note: A health check-up biobank cohort of Korean examinees; despite the gene-environment name, the paper describes deep clinical phenotyping with environment and lifestyle mentioned only generically, not a design built around measuring environmental exposures, and no disease selection.

label: China Atherosclerosis Study
quote: CAS consisted of 1,010 cases of CAD and 3,998 controls. 1,010 cases from the Northern provinces in China were enrolled from Fuwai Hospital, National Center of Cardiovascular Diseases. 83.8% of cases have a family history of CAD.
note: A Han Chinese case-control collection of hospital-enrolled coronary artery disease cases and population controls; no exposure basis.

label: Diabetes Prediction and Prevention
quote: The carriers of the genotype DQB1*02/DQB1*03:02 or DQB1*03:02/x genotypes (here x≠ DQB1*02, DQB1*03:01, DQB1*06:02, or DQB1*06:03 alleles) were categorized into the T1D risk group and recruited for the DIPP follow up program.
note: A Finnish birth cohort in which newborns carrying HLA genotypes conferring type 1 diabetes risk are followed for islet autoimmunity and diabetes; selection is by genetic risk, not by exposure.

label: Functional genomic diagnostic tools for coronary artery disease
quote: This study investigated the association of clinical, demographic, and genetic factors with severe coronary artery stenosis phenotypes in our population composed of 1734 individuals with severe coronary stenosis (≥ 50% in coronary vessels) and comparing them to 757 controls with no evidence of stenosis on angiography.
note: A Lebanese series of patients undergoing coronary angiography, analysed as severe coronary stenosis cases against angiographic controls; a clinical disease cohort with no exposure basis.

label: German Chronic Kidney Disease Study
quote: The German Chronic Kidney Disease (GCKD) study is a prospective observational national cohort study. It aims to enrol a total of 5000 patients with CKD of various aetiologies, who are under nephrological care, and to follow them for up to 10 years.
note: A prospective cohort of chronic kidney disease patients under nephrological care in Germany; no exposure basis.

label: German Longevity Study
quote: The examined sample comprised 1351 German LLI (≥94 years, including 643 centenarians) and 4680 German younger controls.
note: Long-lived individuals (94 years and older) compared with younger controls: selection is by the trait of longevity, which is out of scope as a disease, and there is no exposure basis.

label: Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events
quote: GRACE (the Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events) is a large, prospective, multinational observational study of patients hospitalized with ACS.
note: A multinational registry of patients hospitalised with acute coronary syndromes; no exposure basis.

label: TwinGene Study
quote: TwinGene is a cross-sectional study where participants underwent a health examination and venous blood sample collection at a local health care facility between 2004 and 2008.
note: A twin-registry sub-study in which Swedish twins had a health examination and blood draw; twin registries are unselected on exposure and disease.

label: Uppsala Longitudinal Study of Adult Men
quote: ULSAM started as a health investigation, focused at identifying metabolic risk factors for cardiovascular disease, to which all 50 year-old men living in Uppsala in 1970 were invited.
note: A population cohort of all 50-year-old men in Uppsala set up to identify metabolic risk factors for cardiovascular disease (later broadened to ageing); diet and physical activity are measured among many variables, so no exposure design.

label: Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Ageing
quote: The National Institute on Aging’s Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging (BLSA) is America's longest-running scientific study of human aging.
note: A longitudinal study of normal human ageing in healthy volunteers; ageing is not a disease and there is no exposure basis.

label: Motor Neuron Disease Biobank study
quote: Adults attending one of 20 UK hospitals and who had been diagnosed with ALS by two consultant neurologists were invited to participate in the UK National DNA Bank for Motor Neuron Disease Research (MND DNA bank), a national collection of ALS DNA samples derived from whole blood.
note: A national DNA bank of patients diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis at UK hospitals; no exposure basis.

label: Singapore Diabetic Cohort Study
quote: The diabetic cohort (DC) was set up to study the determinants of complications in individuals with type 2 diabetes and examine the role of genetic, physiological and lifestyle factors in the development of complications in these individuals.
note: A cohort of adults with physician-diagnosed type 2 diabetes recruited from Singapore clinics to study complications; lifestyle is one factor among many, not an exposure design.

label: Ely Study
quote: The Ely study, established in 1990, is a prospective study of the etiology of type 2 diabetes, as described in detail elsewhere (18, 19).
note: A population-based cohort of non-diabetic adults from one Ely practice followed to study the incidence and aetiology of type 2 diabetes; no exposure basis.

label: Genetic Asthma Susceptibility to Indoor Pollution in Peru
exposures: indoor pollution
quote: We do so by determining the global estimates of ancestry for children with and without asthma from the Genetic Asthma Susceptibility to Indoor Pollution in Peru (GASP study), and evaluating if these global ancestry estimates are associated with asthma status, lung function and total serum IgE levels (IgE).
note: A case-control study of Peruvian children with and without asthma built, as its name states, to study genetic susceptibility to indoor pollution (the paper describes it as evaluating genetics, environment and asthma status); the pollution design is stated only through the study's name, so the exposure verdict is medium.

label: Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative
quote: The Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI) is an observational, international study designed to establish biomarker-defined cohorts and identify clinical, imaging, genetic, and biospecimen Parkinson's disease (PD) progression markers to accelerate disease-modifying therapeutic trials.
note: An international biomarker cohort of untreated early Parkinson's disease patients (with healthy controls and SWEDD subjects) followed for progression markers; no exposure basis.

label: Psychosis Endophenotype Consortium
quote: 1239 cases with schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, or psychotic bipolar disorder; 857 of their unaffected relatives, and 2739 healthy controls were genotyped with the Affymetrix 6.0 single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) array.
note: A consortium of psychosis case collections (schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, psychotic bipolar disorder) with their unaffected relatives and controls; classified by the patient collections it aggregates, with no exposure basis.

label: Study of Health in Pomerania
quote: A sample of 7008 women and men aged 20 to 79 years in a north-east region of Germany, 4900 expected participants. The sample was drawn in two steps: First, 32 communities in the region were selected. Second, within the communities a simple random sample was drawn from residence registries, stratified by gender and age.
note: Population-based random samples of adults in West Pomerania examined for a broad range of diseases and risk factors; neither an exposure nor a single disease defines the SHIP cohorts.

label: The Cooperative Health Research in South Tyrol
quote: The Cooperative Health Research In South Tyrol (CHRIS) study is a population-based study with a longitudinal lookout to investigate the genetic and molecular basis of age-related common chronic conditions and their interaction with life style and environment in the general population.
note: A general-population study of the Vinschgau valley with a broad remit of age-related chronic conditions; lifestyle and environment are mentioned as interacting factors, not as an exposure-centred design, and no single disease defines it.

label: The Health Effects of Arsenic Longitudinal Study
exposures: arsenic exposure through drinking water
quote: The Health Effects of Arsenic Longitudinal Study (HEALS [41]) is a prospective investigation of health outcomes associated with arsenic exposure through drinking water in a cohort of adults in Araihazar, Bangladesh, a rural area east of the capital city, Dhaka.
note: Population-based prospective cohort of adults in an arsenic-affected rural area of Bangladesh, set up to study the health effects of arsenic in drinking water; the outcomes are all-cause and chronic-disease mortality broadly, not one disease.

label: 100,000 Genomes Project
note: NHS patients with rare diseases or cancer, and their relatives, sequenced by Genomics England for diagnosis; the quoted pilot describes the rare disease arm and the cancer arm comes from the definition. No exposure basis.

label: 1958 British Birth Cohort
quote: The 1958 National Child Development Study (NCDS) is following the lives of an initial 17,415 people born in England, Scotland and Wales in a single week of 1958.
note: General birth cohort of everyone born in Great Britain in one week of March 1958, followed for health, cognition and social outcomes and used as population controls; no exposure or disease selection.

label: 300BCG
quote: To investigate human population variation of trained immunity, we immunized healthy individuals with Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG).
note: Healthy volunteers vaccinated with BCG to study variation in trained immunity; vaccination is an intervention, not an environmental exposure, and the participants are healthy.

label: AACR Project GENIE
note: AACR registry aggregating clinical tumour sequencing and outcomes of cancer patients from participating cancer centres; the EGA study used it as a cohort of 121,771 sequenced tumour samples. No exposure basis.

label: AC-ANGIOPREDICT Phase II trial
note: Phase II trial cohort of metastatic colorectal cancer patients treated with bevacizumab-containing therapy; treatment is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: Adjuvant Lapatinib and/or Trastuzumab Treatment Optimisation trial
note: Phase III adjuvant trial cohort of women with HER2-positive early breast cancer; no exposure basis.

label: African Collaborative Center for Microbiome and Genomics Research
note: HIV-negative women from the general population of Abuja enrolled in a cohort set up to study persistent hrHPV infection and cervical cancer; they were not selected for an environmental exposure, and smoking and other risk factors are measured only as covariates.

label: African Genome Resource
quote: Whole genome DNAseq data at 4x-8x depth from approximately 3,000 Africans of 14 distinct ethnicities
note: A genome reference resource (haplotype reference panel, transcriptomes and an informatics centre) built from African population samples of many ethnicities; no exposure or disease basis.

label: African Genome Variation Project
quote: The African Genome Variation Project represents dense genotypes from 1,481 individuals and whole-genome sequences from 320 individuals across sub-Saharan Africa.
note: Population-genetic resource of individuals from 18 ethno-linguistic groups across sub-Saharan Africa, assembled to characterise genetic diversity; no exposure or disease selection.

label: African Partnership for Chronic Disease Research
note: Consortium that brings together population cohorts, genome resources and diabetes case collections from sub-Saharan Africa to study the genetics of chronic disease broadly; a broad chronic-disease purpose is not a disease cohort, and nothing in it is exposure-based.

label: ALLG ALL06
note: Adolescent and young adult patients with acute lymphoblastic leukaemia treated on the ALLG ALL06 protocol; no exposure basis.

label: Alpe-DPD study
note: Adult cancer patients starting fluoropyrimidine chemotherapy in Dutch hospitals, genotyped for DPYD variants and toxicity; the EGA text names only the treatment and the definition names cancer. Drug treatment is not an environmental exposure.

label: APCDR Diabetes Case Control Study
note: Collection of type 2 diabetes cases of Zulu descent assembled by APCDR for diabetes genetics; no exposure basis.

label: Atlas of Blood Cancer Genomes
note: Project assembling and sequencing cohorts of patients with distinct blood cancers (BPDCN, high-grade B-cell lymphoma, T lymphoblastic leukaemia/lymphoma) into a genomic atlas; the quoted EGA study is its BPDCN cohort. No exposure basis.

label: Australian childhood AML cohort
note: Australian children with acute myeloid leukaemia whose exomes were screened for germline cancer-predisposition variants; no exposure basis.

label: BEACON eczema drug trial
note: Patients with atopic dermatitis enrolled in the BEACON eczema drug trial, profiled for the Human Cell Atlas; the EGA page gives only a title-level statement of the disease. No exposure basis.

label: Beat AML
note: Acute myeloid leukaemia patients of the Beat AML programme whose tumour specimens were sequenced and drug-tested; chemotherapy in the secondary analysis is treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Belgian Approach of Local Laboratory Extensive Tumor Testing
note: Belgian precision-oncology study enrolling metastatic or locally advanced cancer patients for comprehensive genomic profiling; no exposure basis.

label: BELLINI trial
note: Phase 2 trial cohort of patients with early-stage triple negative breast cancer given neoadjuvant nivolumab with or without ipilimumab; no exposure basis.

label: Blood First Assay Screening Trial
note: Multicohort trial of patients with advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer selected by blood-based molecular testing; no exposure basis.

label: Born in Bradford
quote: Born in Bradford (BiB) is similarly focused on a particular local area, the city of Bradford in the north of England, and recruited 13,858 babies between 2007 and 2011, of whom ~41% self-report as white British and ~59% as other ethnicities, predominantly Pakistani.
note: Multi-ethnic birth cohort recruited from routine maternity care in Bradford to study the determinants of childhood health broadly; it sits in the exposome catalogue but is not designed around an exposure and is not selected for a disease.

label: CALGB 40601
note: Phase III neoadjuvant trial cohort of women with HER2-positive breast cancer; no exposure basis.

label: Cambridge Biorepository for Translational Medicine
quote: This project involves a genotyping dataset generated using the UK Biobank Axiom™ Array Kit from donor samples provided by the Cambridge Biorepository for Translational Medicine (CBTM).
note: Biorepository of tissue and blood from organ and tissue donors in Cambridge, genotyped for Human Cell Atlas work; unselected donors with no exposure or disease basis.

label: Canadian Airways Research Group
note: Prospective cohort of patients with idiopathic or trauma-induced subglottic stenosis plus controls, enrolled by the Canadian Airways Research Group; the trauma is a medical (airway) injury, not an environmental exposure.

label: Canadian Prostate Cancer Genome Network
note: Men with intermediate-risk prostate cancer whose tumour genomes were sequenced by CPC-GENE; a tumour series of patients with no environmental exposure in its design.

label: Cancer Genomics of the Kidney
note: Tumour and constitutional DNA pairs from patients with clear cell renal carcinoma assembled by the ICGC CAGEKID project; a patient series, not an exposure cohort.

label: Celiac Disease Northern Netherlands cohort
note: Treated coeliac disease patients and controls from Groningen whose faecal microbiomes were sequenced; the patients define the cohort, and the gluten-free diet is a treatment rather than an environmental exposure.

label: CENet Cohort
note: Patients with genetic generalized or non-acquired focal epilepsy collected in Montreal for whole-genome sequencing; a patient series.

label: CHILD Cohort Study
exposures: environmental determinants of atopic diseases
quote: The core mission of the CHILD Cohort Study is to advance knowledge about the genetic and environmental determinants of atopic diseases including asthma, allergy, allergic rhinitis, and eczema through trans-disciplinary and longitudinal study, with the goal of advancing the health status and well-being of children in Canada.
note: A Canadian birth cohort listed in the Global Exposome Cohort Catalogue whose stated core mission is the genetic and environmental determinants of atopic diseases; the exposure verdict rests on that stated mission (the bundle names no specific agents, hence the category other), and the disease verdict on the same sentence naming asthma, allergy, allergic rhinitis and eczema.

label: City of Hope triple negative breast cancer cohort
note: Treatment-naive triple negative breast cancer patients at City of Hope whose tumours were whole-genome and RNA sequenced; a patient series.

label: CLUSTER consortium
note: A UK consortium harmonising juvenile idiopathic arthritis and associated uveitis cohorts and trials; it collects patient cohorts of one disease family and has no exposure component.

label: COMPARE study
quote: The COMPARE study enrolled 29,066 British blood between donors between February 2016 and March 2017, the study aim is to find the optimum technology for haemoglobin screening (ISRCTN 90871183).
note: British blood donors enrolled in a haemoglobin screening technology trial and later genotyped for array development; unselected donors, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: COVID-19 Host Genetics Initiative
note: A global meta-analysis initiative combining COVID-19 case cohorts with population-based controls; classified by what its members collect (COVID-19 cases), and SARS-CoV-2 enters as the disease studied, not as an exposure that defines the participants.

label: CRCbiome
note: Participants of the Norwegian bowel cancer screening trial with a positive FIT, followed for gut metagenome before and after colonoscopy to detect advanced colorectal lesions, so selected for their risk of colorectal cancer. Diet and lifestyle are collected for interaction analyses, but the design centres on the microbiome as a screening biomarker, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: DERMATLAS
note: A genomic atlas of skin tumour subtypes, this EGA study holding the SCC and BCC cases for methylation; a tumour series of patients with no exposure basis stated.

label: Diagnosis and Management of Febrile Illness using RNA Personalised Molecular Signature Diagnosis
note: Children and adults with febrile illness, including MIS-C, recruited prospectively at UK and EU hospitals to develop transcriptomic diagnostic signatures; a patient cohort, and the infections are the diseases studied rather than an exposure defining recruitment.

label: DKTK MASTER
note: A prospective precision oncology observational cohort of the German Cancer Consortium enrolling adults under 51 with advanced cancer and patients with rare tumours; a patient cohort.

label: Donor InSight III study
quote: The Donor InSight III study, undertaken by Sanquin research, recruited 3,046 Dutch blood donors between 2015 and 2016.
note: Dutch blood donors recruited by Sanquin to study donor characteristics, motivations and health, genotyped for array development; unselected donors, so neither verdict applies.

label: East London Genes and Health
quote: East London Genes and Health (ELGH) is a cohort of healthy British South Asians being recruited by David van Heel, Richard Trembath and colleagues, with consent for recall.
note: A community cohort of healthy British Bangladeshi and Pakistani adults recruited with consent for recall by genotype; a general population cohort.

label: Egyptian Collaborative Cardiac Genomics Project
quote: Here, we present the first 391 Egyptian healthy volunteers (EHVols) recruited to establish a pilot phenotyped control cohort.
note: Egyptian healthy volunteers free of cardiovascular disease recruited as a phenotyped control cohort; healthy volunteers are not a disease cohort even though the project is meant to support future CVD studies.

label: EMC-DC-IL10R study
note: An Erasmus MC study cohort of healthy donors together with paediatric inflammatory bowel disease patients (and, per the definition, an IL10RA-deficient patient) profiled by RNA-seq; the patients make it a disease cohort, and nothing environmental defines it.

label: Emirati Genome Program
quote: Here, we present a comprehensive genomic characterization of a cohort of 43,608 Emirati genomes sequenced as part of the Emirati Genome Program (EGP).
note: The national genome programme of the United Arab Emirates sequencing Emirati citizens for population-scale variant discovery; a population cohort.

label: Entebbe Mother and Baby study
quote: We aim to genotype 1,500 children from the Entebbe Mother and Baby (EMaB) study, an ongoing birth cohort in southern Uganda, using the Illumina HumanOmni 2.5M chip array.
note: A Ugandan birth cohort genotyped for serological response to infant vaccinations, with malaria, infection and atopy phenotypes; its purpose is vaccine response across several diseases rather than one disease, and no environmental exposure defines it.

label: EORTC-SPECTA RP1759
note: Adolescent and young adult patients with newly diagnosed or relapsed high-grade glioma recruited across Europe; a patient cohort.

label: ESTAMPA
note: A multicentre Latin American cervical cancer screening and triage study with HPV testing (its full Spanish name), whose participants' cervical cells with and without HPV and pre-cancerous lesions were sequenced; a screening population whose purpose is one disease. HPV status is measured, not a recruitment criterion, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: Estonian Microbiome Cohort
quote: As part of the Estonian Biobank, we established the Estonian Microbiome Cohort which includes stool, oral and plasma samples from 2,509 participants and is supplemented with multi-omic measurements, questionnaires, and regular linkages to national electronic health records.
note: A sub-cohort of Estonian Biobank volunteers who gave stool, oral and plasma samples for microbiome research; a population biobank sub-cohort, and the medication effects it studies are not environmental exposures.

label: Etude des Déterminants pré et postnatals précoces du développement et de la santé de l'Enfant
quote: The EDEN study is a French bicentric generalist cohort study (Heude et al. IJE 2016).
note: A French mother-child cohort recruited in pregnancy to study pre- and early postnatal determinants of child health and development, listed in the Global Exposome Cohort Catalogue; the catalogue calls it a generalist cohort that collects exposures among many phenotypes, so exposure is not its stated design purpose, and its contribution to the MeDALL allergy project is a use rather than a disease purpose.

label: EuroEPINOMICS
note: A European research networking programme of epilepsy genetics groups whose sites contribute patients with epilepsy and paroxysmal neurological disorders to sequencing studies; an aggregation of patient collections.

label: European BestAgeing Study
note: A multicentre European cohort of 1,209 patients with acute coronary syndrome, coronary artery disease or cardiomyopathy plus 848 controls, profiled for circulating miRNAs; a patient cohort of cardiovascular disease.

label: Extended Cohort for E-health, Environment and DNA
quote: EXCEED is a longitudinal population-based cohort which facilitates investigation of genetic, environmental and lifestyle-related determinants of a broad range of diseases and of multiple morbidity through data collected at baseline and via electronic healthcare record linkage.
note: A population-based cohort of adults in Leicestershire with electronic health record linkage. Environment is one of three determinant classes studied across a broad range of diseases, so exposure is not the design purpose and no single disease is its subject.

label: Genome Database of Latvian Population
quote: sequence 502 individuals from the Genome Database of Latvian Population as representatives of the Latvian population
note: A national population biobank whose participants were sequenced as representatives of the Latvian population to build a reference panel: a general biobank with no exposure or disease selection. The quote is the curated location quote from the EGA study page; the cached copy of that page now shows only the title (pending for release).

label: Genome Diversity in Africa Project
quote: Using a sequencing-based approach, the Genome Diversity in Africa Project (GDAP) aims to produce a comprehensive catalogue of human genetic variation in SSA, including single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), structural variants, and haplotypes.
note: A population-genetics project sequencing individuals from ethnolinguistic groups across sub-Saharan Africa to catalogue genetic variation; although run under the African Partnership for Chronic Disease Research, its own participants are selected by ancestry, not by exposure or disease.

label: Genome Research at Fundació ACE
quote: The GR@ACE study comprises 7,409 unrelated individuals. 4,120 AD cases were diagnosed at Fundació ACE Memory Clinic (Barcelona, Spain).
note: A case-control GWAS collection of Alzheimer's disease patients diagnosed at a memory clinic plus Spanish controls; the cases define it as a disease cohort and no exposure is studied.

label: Genomic Advances in Sepsis
quote: Patients with sepsis due to community acquired pneumonia or faecal peritonitis were recruited from 35 hospitals across the UK from 2005-2018, with samples for functional genomics and detailed clinical information collected over the first five days of ICU admission.
note: A biobank of adult intensive-care patients with sepsis from community-acquired pneumonia or faecal peritonitis; participants are selected by the disease, not by exposure to an agent.

label: German Cancer Consortium
quote: We analysed the molecular profiles and clinical outcomes of patients with pazopanib-treated sarcoma enrolled in a prospective observational study by the German Cancer Consortium, DKTK MASTER, that employs whole-genome/exome sequencing and transcriptome sequencing to inform the care of young adults with advanced cancer across histology and patients with rare cancers.
note: A consortium of German cancer centres whose collected cohort, DKTK MASTER, enrols patients with advanced or rare cancers for precision oncology; classified by what it collects, it is a cancer patient aggregation with no exposure focus.

label: German MI cohort
quote: The experiment will use the early onset patients from the German MI cohort and the UK BHF CAD/MI cohort both of which have strong family history.
note: German patients with early-onset myocardial infarction and a strong family history of coronary disease, used as cases in the Cardiogenics re-sequencing study; a patient series with no exposure component.

label: GMMG-BIRMA trial
quote: ENCORAFENIB COMBINED WITH BINIMETINIB FOR BRAFV600E-MUTATED RELAPSED/REFRACTORY MULTIPLE MYELOMA: THE PHASE II GMMG-BIRMA TRIAL (Hipo_K08K)
note: Twelve relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma patients with BRAF V600E mutations enrolled in a phase II trial of encorafenib and binimetinib; a trial cohort whose participants have the disease, with no exposure component.

label: Gutenberg Health Study
quote: The Gutenberg Health Study (GHS) is a community-based, prospective, observational, single-center cohort study in the Rhine-Main area of western Germany.
note: A community-based population cohort of adults from Mainz and Mainz-Bingen with broad cardiovascular, metabolic, ophthalmological and psychological phenotyping; the definition gives its purpose as cardiovascular and other common diseases, a broad purpose rather than one disease, and exposures are not its design.

label: Haematological Malignancy Research Network
quote: Covering a population of around 4 million, HMRN collects detailed information about all patients diagnosed with a haematological malignancy within the HMRN region, accruing around 2,400 new diagnoses each year.
note: A population-based registry of every patient newly diagnosed with a haematological malignancy in two UK cancer networks since 2004: a disease registry, with no exposure component.

label: Health, Alcohol and Psychosocial factors In Eastern Europe study
exposures: alcohol | nutrition
quote: The main hypotheses of the HAPIEE study relate to the role of alcohol, nutrition and psychosocial factors.
note: A prospective cohort of random population samples of adults aged 45-69 in four eastern European cities, designed to test the roles of alcohol, nutrition and psychosocial factors in cardiovascular and other non-communicable diseases. Alcohol and diet are its stated main hypotheses, so it is an exposure cohort; its disease purpose is broad (cardiovascular and other NCDs) in an unselected population, so not a disease cohort.

label: Healthy Life in an Urban Setting
quote: This is a multi-ethnic population-based cohort study in Amsterdam, the Netherlands with in total over 25,000 participants.
note: A multi-ethnic population-based cohort of Amsterdam residents studying ethnic differences in health; a general population cohort with no exposure design or single-disease purpose.

label: ICGC Gastric Cancer China project
quote: There are 340 cases belongs to ICGC GACA-CN project.
note: The Chinese gastric cancer project of the ICGC, a collection of 340 tumour cases; the EGA page gives only the case count, the disease follows from the project's name (GACA = gastric cancer).

label: ICGC Gynecological Carcinosarcoma project
quote: The aim of ICGC GCS program is to genomically characterize C and S components of 20 tumors, from endometrium or ovary, through an integrative analysis of whole genome sequencing, RNA sequencing and methylome array.
note: An ICGC tumour collection of 20 gynaecological carcinosarcomas of the endometrium or ovary characterised by genome, transcriptome and methylome sequencing; a tumour series, no exposure component.

label: ICGC India Project
quote: As a part of the ICGC, India has undertaken genomic studies on gingivobuccal cancer of the oral cavity, which is the most prevalent form of cancer among men in India.
note: India's ICGC project: paired tumour and blood samples from patients with gingivo-buccal oral squamous cell carcinoma recruited in Mumbai. Nearly all patients were tobacco chewers and exposure data are recorded, but participants were selected for the cancer, not for tobacco exposure, so it is a disease cohort rather than an exposure cohort.

label: ICGC Liver Cancer China project
quote: The Landscape of Genetic Alterations in Hepatocellular Carcinoma, 88 matched HCC tumour/normal pairs WGS belongs to ICGC LICA-CN project
note: The Chinese liver cancer project of the ICGC: 88 hepatocellular carcinomas with matched normal tissue, whole-genome sequenced. A tumour series, no exposure component.

label: ICGC MMML-Seq
quote: In the framework of the German ICGC MMML-Seq we are currently exploring sequencing data of GCB-lymphomas and paired normal controls as well as normal B-cell subsets separated by FACS.
note: The German ICGC lymphoma sequencing project: germinal-centre B-cell derived lymphomas (Burkitt, follicular and diffuse large B-cell) from children and adults with paired normals. A tumour series, no exposure component.

label: ICGC Oesophageal Adenocarcinoma project
quote: Data from 496 OCCAMS (Oesophageal Cancer Clinical And Molecular Stratification) cases.
note: The UK ICGC oesophageal adenocarcinoma project, gathering tumour, Barrett's oesophagus and lymph-node samples with matched normals through the OCCAMS hospital network; a patient series, no exposure component.

label: ICGC Pancreatic Cancer project
quote: ICGC Pancreatic Cancer study Pancreatic Cancer whole genome sequencing of 112 samples
note: An ICGC collection of 112 pancreatic cancer samples that were whole-genome sequenced; the EGA page is sparse but states the disease, so a tumour series with no exposure component.

label: ICGC PedBrain Tumor Project
quote: Here we describe whole-genome sequencing of 96 pilocytic astrocytomas, with matched RNA sequencing (n = 73), conducted by the International Cancer Genome Consortium (ICGC) PedBrain Tumor Project.
note: The ICGC paediatric brain tumour project, sequencing childhood brain tumours (pilocytic and other low-grade astrocytomas, medulloblastomas, glioblastomas) with matched normals; a tumour series, no exposure component.

label: ICGC Prostate Cancer UK project
quote: Prostate cancer somatic genomic sequencing data generated from 2011 onwards under auspices of the International Cancer Genome Consortium Prostate Cancer UK consortium (CRUK-ICGC Prostate Group)
note: The UK ICGC prostate cancer project: primary and metastatic prostate cancers with matched blood, sequenced to study multifocality, heterogeneity, castration resistance and metastasis. A patient series, no exposure component.

label: ICR MOPOPGEN UK exome control series
quote: For comparison, we analysed WES data on 1,644 UK population controls from the 1958 Birth Cohort (1958BC) with no history of malignancy.
note: A series of exome-sequenced UK population controls drawn from the 1958 Birth Cohort with no history of malignancy, assembled by the ICR for comparison with cancer cases; unselected controls, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: IMI-RHAPSODY
quote: Molecular data of large diabetes cohorts was generated to identify markers of diabetes progression measured as time to insulin initiation
note: An IMI consortium pooling European diabetes cohorts to find markers of glycaemic deterioration in type 2 diabetes (time to insulin initiation) and of progression from pre-diabetes; classified by what it collects, an aggregation of diabetes patient cohorts with no exposure focus.

label: IMMUcan
quote: The goal of IMMUcan is to understand how the immune system interacts with tumors and how therapeutic interventions influence this interaction.
note: An IMI consortium building prospective cohorts of cancer patients (head and neck, lung, breast) with tumour immune profiling; its member SCCHN1 cohort is of recurrent or metastatic head and neck cancer patients, so an aggregation of cancer patient cohorts with no exposure focus.

label: IMMUcan SCCHN1 cohort
quote: This cohort includes patients with confirmed locally recurrent and/or metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck (SCCHN) who receive first-line treatment with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) or ICI combined with chemotherapy.
note: Patients with locally recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma on first-line immune checkpoint inhibitors, profiled by IMMUcan; a patient cohort, no exposure component.

label: ImmunAID
note: Multicentre cohort of patients with systemic autoinflammatory diseases assembled for biomarker discovery; a patient series, with no exposure component.

label: Initiative for Molecular Profiling and Advanced Cancer Therapy 2
note: Patients with advanced (metastatic, per the definition) cancer whose tumours were profiled in the IMPACT 2 randomised study at MD Anderson; the EGA page shows only a cancer genomics study of patient samples, so the disease verdict follows from the design and name. No exposure basis.

label: International Cancer Genome Consortium
note: Consortium of cancer genome projects, each a tumour series of one cancer type; classified by what it collects. No exposure basis.

label: International Genetics of Parkinson Disease Progression Consortium
note: Consortium pooling longitudinal cohorts of Parkinson disease patients followed from disease onset for progression studies. No exposure basis.

label: International HapMap Project
note: Reference collection of DNA samples and cell lines from population samples of several ancestries, used as a reference panel and control set; the EGA text treats it as a population resource (HapMap Maasai and other populations). Neither disease nor exposure defines it; no sentence states the recruitment basis, so no quote.

label: InterPregGen
note: Consortium combining maternal and fetal preeclampsia case-control collections for GWAS meta-analysis; preeclampsia is a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy, counted as a disease rather than as pregnancy itself. No exposure basis.

label: Korean Genome Project
note: General-population whole-genome resource of Koreans with routine health check-up phenotypes; healthy participants (those reporting a rare disease were removed), no exposure design.

label: LifeLines-DEEP
quote: From April to August 2013, all participants registered at the LifeLines Research Site in Groningen were invited to participate in LifeLines DEEP, in addition to the regular LifeLines programme.
note: General-population multi-omics sub-cohort of LifeLines, open to all registered participants. The profile says it 'has been designed to study exposures in detail', but in the systems-epidemiology sense (diet, microbiome, environmental and lifestyle factors among thousands of phenotypes); no environmental agent is a stated purpose, so exposure is no; disease is no.

label: Lifelines-NEXT
note: Population birth cohort of newborns and mothers nested in LifeLines, followed for microbiome development; maternal smoking is one of many recorded variables, not a design purpose.

label: Liverpool Preterm Birth Biomarker Study
note: Pregnant women recruited at 16 and 20 weeks, enriched for those with a previous spontaneous preterm birth (with low-risk term controls), to find early biomarkers of spontaneous preterm birth; treated as a cohort at risk of a pregnancy complication rather than of pregnancy itself. No exposure basis.

label: Low coverage Kuusamo whole genome sequencing study
note: Geographic subset (Kuusamo) of the FINRISK 2012 population survey sample, sequenced at low coverage; a population sample with no disease or exposure selection.

label: Lung Cancer Diagnostic Study
note: Prospective diagnostic cohort of individuals at risk for lung cancer, about a third of whom were diagnosed with it. The basis of the at-risk selection (smoking history versus symptomatic referral) is not stated in the cached text and the paper is not cached, so whether it is also a tobacco-exposure cohort cannot be settled.

label: lungNENomics
note: Tumour series of patients with lung neuroendocrine neoplasms profiled by WGS, RNA-seq and methylation arrays. No exposure basis.

label: Maastricht IBS studies
note: Irritable bowel syndrome cases and controls from Maastricht University Medical Centre studies; the cases of a case-control collection. No exposure basis.

label: Malaria Genomic Epidemiology Network
note: Definition only: an international network assembling samples for the genomic epidemiology of malaria, whose member cohorts are severe-malaria case-control studies in Malawi, Tanzania and Ghana. The cached EGA page describes only an African population reference set and never mentions malaria, so no quote. Defined by disease, not by exposure to the parasite.

label: Malaysian Breast Cancer cohort
note: Hospital-based cohort of Malaysian breast cancer patients with tumour sequencing. No exposure basis.

label: Malmö Diet and Cancer Study
exposures: diet
note: Definition only: a population-based prospective cohort of Malmö residents set up, as its name states, to investigate diet and cancer (with cardiovascular disease added), an EPIC-type diet-and-cancer cohort. The cached EGA page only names the MDC study as a source of ischaemic stroke cases and controls, so no quote supports either verdict.

label: Mechanisms of the Development of Allergy
note: EU project pooling European birth cohorts (INMA, EDEN, BAMSE, PIAMA, MAS) to study the mechanisms of allergy development; classified by its stated purpose, one disease family. Some member cohorts have environmental designs, but exposure is not MeDALL's purpose.

label: Medical Genome Reference Bank
note: Reference resource of healthy elderly individuals selected for the absence of major disease, drawn from community cohorts; healthy volunteers, no exposure design.

label: MESOMICS
note: Tumour series of malignant pleural mesothelioma from the French MESOMICS project; defined by the disease, not by asbestos exposure, which the source does not mention.

label: Milieu Intérieur
note: Population-based cohort of 1,000 healthy donors for immune variability studies; 'environment' figures only as one broad factor among genetics and immunity, not as an exposure design.

label: MITO16A/MaNGO-OV2 trial
note: Ovarian cancer patients enrolled in the phase IV MITO16A/MaNGO-OV2 trial of first-line therapy. No exposure basis.

label: Molecular Phenotyping to Accelerate Genomic Epidemiology
note: EU project drawing on sub-studies of two population resources (Oxford Biobank, TwinsUK) with the stated purpose of finding diabetes biomarkers; a population study of one disease. No exposure basis.

label: Molecular Taxonomy of Breast Cancer International Consortium
note: Tumour bank collection of about 2,000 primary breast tumours with clinical follow-up from UK and Canadian banks. No exposure basis.

label: MRCE family panel
note: Definition only: a family panel of 550 individuals from asthma families, used to map expression QTLs; families ascertained through asthma comprise patients and their relatives, so 'at risk'. The cached EGA page describes only the eQTL work and never mentions asthma, so no quote. No exposure basis.

label: MultiMuTHER
quote: Longitudinal dynamics of gene expression and metabolomics in an aging population cohort The MultiMuTHER study is a longitudinal study of 335 subjects seen at three or more clinical visits per participant.
note: Longitudinal sub-study of TwinsUK women (a population twin register) on molecular ageing; environmental factors are assessed only among other influences on molecular traits, and ageing is not a disease.

label: Multiple Tissue Human Expression Resource
quote: derived from a total of 43 female twinsbelonging to the MuTHER/TwinsUK cohort.
note: Multi-tissue expression resource drawn from healthy female TwinsUK twins to map regulation of gene expression; no exposure or disease selection.

label: Nala GSI GSAv3 PGx Study
quote: Here, we present the results of accuracy and precision assessments, involving a total of 73 cell lines.
note: Pharmacogenomic array validation on 73 reference cell lines (GIAB, GeT-RM, 1000 Genomes), not on recruited people; neither exposure nor disease applies.

label: NCI China cohort
exposures: diesel exhaust fumes
quote: These patients have been exposed to diesel exhaust fumes.
note: NCI/IARC cohort of Chinese people with and without bladder cancer, all exposed to diesel exhaust, sampled for duplex sequencing of buccal cells; the EGA page names only diesel exhaust and bladder cancer (the definition adds PAHs and lung cancer from another study).

label: NCI Taiwan cohort
note: Taiwanese case series of oral cancer, oral dysplasia and people with unnamed risk factors for oral cancer, sampled for buccal-cell duplex sequencing; the page does not say which risk factors (e.g. betel quid or tobacco) define the exposed group, so the exposure verdict cannot be settled from the bundle.

label: NeoALTTO
note: Phase III neoadjuvant trial cohort of women with HER2-positive breast cancer; treatment is the only 'exposure'.

label: NIHR BioResource
quote: The dataset includes 13489 samples from blood donors, they were not screened for any particular disease, and therefore they are representative of the general population.
note: National recall-by-genotype volunteer resource of blood donors and patients across common and rare diseases; a broad biobank rather than a cohort of one disease, and no exposure design.

label: Pan-Cancer Analysis of Whole Genomes
note: Aggregation of ICGC and TCGA tumour whole genomes across cancer types; it collects cancer patients, with no exposure design.

label: PANDA trial
note: Phase 2 neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy trial in 21 patients with resectable gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma; treatment only, no environmental exposure.

label: PELICAN
note: Rapid-autopsy series of men who died of lethal metastatic prostate cancer at Johns Hopkins; a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: PETAL trial
note: German PET-guided therapy trial of DLBCL patients whose tumours were sequenced; treatment only.

label: PHOENIX trial
note: Phase III ibrutinib plus R-CHOP trial in non-GCB DLBCL; the EGA study holds the non-China cohort's tumour sequencing. Treatment only, no environmental exposure.

label: Polish glioma cohort
note: Polish series of glioma patients (WHO grades II-IV) with tumour and matched blood sequencing; no exposure design.

label: Posthumous Evaluation of Advanced Cancer Environment
note: UK research autopsy programme of patients with advanced cancer (this EGA study: 14 ICI-treated metastatic melanoma patients); a patient cohort, no exposure design.

label: PRedicting Outcomes For Crohn's disease using a moLecular biomarker
note: UK biomarker-stratified randomised trial of adults with newly diagnosed active Crohn's disease, with stool metagenomics; treatment only.

label: Pregnancy Outcome Prediction study
quote: The Pregnancy Outcome Prediction (POP) study is a prospective cohort study of nulliparous women attending the Rosie Hospital (Cambridge, UK) for their dating ultrasound scan.
note: Unselected prospective cohort of nulliparous pregnant women whose stated purpose is predicting adverse pregnancy outcomes (the page's case sets are preeclampsia, fetal growth restriction and preterm birth); pregnancy itself is out of scope but the cohort is built around these complications, so it is taken as a population study of that disease family. No exposure design.

label: Premature Atherosclerosis Study pedigrees
note: Amsterdam pedigrees ascertained through premature atherosclerosis, exome sequenced for rare cardiovascular variants; pedigrees include affected members and their relatives (at risk), classed here by the disease that defines them. No exposure design.

label: PrevANZ trial
note: Australian/New Zealand trial in people with a first demyelinating event, selected for their high risk of definite multiple sclerosis; vitamin D supplementation is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Prevention and Incidence of Asthma and Mite Allergy
exposures: house dust mite allergen (RCT on the use of bed-covers)
quote: Birth cohort in Utrecht, Rotterdam and Groningen with RCT on the use of bed-covers in the first years
note: Dutch birth cohort set up around the prevention and incidence of asthma and mite allergy, with a nested trial of mite-avoiding bed-covers, and listed in the Global Exposome Cohort Catalogue; the exposure verdict rests on that catalogue entry and the allergen-avoidance design (the MOLGENIS page itself is not cached), and the disease verdict on the cohort's stated asthma/allergy purpose.

label: Princess Margaret Cancer Centre acute myeloid leukemia patient cohort
note: Toronto tissue-bank series of 81 AML patients whose samples were RNA sequenced; a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: Radar cohort
exposures: paternal exposure to ionizing radiation in radar technicians
quote: The father in this cohort were exposed to 0-353mSv of ionizing radiation and serve as exposed samples.
note: Children of radar technicians occupationally exposed to ionizing radiation, whole-genome sequenced for transgenerational mutation signatures; selected for the fathers' exposure, not for any disease.

label: Research on Obesity and Diabetes among African Migrants
quote: The RODAM study assesses the health and wellbeing of Ghanaian residents in Ghana and Europe and follows them up over time.
note: Population cohort of Ghanaian adults in rural Ghana, urban Ghana and European cities set up to study obesity, diabetes and cardiovascular disease; the migration/urbanisation contrast is its design but the page names no environmental agent, so it is not taken as an exposure cohort.

label: ROBUST trial
note: Phase III lenalidomide plus R-CHOP trial in newly diagnosed ABC-subtype DLBCL, with tumour RNA and genome sequencing; treatment only.

label: SARS-CoV-2 Vaccine Response in Cancer trial
note: Italian prospective study of SARS-CoV-2 vaccine response in patients with haematological malignancies with healthy controls; vaccination is a medical intervention, not an environmental exposure.

label: Schizophrenia Exome Sequencing Meta-analysis consortium
note: International consortium meta-analysing exomes of schizophrenia cases and controls from member studies; it collects case-control samples for one disease, with no exposure design.

label: Severe Childhood Onset Obesity Project
note: UK cohort of individuals with severe early-onset obesity, a subset of the Genetics of Obesity Study; obesity counts as a disease and no environmental exposure defines the cohort.

label: SG10K Pilot
quote: By whole-genome sequencing of 4,810 Singapore Chinese, Malays, and Indians
note: Population whole-genome sequencing of three Singapore ancestry groups to build an Asian reference and imputation resource; no disease or exposure selection.

label: STRAT-PARK
note: Norwegian longitudinal cohort of people with Parkinson's disease and other neurodegenerative parkinsonisms (with healthy controls) for biomarker-based subtyping; no exposure focus.

label: STREP GENE
note: Survivors of invasive group A streptococcal disease in the UK recruited for a host-susceptibility GWAS; defined by having had the infectious disease, not by exposure to the agent.

label: Stroke Investigative Research and Education Network
note: H3Africa case-control study of stroke in Ghana and Nigeria feeding a stroke GWAS; the EGA text states the stroke focus while the case-control recruitment comes from the definition. Its 'environmental risk factors' are conventional stroke risk factors, not an exposure design.

label: Study Into Lean and Thin Subjects
quote: 1,600 peoplewith thinness (defined as a body mass index <18kg/m2) in the absence of chronic disease oreating disorders have been recruited through primary care with the involvement of UKPrimary Care Research Networks (PCRNs).
note: Persistently thin, healthy adults recruited through UK primary care as the low extreme of BMI; thinness is a trait rather than a disease, and no exposure is involved.

label: SweGen
quote: A total of 1000 individuals, reflecting a cross-section of the population and capturing the main genetic structure, were selected for whole-genome sequencing.
note: Population cross-section of 1,000 Swedes from the Swedish Twin Registry and NSPHS sequenced as a national variant-frequency reference; no disease or exposure selection.

label: Sys4MS cohort
note: Prospective European cohort of patients with multiple sclerosis followed for two years with clinical, imaging and omics data; a patient cohort with no exposure focus.

label: Therapeutically Applicable Research to Generate Effective Treatments
note: NCI initiative assembling tumour cohorts of children with hard-to-treat cancers (the pan-cancer paper analyses 1,699 paediatric B-ALL, T-ALL, AML, neuroblastoma, Wilms tumour and osteosarcoma cases); an aggregation of patient cohorts, with no exposure basis.

label: TRACERx
note: Prospective UK cohort of patients with early-stage non-small cell lung cancer sampled through therapy for tumour evolution; patients are recruited for the cancer, not for smoking or another exposure.

label: TransplantLines
note: Single-centre clinical cohort and biobank of solid organ transplant recipients (plus healthy living donors) at UMCG; recipients are patients treated for organ failure, so this is a patient cohort although the source names the transplant rather than an underlying disease. Transplantation is a medical procedure, not an environmental exposure.

label: TrypanoGEN
note: H3Africa case-control collection of sleeping sickness cases, latent infections and controls from endemic areas of six countries for host-susceptibility genetics; defined by the disease rather than by exposure to the parasite.

label: Tumor Profiler
note: Swiss observational multi-omic tumour-profiling study of patients with AML, metastatic melanoma and metastatic ovarian cancer; the EGA page read covers the AML arm, the other two cancers come from the definition.

label: Type 2 Diabetes Genetic Exploration by Next-generation sequencing in multi-Ethnic Samples
note: Consortium assembling type 2 diabetes cases and controls of five ancestries from member cohorts for exome sequencing; a disease case-control aggregation with no exposure basis.

label: Uganda General Population Cohort
quote: a population-based study of 6,400 individuals from a geographically defined rural community in South-West Uganda
note: Rural general population cohort in south-west Uganda used for population genetics and cardiometabolic, communicable and non-communicable disease research; a general-population design with a broad purpose, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: British Heart Foundation Family Heart Study
note: UK families with at least two siblings affected by premature coronary artery disease recruited for linkage and association studies; the participants are CAD patients (unaffected siblings collected where available), with no exposure basis.

label: UK Blood Service Control Group
quote: Controls used were data from the Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium 2 (WTCCC2) 1958 birth cohort and the UK Blood Service Control Group (available as EGAS00000000028).
note: Blood donors recruited through the UK Blood Services as a population control set for WTCCC and later association studies; unselected donors, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: UK10K
quote: The UK10K project proposes a series of complementary genetic approaches to find new low-frequency/rare variants contributing to disease phenotypes.
note: Sequencing project collecting the TwinsUK and ALSPAC population cohorts together with extreme-phenotype (severe obesity) and rare-disease collections; its purpose is disease in general rather than one disease or disease family, so it is treated as a broad-purpose aggregation.

label: UK10K Rare Neuromuscular Disorders cohort
note: Patients with rare neuromuscular disorders contributed to the rare-disease arm of UK10K for exome and genome sequencing; a patient collection with no exposure basis.

label: University of Washington ovarian carcinoma cohort
note: Series of 56 patients with primary treatment-naive ovarian carcinoma at the University of Washington whose tumours were RNA sequenced; a patient series with no exposure basis.

label: UPTIDER
note: Post-mortem tissue donation programme at UZ Leuven for women with metastatic breast cancer; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: VIVO Biobank
note: UK biobank of pathological samples from over 600 patients with rhabdomyosarcoma and other childhood cancers, sequenced to find risk biomarkers; a patient biobank with no exposure basis.

label: West Coast Prostate Cancer Dream Team
note: Patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer whose metastasis biopsies and plasma were collected by the West Coast Dream Team for sequencing; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Ankylosing Spondylitis
note: WTCCC collection of ankylosing spondylitis cases from the UK analysed against population controls; the cases of a case-control study, with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Autoimmune Thyroid Disease
note: WTCCC collection of autoimmune thyroid disease cases from the UK analysed against population controls; the cases of a case-control study, with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Bipolar Disorder
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Bipolar disorder (BD) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service collections as controls.
note: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's UK collection of bipolar disorder cases, analysed against 1958 Birth Cohort and blood-donor controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Breast cancer
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Breast cancer (BC) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort collection as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of breast cancer cases, analysed against 1958 Birth Cohort controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Coronary Artery Disease
quote: EGAD00000000004 WTCCC1 project Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) samples
note: The WTCCC UK collection of coronary artery disease cases, analysed against 1958 Birth Cohort and blood-donor controls; the EGA study text mislabels the disease as 'Bipolar disorder (CAD)', so the dataset description is quoted. No exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Hypertension
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Hypertension (HT) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service collections as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of hypertension cases (from the British Genetics of Hypertension study), analysed against population and blood-donor controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Inflammatory Bowel Disease
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service collections as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's disease) cases, analysed against population and blood-donor controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Multiple Sclerosis
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Multiple Sclerosis (MS) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort collection as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of multiple sclerosis cases, analysed against 1958 Birth Cohort controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Rheumatoid Arthritis
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service collections as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of rheumatoid arthritis cases, analysed against population and blood-donor controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Tuberculosis
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Tuberculosis (TB) using the African samples as controls.
note: The WTCCC African collection of tuberculosis cases with African controls. Participants were selected as TB cases, a disease, not as people exposed to the agent, so this is a disease cohort and not an exposure cohort.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Type 1 Diabetes
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service collections as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of type 1 diabetes cases, analysed against population and blood-donor controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Type 2 Diabetes
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service collections as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of type 2 diabetes cases, analysed against population and blood-donor controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: Charles F. and Joanne Knight Alzheimer Disease Research Center
quote: Out of the 6,625 Knight-ADRC participants (Table 1) recruited during the last 30 years, 2,746 of them are classified at the last assessment as AD (with 29 of them being Autosomal Dominant AD), 2,369 are considered cognitively unimpaired, and 1,510 are considered to suffer from other dementias (1,285 AD Related Dementias (ADRD), 153 FTD, and 72 DLB - Table 1.
note: The Washington University Alzheimer Disease Research Center's volunteer cohort: people with Alzheimer disease or related dementias and cognitively unimpaired controls followed for onset, recruited through the Memory and Aging Project and Memory Diagnostic Clinic for Alzheimer disease research. A disease research cohort (cases with controls), not an exposure cohort.

label: Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
quote: A total of 819 subjects (229 cognitively normal, 398 with MCI, and 192 with AD) were enrolled at baseline and followed for 12 months using standard cognitive and functional measures typical of clinical trials.
note: A multi-site longitudinal cohort of people with mild Alzheimer disease or mild cognitive impairment and cognitively normal controls, enrolled to evaluate imaging and fluid biomarkers of Alzheimer disease progression. A disease cohort with controls; nothing about exposures.

label: Dominantly Inherited Alzheimer Network
quote: DIAN collects comprehensive information and tissue in accordance with standard protocols from asymptomatic and symptomatic ADAD mutation carriers and their non-carrier family members to determine the pathochronology of clinical, cognitive, neuroimaging, and fluid biomarkers of AD.
note: An international cohort of families with autosomal dominant Alzheimer disease mutations: asymptomatic and symptomatic mutation carriers and their non-carrier relatives, selected for their genetic risk of the disease. The selection basis is mutation carriage in a family, so 'at risk'; a genotype is not an environmental exposure.

label: Barcelona-1
quote: Barcelona -1 is a longitudinal observational study consisting of ~300 subjects at baseline carried out in the Memory and Disorder unit at the University Hospital Mutua de Terrassa, Terrassa, Barcelona, Spain.
note: A memory-clinic cohort from the Memory Disorders Unit of Hospital Mutua de Terrassa; the same paper describes its cases as sporadic AD cases with most other subjects carrying other diagnoses, and the definition names Alzheimer disease dementia, other dementias, MCI and subjective memory complaints. Patients of a memory clinic, so a disease cohort; no exposure basis.

label: Stockholm-Tartu Atherosclerosis Reverse Networks Engineering Task
quote: Coronary artery disease (CAD) patients eligible for coronary artery by-pass grafting (CABG) surgery (n = 200) and controls eligible for other open-heart surgeries (e.g. valve replacement, n = 84), verified to be CAD-free in pre-operative coronary angiograms, were enrolled at the Department of Cardiac Surgery, Tartu University Hospital.
note: Coronary artery disease patients undergoing bypass surgery at Tartu University Hospital, with CAD-free open-heart-surgery comparators, whose tissues were profiled to study cardiometabolic gene regulation. A patient series; no exposure basis.

label: Million Veteran Program
exposures: military service
quote: We present genome-wide associations for 2068 traits from 635,969 participants in the Department of Veterans Affairs Million Veteran Program, a longitudinal study of diverse United States Veterans.
note: A mega-biobank of United States military veterans enrolled through VA health care to study genetic influences on health and disease broadly. Every participant is a veteran, which the guidance counts as a war-or-military exposure basis, but the cached sources give no exposure-focused design purpose and the cohort is not built around a deployment, so the exposure verdict is borderline. No single disease: a general biobank.

label: Chinese Imaging Genetics study
exposure categories: air pollution | climate or weather | built environment
exposures: climate | air pollution | urbanization | population density | green space
quote: In addition to micro-environmental measurements, this study also collects hundreds of quantitative macro-environmental measurements from remote sensing and national survey databases based on the locations of each participant from birth to present, which will facilitate discoveries of new environmental factors associated with neuroimaging phenotypes.
note: A neuroimaging genetics cohort of healthy young Chinese Han adults whose stated aim is genetic and environmental factors and their interactions on brain phenotypes, with lifelong macro-environmental exposures (climate, air pollution, urbanization, population density, green space) derived from remote sensing and survey data for each participant's residences. Environment is half of the design, so an exposure cohort of medium confidence; healthy volunteers, so not a disease cohort.

label: African American Study of Kidney Disease and Hypertension
quote: Participants include African-American men and women aged 18 to 70 yr who have hypertensive kidney disease and GFR between 20 and 65 ml/min per 1.73 m(2).
note: African American adults with hypertensive chronic kidney disease enrolled in a randomized trial of antihypertensive regimens and blood-pressure goals, then followed in a cohort study of kidney disease progression. Patients with the disease; drug treatment is not an environmental exposure.

label: Amsterdam Dementia Cohort
quote: The ADC started collecting samples in the year 2000 and is an ongoing, observational follow-up study of patients who visited the memory clinic of the Alzheimer Center at Amsterdam UMC, location VU University medical center (VUmc).
note: All patients who visited the memory clinic of the Alzheimer Center Amsterdam since 2000, followed for research on early diagnosis, heterogeneity and vascular factors in dementia. A memory-clinic patient series; no exposure basis.

label: Protein Aggregation and Neurotransmitter Deficits Study
quote: The purpose of this study is to understand the role of brain proteins and neurotransmitters in the symptoms of PD compared to healthy aging.
note: A Washington University movement-disorders study following people with Parkinson disease and healthy older controls with imaging, motor and cognitive testing to relate brain proteins and neurotransmitters to PD symptoms. A disease cohort with controls; no exposure basis.

label: Protein and Imaging Biomarkers of Parkinson Disease Study
quote: The purpose of this study is to understand the relationship between clinical symptoms and brain changes in people with PD as compared to healthy aging.
note: A Washington University movement-disorders study following people with Parkinson disease and healthy older controls with MRI, PET and clinical testing. A disease cohort with controls; no exposure basis.

label: BioBank Japan
quote: The BBJ is a registry of patients diagnosed with any of 47 target common diseases.
note: A patient-based biobank: every participant was enrolled at a hospital as a patient with one of 47 (later 51) target common diseases, which the source contrasts with population-based biobanks. Participants are selected for having a disease, so 'patients', but the disease list is broad (cancers, cardiometabolic, respiratory and other diseases), which puts it close to the broad-purpose exclusion; no exposure basis.

label: Age, Gene/Environment Susceptibility-Reykjavik Study
quote: The AGES-Reykjavik sample is drawn from an established population-based cohort, the Reykjavik Study.
note: A population-based cohort of older Icelanders drawn from the Reykjavik Study, phenotyped across cardiovascular, neurocognitive, musculoskeletal and metabolic systems to study disease and disability in old age. 'Gene/Environment' in the name refers to risk factors and gene-environment interaction in general, not to a defined exposure or an exposure-measurement design; the purpose spans many diseases, so not a disease cohort.

label: Stanford Alzheimer's Disease Research Center
quote: The SADRC cohort is a longitudinal observational study of clinical dementia subjects and age-sex-matched non-demented subjects.
note: The Stanford Alzheimer's Disease Research Center's observational cohort of people with Alzheimer disease, Lewy body disorders or mild cognitive impairment and matched non-demented controls, focused on Alzheimer disease and Lewy body disorders. A disease cohort with controls; no exposure basis.

label: Canadian Longitudinal Study on Aging
quote: The CLSA recruited participants between 2010 and 2015 who were between the ages of 45–85 years to investigate social, environmental, and other factors that affect aging and disease.
note: A national stratified sample of 51,338 Canadians aged 45-85 assembled as a longitudinal platform for research on health and aging. A general population cohort with a broad purpose: 'environmental' factors are one of many measured, not a design purpose, and no single disease is studied.

label: Jackson Heart Study
quote: JHS is a prospective population-based observational study designed to investigate risk factors for cardiovascular disease (CVD) in Black individuals.
note: Community-based cohort of African American adults in Jackson, Mississippi, designed to investigate risk factors for cardiovascular disease: a population study of one disease family, with no exposure-based selection or purpose.

label: UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project
quote: The UKB Pharma Plasma Proteome (UKB-PPP) cohort comprises plasma samples from 54,219 individuals, including 46,595 randomly selected participants, 6,376 consortium-chosen individuals and 1,268 participants from a COVID-19 repeat imaging study.
note: A mostly random sub-sample of UK Biobank participants profiled for plasma proteomics to map pQTLs; a general population biobank subset with no exposure or disease selection.

label: Mass General Brigham Biobank
quote: It collects biological samples and health data from consenting individuals at Massachusetts General Hospital, Brigham and Women’s Hospital, and local healthcare sites within the MGB network66.
note: Healthcare-system biobank of consenting patients across the Mass General Brigham network, not selected for any disease; its interest in environmental context is geospatial and socioeconomic rather than a designed exposure study.

label: Cardiovascular Health Study
quote: Eligible participants were sampled from Medicare eligibility lists in each area.
note: Population-based cohort of older adults sampled from Medicare lists in four US communities whose stated objective is the onset and course of coronary heart disease and stroke; no exposure-based design.

label: Framingham Heart Study
quote: Framingham Heart Study, which is a longitudinal, multi-generational community-based cohort based in Framingham, Massachusetts, USA.
note: Community-based multi-generational cohort of Framingham residents conceived and designed to study the epidemiology of cardiovascular disease, the archetypal population study of one disease family; no exposure-based design.

label: Rhineland Study
quote: We used data from the Rhineland Study, an ongoing population-based cohort study in Bonn, Germany, to perform a GWAS on circulating complex lipid levels and composition measured using the Metabolon Complex Lipids Platform.
note: Population-based cohort of Bonn residents aged 30 and over, run by DZNE, whose stated aim is what keeps people healthy or makes them resistant to disease in general, with neurodegenerative and age-related diseases named as one interest: a broad health-and-ageing purpose, not one disease and not an exposure design.

label: European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition-Potsdam
exposures: diet | nutritional status | lifestyle and environmental factors
quote: EPIC was developed to examine the relationships between diet, nutritional status, lifestyle and environmental factors, as well as the incidence of cancer and other chronic diseases lilke type 2 diabetes.
note: The Potsdam centre of EPIC, a population-based diet-and-cancer cohort in which initially healthy adults are examined for exposure characteristics such as nutritional behaviour; cancer is the disease the cohort was set up for, though the stated purpose extends to other chronic diseases such as type 2 diabetes, hence medium confidence on the disease verdict.

label: Hispanic Community Health Study/Study of Latinos
quote: The HCHS/SOL will recruit 16,000 men and women who self-identify as Hispanic or Latino, 18 to 74 years of age, from a random sample of households in defined communities in the Bronx, Chicago, Miami, and San Diego.
note: Community-based cohort drawn by random household sampling of Hispanic/Latino adults in four US cities, studying heart, lung, blood, sleep, kidney, liver, diabetes, cognitive, dental and hearing conditions together with immigration and acculturation: a broad multi-disease purpose, not an exposure design.

label: Busselton Health Study
quote: The BHS is a community-based study in Western Australia that includes both related and unrelated individuals (predominantly of European ancestry) and has been described in more detail elsewhere46–48.
note: Community-based survey of residents of Busselton, Western Australia, run since 1966 and used for cardiovascular, respiratory, metabolic and ageing research: a general population cohort with no single disease or exposure purpose.

label: Swedish Infrastructure for Medical Population-Based Life-Course and Environmental Research
exposures: dietary and lifestyle factors
quote: SIMPLER is an infrastructure with the purpose of providing national and international researchers with data for research about dietary and lifestyle factors as well as genetics, and how they affect our health, particularly in the latter part of life.
note: Research infrastructure combining two population-based Swedish cohorts (COSM and SMC) whose stated purpose is research on dietary and lifestyle factors and genetics in relation to health in later life; the diet-and-lifestyle purpose makes it an exposure-designed aggregation, while its health outcomes are broad rather than one disease.

label: Swedish CArdioPulmonary bioImage Study
quote: SCAPIS is designed as a prospective observational study of a randomly selected sample from the general population.
note: Randomly recruited national population cohort of Swedes aged 50-64 whose stated purpose is cardiopulmonary disease (cardiovascular disease and COPD with related metabolic disorders); treated as a population study of a named disease family rather than a broad chronic-disease cohort, hence medium confidence. No exposure-based design.

label: Malmö Offspring Study
quote: The study participants of MOS consists of invited adult children and grandchildren to participants in the Malmö Diet and Cancer Study—Cardiovascular Cohort (MDCS-CC, n = 6103), which is a random, deeply phenotyped subpopulation of the Malmö Diet and Cancer Study (MDCS) [17].
note: Family-based cohort of the adult children and grandchildren of a random Malmö population sample, mapping risk factors for family traits of chronic diseases in general; diet is one of many measured factors, not the defining or main subject.

label: Metabolic Syndrome in Men Study
quote: The Metabolic Syndrome in Men (METSIM) study is a population-based study including 10,197 Finnish men examined in 2005-2010.
note: Population-based cohort of Finnish men designed to investigate risk factors for type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease, the cardiometabolic disease family its name (Metabolic Syndrome in Men) points to; medium confidence because the purpose spans two related diseases. No exposure-based design.

label: Qatar Genome Program
quote: The QGP is a population-based study designed to perform whole genome sequencing of the Qatar Biobank (QBB) participants9 with the aim to gain insights into the population structure and the genetic architecture of clinically relevant phenotypes in the Middle Eastern Qatari population.
note: National whole-genome sequencing programme of Qatar Biobank volunteers to characterise the Qatari population; a population biobank with no disease or exposure selection.

label: Trøndelag Health Study
quote: In the HUNT Study, all residents aged ≥20 years in the Nord-Trøndelag region, Norway, have been invited to repeated surveys since 1984-86.
note: Total-population health survey of all adult residents of Trøndelag County, Norway, covering a broad range of health topics; a general population cohort with no disease or exposure selection.

label: Simons Foundation Powering Autism Research for Knowledge
note: Nationwide US cohort of individuals with a professional diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder and their family members, built to accelerate autism research; a patient (family-based) disease cohort with no exposure basis.

label: Chronic Renal Insufficiency Cohort Study
note: Multicentre prospective cohort of adults with chronic kidney disease enrolled at seven US clinical centres to study progression of kidney disease and cardiovascular disease; a patient cohort, not exposure-defined.

label: Systematic and Combined Analysis of Olink Proteins
quote: Each SCALLOP member works on human study collections from the general population, clinical trials or patients with certain diseases such as coronary artery disease, rheumatoid arthritis, bipolar disease, heart failure, dementias or metabolic syndrome.
note: Consortium pooling Olink proteomics and genotype data from general population cohorts, clinical trials and patient collections of many unrelated diseases to map pQTLs; it collects no single disease and no exposure-based cohorts.

label: China Medical University Hospital Biobank
quote: The study participants were part of the China Medical University Hospital (CMUH) Precision Medicine Project, a systemic effort initiated in 2018 to recruit subjects and collect biospecimens from all patients who come to CMUH for medical visits [69,70].
note: Hospital-based biobank recruiting all patients attending China Medical University Hospital, Taichung, for medical visits, used for GWAS and PheWAS across hundreds of traits; unselected for any disease or exposure.

label: Religious Orders Study and Rush Memory and Aging Project
note: Pair of volunteer cohorts of older adults enrolled without dementia, with annual evaluation and brain donation, whose stated purpose is Alzheimer's disease; a cohort set up to study one disease, not exposure-based.

label: Mayo Clinic Biobank
quote: Participants were all Mayo Clinic patients, 18 years of age or older and US residents.
note: Clinic-based biobank of unselected adult Mayo Clinic patients established to supply controls for case-control studies and a prospective cohort for common outcomes; no disease or exposure selection.

label: HOLBAEK Study
note: Danish childhood obesity biobank combining an obesity clinic cohort of children and adolescents in treatment with a population-based reference cohort; obesity counts as a disease, so a patient cohort with controls, not exposure-based.

label: FinnGen
quote: The FinnGen study (https://www.finngen.fi/en) is an ongoing research project that utilizes samples from a nationwide network of Finnish biobanks and digital healthcare data from national health registers.
note: Nationwide Finnish biobank-plus-register study of about 500,000 people studying thousands of disease endpoints; hospital-based recruitment enriches it for disease in general but it is selected for no single disease and no exposure.

label: NIHR BioResource Rare Diseases Study
