note: Definition only: a Leipzig sample of about 900 adults with a mean BMI of 35 to 38 collected through the IFB AdiposityDiseases and the German Obesity Biomaterial Bank for obesity-trait consortia, i.e. an obesity patient sample; the cached papers give only funding acknowledgments (SFB-1052 Obesity mechanisms), no recruitment description. No exposure.

label: Swiss Study on Air Pollution and Lung Diseases in Adults
exposures: long-term exposure to air pollution | nitrogen dioxide (NO2), sulphur dioxide (SO2), ozone (O3) and particulates in ambient air
quote: The Swiss Cohort Study on Air Pollution and Lung Diseases in Adults (SAPALDIA) was designed to investigate the health effects from long-term exposure to air pollution.
note: Population-based Swiss cohort designed to measure the health effects of long-term air pollution, with monitored NO2, SO2, O3 and particulates and GIS exposure estimates: an air-pollution cohort; its stated aim is the prevalence and determinants of asthma, chronic bronchitis and allergic conditions in adults, one disease family, so also a population study of lung disease.

label: Bunkyo Health Study
quote: Bunkyo Health Study is a prospective cohort study of over 10 years21, which recruited older subjects aged 65–84 years living in Bunkyo-Ku, an urban area in Tokyo, Japan.
note: Probability sample of community-dwelling older residents of a Tokyo ward followed for muscle function, metabolic health and need for long-term care: a general ageing cohort, not selected for or aimed at one disease and without an exposure focus.

label: Shimane CoHRE Study
quote: The Shimane CoHRE study conducted by Shimane University in Japan worked in collaboration with Okinoshima town in the Shimane prefecture to identify potential factors of healthy aging among rural residents.
note: Community health-examination cohort of rural older adults in Shimane Prefecture run for healthy ageing and chronic disease in general; no exposure or single disease defines it.

label: Fangchenggang Area Male Health and Examination Survey
quote: Briefly, the FAMHES was a population-based study conducted among non-institutionalized Chinese men aging from 17 to 88 years old in Guangxi, China.
note: Population-based survey of men attending routine physical examinations in Fangchenggang, designed for environmental and genetic factors in age-related chronic diseases in general; environment is a generic aim (serum metal levels were later used as GWAS phenotypes) rather than a defining exposure, and the disease aim is broad.

label: Italian Network of Genetic Isolates - Friuli Venezia Giulia
quote: INGI-FVG - INGI-Friuli Venezia Giulia The INGI-FVG cohort consisted of about 1700 subjects drawn from the project “Genetic Park of Friuli Venezia Giulia”.
note: Population-based genetic isolate cohort of six villages in Friuli Venezia Giulia, studied for complex traits in general; neither an exposure nor a disease defines it.

label: Osteoarthritis Initiative
quote: The Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI) is a prospective longitudinal study designed to identify risk factors for the incidence and progression of symptomatic tibiofemoral knee osteoarthritis.
note: Multicentre observational study of knee osteoarthritis enrolling an incidence subcohort selected for increased risk (the majority), a progression subcohort with symptomatic knee OA and a small reference group, so an at-risk cohort that also holds patients; no exposure defines it.

label: SWOG Cancer Research Network
quote: SELECT was coordinated by SWOG, a national consortium of institutions and investigators that conducts multidisciplinary clinical trials to improve the practice of medicine in preventing, detecting, and treating cancer, and to enhance the quality of life for cancer survivors.
note: NCI cancer clinical trials network (aggregation) whose trial cohorts are cancer treatment trials of cancer patients (e.g. CALGB/SWOG 80405 in metastatic colorectal cancer) and cancer prevention trials of men at risk (SELECT, PCPT); classified by what it collects as a cancer patient aggregation. No exposure focus.

label: Leeds Colorectal Cancer Study
exposures: heterocyclic amines from meat cooked at high temperatures | meat intake | cigarette smoking
quote: carcinogenic heterocyclic amines (HA), which are produced by meat cooked at high temperatures and are found in cigarette smoke. A study of 500 incident colorectal cancer cases and population controls, matched for age, sex and general practitioner, was conducted in the UK to investigate this hypothesis.
note: Population-based colorectal cancer case-control study (Leeds, Dundee, York) whose founding paper says it was conducted to test the meat- and smoking-derived heterocyclic amine / NAT2 hypothesis, with detailed diet (an EPIC-modelled food frequency questionnaire) and smoking interviews and Food Standards Agency funding: cases make it a disease cohort and diet and tobacco are its stated design subject; medium because later uses treat it as a general CRC case-control set.

label: North Carolina Colon Cancer Study
quote: The North Carolina Colon Cancer Studies I and II (NCCCS I and NCCCS II) were population-based case-control studies conducted in 33 counties of North Carolina.
note: Population-based case-control studies of colon (phase I) and distal colorectal (phase II) cancer in North Carolina with oversampled African Americans; the cases make it a disease cohort. Diet and medication were collected as risk factors among others, with no stated exposure design purpose.

label: Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta-Carotene Cancer Prevention Study
exposures: cigarette smoking
quote: Briefly, ATBC was a randomized placebo‐controlled trial (NCT00342992 clinicaltrials.gov) examining α‐tocopherol and/or β‐carotene for primary prevention of lung and other cancers in 29,133 male Finnish smokers, aged 50–69 years at recruitment between 1985 and 1988.
note: Finnish prevention trial that enrolled 29,133 male smokers, later followed as a cohort: recruited as smokers, so an exposure-defined cohort, and selected for their smoking-related risk of lung and other cancers, so at risk. The supplements are an intervention, not an exposure.

label: Growth and Obesity Chilean Cohort Study
note: Definition and name only: a longitudinal cohort of Santiago children recruited at age 3.5 from childcare centres and followed into adolescence to study growth, puberty and obesity; the cached paper describes only the recruitment, not the purpose, so the obesity aim rests on the cohort's name and definition. No exposure focus.

label: Health Examinees Study
quote: HEXA cohort was initiated in 2004 to identify environmental and genetic risk factors for major chronic diseases in Koreans, targeting men and women over 40 years of age who visited medical examination centers in urban areas.
note: Large population-based KoGES cohort of health examinees recruited for environmental and genetic risk factors of major chronic diseases in general: a broad-purpose population cohort, with environment only as a generic aim.

label: Newfoundland Colorectal Cancer Registry
quote: In order to investigate the factors, especially genetic components, responsible for CRC we established the Newfoundland Colorectal Cancer Registry.
note: Population-based registry of colorectal cancer patients diagnosed under 75 in Newfoundland and Labrador, followed for survival, with population controls added for case-control analyses; a patient registry. Smoking was analysed as a risk factor but does not define the cohort.

label: Toshiba cohort
quote: This study was conducted at Toshiba Corp, an electronics manufacturer in Japan.
note: Corporate genome cohort of consenting Toshiba employees with health check-up and questionnaire data, used for vaccine side-effect GWAS and a salt-reduction trial; the workplace is a recruitment setting, not an occupational hazard, and no disease selects the participants.

label: Women's Health Initiative Memory Study
quote: WHIMS, an ancillary study of the WHI Hormone Trials, was designed to investigate the effects of hormone therapy (conjugated equine estrogens (CEE) alone vs. placebo or CEE plus medroxyprogesterone [E + P] acetate vs. placebo) on cognitive outcomes among 7479 women aged 65–80 years recruited from 39 clinical sites across the United States who were cognitively unimpaired at randomization (1996–1999)
note: Ancillary trial of the WHI hormone trials in cognitively unimpaired older women, designed to test hormone therapy against incident mild cognitive impairment and probable dementia, so a population study of dementia; medium because the COHO term is the WHIMS+ genotyping set, which adds other hormone-trial women to represent the whole trial population. Hormone therapy is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: WHI SNP Health Association Resource
quote: the WHI SNP Health Association Resource (WHI SHARe), a randomly selected sample of 8,515 African American and 3,642 Hispanic women from WHI.
note: Randomly selected African American and Hispanic women from the Women's Health Initiative genotyped under the NHLBI SHARe project: a general population sample, defined by neither exposure nor disease.

label: Isle of Wight Whole Population Birth Cohort
quote: Parental consent was obtained from 1456 of the 1536 children for inclusion into a longitudinal study of asthma and allergic disease (Figure 1).
note: Whole-population birth cohort of the Isle of Wight established to measure the prevalence, natural history and risk factors of asthma and allergic diseases from infancy to adulthood: an unselected birth cohort with one disease family as its purpose. Environmental risk factors (smoking, pets) are one of several aims, not the design centre.

label: Starr County Health Studies
quote: To assess the prevalence and morbidity of noninsulin-dependent diabetes mellitus among Mexican Americans, 14% of the Starr County, Texas, population (97% Mexican-American) was randomly sampled.
note: Programme of studies of type 2 diabetes among Mexican Americans in Starr County, Texas, built on a random population sample and later diabetes case-control collections and household surveys; a population study of one disease that also holds diabetes patients. No exposure focus.

label: International Multicentre ADHD Genetics project
note: European multi-site family sample of children with DSM-IV combined-type ADHD, their siblings and parents, collected for molecular genetic studies of ADHD; a patient (proband-family) cohort, with no exposure basis.

label: Family Blood Pressure Program
note: NHLBI programme pooling four family networks recruited mainly through hypertensive probands to study the genetic determinants of blood pressure and hypertension; the families contain both hypertensive probands and their relatives, so the disease role is patients (with at-risk relatives). No exposure basis.

label: Women's Health Study
quote: The Women’s Health Study (WHS) was a randomized, double-blind, clinical trial of low-dose aspirin and vitamin E in the primary prevention of CVD and cancer among 39,876 apparently healthy women age ≥45 years.
note: Primary-prevention trial of aspirin and vitamin E in apparently healthy female health professionals, followed as a cohort for CVD, cancer and other incident disease; healthy volunteers with a broad two-disease-family purpose, so not a disease cohort, and the only exposures are the trial medications.

label: Genetics and Epidemiology of Colorectal Cancer Consortium
note: International consortium pooling colorectal cancer case-control, cohort and trial studies (cases and controls) to find genetic risk factors and gene-environment interactions for colorectal cancer; classified by what it collects. Gene-environment work does not make it an exposure cohort.

label: Prostate Cancer Association Group to Investigate Cancer-Associated Alterations in the Genome
note: Consortium of prostate cancer case-control and cohort study groups pooling cases and controls to study inherited susceptibility to prostate cancer; no exposure basis.

label: Singapore Multi-Ethnic Cohort
quote: The Multi-Ethnic Cohort (MEC) Study is a population-based study in Singapore (n=14 530) with recruitment conducted between 2004 and 2010.
note: Population-based cohort of Singapore residents of three ethnic groups, free of major disease at recruitment, for chronic disease research broadly; neither an exposure nor a disease cohort.

label: ADDITION-Denmark
note: Danish arm of ADDITION-Europe: general-practice populations were screened and those with screen-detected type 2 diabetes were cluster-randomised to routine or intensive treatment and followed for CVD and death; a trial cohort of patients with the condition. No exposure basis.

label: Anglo-Danish-Dutch Study of Intensive Treatment in People with Screen Detected Diabetes in Primary Care
note: Cluster-randomised trial in Denmark, the Netherlands and the UK of intensive multifactorial treatment in 3,057 people with screen-detected type 2 diabetes; a trial cohort of patients. No exposure basis.

label: Montreal Heart Institute Biobank
note: Hospital-based biobank of patients of the Montreal Heart Institute, a cardiology hospital, so the participants are cardiology patients enriched for cardiovascular disease rather than all confirmed cases; the sources call them patients. No exposure basis.

label: Exeter Family Study of Childhood Health
quote: We recruited 1017 families from a postcode-defined area in central Exeter. Specific inclusion criteria were established to obtain a homogeneous, non-diabetic, UK Caucasian cohort.
note: Prospective family study of parents and children from a postcode-defined area of Exeter, deliberately non-diabetic and disease-free, set up to test the fetal insulin hypothesis and study birthweight and early growth; a birth cohort about growth, not disease or exposure.

label: Global Lipids Genetics Consortium
note: Consortium meta-analysing GWAS of blood lipid levels across some 200 mostly population studies; blood lipids are a quantitative trait rather than a disease, and the member studies are not selected by exposure.

label: Molecular Epidemiology of Colorectal Cancer Study
note: Population-based case-control study of incident colorectal cancer in northern Israel; the cases of a case-control study make it a patient cohort. Environmental risk factors are studied but do not define the cohort.

label: Nurses' Health Study II
quote: Started in 1989, NHSII recruited 116,429 female registered nurses ages 25–42 from 14 states with large numbers of registered nurses.
note: Prospective cohort of female registered nurses recruited for chronic-disease epidemiology in women; nurses were chosen as reliable reporters, not for an occupational hazard, and the many exposure analyses (aircraft noise, diet) are among many variables rather than the design purpose. Broad chronic-disease remit, so not a disease cohort.

label: National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism cohort
quote: The sample consisted of 119 European American (EA) and 82 African American (AA) healthy controls that were recruited at the National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism (NIAAA) at the National Institutes of Health (NIH), USA.
note: Sample of healthy controls recruited at NIAAA who did not meet criteria for alcohol dependence or other major psychiatric disorders; healthy volunteers, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort despite the institute's name.

label: Southern Community Cohort Study
note: Prospective cohort of predominantly Black, low-income adults in the southeastern US, NCI-funded and designed to address racial disparities in cancer, though it is also used for other chronic diseases; a general-population cohort whose stated purpose is one disease family. Low income by itself is not an exposure.

label: Taiwan Precision Medicine Initiative
quote: Here we present the Taiwan Precision Medicine Initiative (TPMI), established by Academia Sinica in collaboration with 16 major medical centres around Taiwan, which has recruited 565,390 participants who consent to provide DNA samples for genetic profiling and grant access to their electronic medical records (EMRs) for research.
note: Hospital-based precision-medicine cohort of 565,390 unselected Taiwanese participants with genotypes linked to electronic medical records for common-disease and pharmacogenetic research; a biobank with a broad remit, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: Baependi Heart Study
note: Family-based cohort of residents of a rural Brazilian town set up, Framingham-like, to study genetic and environmental influences on cardiovascular disease risk factors, later broadened to sleep and mental health; a population study of one disease family. 'Environmental influences' are mentioned only in passing.

label: Born in Guangzhou Cohort Study
quote: The Born in Guangzhou Cohort Study (BIGCS) is a large-scale prospective observational study investigating the role of social, biological and environmental influences on pregnancy and child health and development in an urban setting in southern China.
note: General birth cohort of pregnant women and their children in Guangzhou studying social, biological and environmental influences on pregnancy and child health and development; environment is one of three broad themes rather than the design purpose, and the cohort is about development, not disease.

label: Genetics, Osteoarthritis and Progression Study
note: Dutch sibling-pair cohort of patients with symptomatic osteoarthritis at multiple joint sites recruited from clinics around Leiden to study osteoarthritis susceptibility and progression; a patient cohort. No exposure basis.

label: Physicians' Health Study
quote: PHS I was initiated in 1982 and was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of 22,071 US male physicians aged 40–84 years aimed at evaluating the impact of aspirin and beta-carotene on cardiovascular disease (CVD) and cancer outcomes, respectively [22].
note: Primary-prevention trials of aspirin, beta-carotene and vitamins in healthy US male physicians, followed as a cohort for CVD and cancer; healthy volunteers with a two-disease-family prevention purpose, so not a disease cohort, and the only exposures are the trial supplements.

label: Trinity Student Study
quote: Samples were collected as part of the Trinity Student Study (TSS), in which a cohort of healthy young adults (aged 18–28 y) were recruited at Trinity College Dublin over a 1-y period (2003–2004), as described previously (36–38).
note: Cohort of about 2,000 healthy young adult students recruited at Trinity College Dublin for genetic studies of circulating metabolites; healthy volunteers, no disease or exposure basis.

label: Yale-Penn study
note: Sample recruited through treatment centres and advertisements for genetic studies of cocaine, opioid and alcohol dependence; addiction counts as a disease and the selection is by DSM-IV dependence diagnosis, not by substance exposure, so it is a patient cohort rather than an exposure cohort.

label: Cardiovascular Disease Association Study
note: Population-based rural cohort of the Korean Genome and Epidemiology Study whose name and stated purpose are cardiovascular disease, though KoGES uses it for chronic disease generally; a general-population cohort set up for one disease family. No exposure basis.

label: China Health and Nutrition Survey
exposures: diet | physical activity
quote: The CHNS was designed to provide representation of rural, urban, and suburban areas varying substantially in geography, economic development, public resources, and health indicators with a focus on examining household- and individual-level sociodemographic factors, diet, physical activity, health, and behavior changes relative to community-level urbanicity and social, and economic change.
note: Longitudinal household survey across Chinese provinces, the first to collect individual dietary intake in China, built around diet, physical activity and other health behaviours as social and economic conditions change; diet and activity are its main subject, so it is an exposure (lifestyle) cohort, but it has no disease focus.

label: 300-Obese
note: Cohort of about 300 overweight or obese adults (BMI 27 or more) enrolled in Nijmegen to study inflammation and cardiovascular disease pathways in obesity; obesity counts as a disease and participants were selected for it. No exposure basis.

label: Anti-Amyloid Treatment in Asymptomatic Alzheimer's Disease Study
note: A secondary-prevention trial that screened cognitively normal older adults with amyloid PET and enrolled those with elevated brain amyloid (preclinical Alzheimer's disease), so the participants were selected for their risk of Alzheimer's disease; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Child and Adolescent Twin Study in Sweden
quote: The Child and Adolescent Twin Study in Sweden (CATSS) is an ongoing longitudinal twin study targeting all twins born in Sweden since July 1, 1992.
note: A population twin cohort of all Swedish twins born since 1992 whose design centres on childhood mental health: screening for autism, ADHD, tic, conduct, obsessive-compulsive and eating disorders with clinical follow-up of screen-positive pairs, so it is a population study of one disease family (mental disorders) rather than a plain twin registry; the 'social environment' it records is not an environmental exposure in scope.

label: CLUE II
quote: At the baseline visit (1989 for CLUE II), brief medical histories, blood pressure readings, and blood samples were collected on 32,894 participants (25,076 of which were residents of Washington County).
note: A community-based volunteer cohort of Washington County residents set up as a campaign against cancer and heart disease, two disease families rather than one, so it is treated as a general population cohort with a broad chronic-disease purpose; exposures such as diet are measured among many variables, not as the design purpose.

label: Genetic Regulation of Arterial Pressure in Humans in the Community Study
quote: The discovery cohort - Genetic Regulation of Arterial Pressure of Humans in the Community (GRAPHIC) Study consists of 2037 subjects from 520 white British pedigrees recruited from the general population in Leicestershire (UK)
note: Nuclear families recruited from the general population through general practices to study the genetic regulation of blood pressure, a quantitative trait rather than a disease; no exposure enters the design.

label: Monongahela-Youghiogheny Healthy Aging Team
quote: MYHAT is an ongoing population‐based study that recruited 1982 individuals aged ≥ 65 from southwestern Pennsylvania by age‐stratified random sampling from electoral rolls.
note: A population-based random sample of adults aged 65 and over followed with cognitive assessments and CDR-based MCI/dementia staging; the available text (PMID:40042063) states no purpose beyond longitudinal cognitive assessment, so whether MYHAT is a population study of dementia/MCI or a cohort of cognitive ageing generally cannot be settled from the cached sources; the definition's 'dementia' is not supported by a quotable statement. Not an exposure cohort.

label: Utah residents (CEPH) with Northern and Western European ancestry
quote: These included all HapMap Phase I and II samples, along with further samples from the same four populations: individuals from the Centre d’Etude du Polymorphisme Humain collected in Utah, USA, with ancestry from northern and western Europe (CEU); Han Chinese in Beijing, China (CHB); Japanese in Tokyo, Japan (JPT); and Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI).
note: A HapMap/1000 Genomes reference population sample of unselected Utah residents of northern and western European ancestry, held as DNA and cell lines for studies of genetic variation; neither disease nor exposure defines it.

label: Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria
quote: These included all HapMap Phase I and II samples, along with further samples from the same four populations: individuals from the Centre d’Etude du Polymorphisme Humain collected in Utah, USA, with ancestry from northern and western Europe (CEU); Han Chinese in Beijing, China (CHB); Japanese in Tokyo, Japan (JPT); and Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI).
note: A HapMap/1000 Genomes reference population sample of unselected Yoruba people in Ibadan, Nigeria, held as DNA and cell lines for studies of genetic variation; neither disease nor exposure defines it.

label: Copenhagen Prospective Study on Asthma in Childhood
exposures: indoor and outdoor air quality | allergens | the child's diet | respiratory, intestinal, and skin microbiology | indicators of lifestyle
quote: Exposure assessments comprise respiratory, intestinal, and skin microbiology; the child's diet; indoor and outdoor air quality; allergens; and indicators of lifestyle.
note: A clinical birth cohort of 411 children of asthmatic mothers, i.e. children at high risk of asthma and other atopic diseases, whose stated objective is the interplay of genetic, environmental and lifestyle factors with scheduled exposure assessments (air quality, allergens, diet, microbiology), so it is designed to study exposures as well as being an at-risk disease cohort; the exposure verdict is a judgement on design emphasis rather than an exposure-defined recruitment.

label: DemGene network
note: A Norwegian network of memory-clinic sites collecting Alzheimer's disease dementia cases (with controls) for genetic studies, so an aggregation of patient collections; no exposure component.

label: Diabetes Genetics Replication and Meta-analysis Consortium
note: A consortium of type 2 diabetes case-control genome-wide association studies, so it collects patient (case) collections with controls; no exposure component.

label: Determining the Influence of Susceptibility COnveying Variants Related to one-Year mortality after BMT
note: Patients with AML, MDS or ALL who received an unrelated-donor transplant, together with their healthy donors, assembled for survival genetics; the transplant is a medical procedure, not an environmental exposure.

label: European Alzheimer's Disease Initiative
note: A French Alzheimer's disease case-control genome-wide association dataset (one of the IGAP founding datasets), so an aggregation of patient collections; no exposure component.

label: EPICURE Consortium
note: A European epilepsy research consortium whose EPICURE cohort of people with genetic generalised epilepsy supplied cases to the ILAE epilepsy GWAS meta-analyses, so an aggregation of patient collections; the project's therapeutic aims involve no environmental exposure.

label: GenEpA Consortium
note: GlaxoSmithKline-funded collections of people with epilepsy and controls from Finland, Norway, Switzerland and Austria that contributed cases to the partial-epilepsy GWAS (3445 patients and 6935 controls) and the ILAE meta-analyses, whose abstract describes the 12 contributing studies as cohorts of individuals with epilepsy; no exposure component.

label: Genetic and Environmental Risk in Alzheimer's Disease Consortium
note: A Cardiff-led consortium assembling Alzheimer's disease cases with screened and population controls into a case-control GWAS dataset, so an aggregation of patient collections; despite 'Environmental Risk' in its name the sources describe only a genetic case-control design, not exposure-based recruitment.

label: Genes for Good
quote: Rates of important chronic health indicators are consistent with those estimated for the general U.S. population using more traditional study designs.
note: A general-public genetics study recruiting volunteers from all US states through a Facebook application, with health rates matching the general population; neither disease nor exposure selects the participants.

label: Imperial-Liverpool-Melbourne Collaboration
note: A collection of people with epilepsy of British ancestry that contributed cases (1294 in the 2023 ILAE GWAS, 1703 in the 2014 meta-analysis) to the ILAE Consortium on Complex Epilepsies; no exposure component.

label: San Antonio Family Study
quote: The SAFHS began in 1991 with 40- to 60-year-old low-income Mexican Americans, selected at random without regard to presence or absence of disease, who were almost exclusively from Mexican American census tracts in San Antonio, Texas [1].
note: Two merged Mexican American family studies: SAFHS families of randomly ascertained probands and SAFDGS families of probands with type 2 diabetes, whose relatives are at familial risk of the disease; the disease verdict rests on the SAFDGS component while the SAFHS half is an unselected population sample. Lifestyle covariates are measured but exposure is not a design purpose.

label: Swedish Adoption/Twin Study of Aging
quote: The SATSA is a twin cohort that aims to understand individual differences in aging.
note: Same-sex twin pairs from the Swedish Twin Registry, including pairs reared apart, followed to study individual differences in ageing and longevity; ageing is not a disease and no exposure defines the cohort.

label: Stroke Genetics Network
note: An NINDS network pooling ischaemic stroke case collections from US, European and Australian centres, with publicly available controls, for GWAS of stroke subtypes, so an aggregation of patient collections; no exposure component.

label: SubPopulations and InteRmediate Outcome Measures in COPD Study
exposures: current and former smokers (≥ 20 pack years)
quote: The SPIROMICS study is a multicenter study that includes current and former smokers (≥ 20 pack years) with or without airflow obstruction and healthy participants who were non-smokers aged 40 to 80 years recruited from 12 clinical sites spread across the United States.
note: An observational COPD cohort recruiting heavy smokers (at least 20 pack-years) with severe or mild/moderate COPD plus smokers without obstruction and a small never-smoker control stratum, so participants are selected as smokers (exposure-defined) and mostly as COPD patients, with the smokers-without-COPD stratum at risk.

label: Veterans Health Service Medical Center cohort
quote: The VHSMC cohort is a hospital-based elderly cohort that includes many patients with various diseases.
note: A hospital-based biobank cohort of older adults at a Seoul veterans' hospital with various diseases, used for body-composition GWAS; no single disease or disease family defines it, and the source describes no military or other exposure as the basis of recruitment.

label: Cervical Artery Dissection and Ischemic Stroke Patients
note: A multinational network of patients with cervical artery dissection, with ischaemic stroke patients of other causes and healthy controls, assembled to find genetic risk factors; environmental factors are studied as covariates of a disease cohort, not as the basis of recruitment.

label: Genetics of Glucose regulation in Gestation and Growth
quote: Between January 2010 and June 2013, we invited pregnant women aged ≥ 18 years old who visited the blood sampling in pregnancy clinic in Sherbrooke for their first trimester clinical blood samples: 1034 women accepted to participate in our cohort study.
note: An unselected prebirth cohort of pregnant women and their children whose stated purpose is impaired glycaemic regulation in pregnancy (gestational diabetes) and its consequences, so a population study of one disease; 'environmental determinants' are mentioned only in passing.

label: Manchester Asthma and Allergy Study
exposures: house dust mite; cat and dog allergens during pregnancy and early life | pet ownership and exposure | endotoxin exposure | thorough dietary questionnaire
quote: Measurements of environmental exposures include levels of house dust mite; cat and dog allergens during pregnancy and early life; pet ownership and exposure; childcare arrangements; number of siblings; vaccination uptake; thorough dietary questionnaire; and endotoxin exposure.
note: A population-based birth cohort recruited antenatally, stratified by parental atopy, to study the development of asthma and allergies in childhood, with defined environmental exposure measurements (allergens, endotoxin, diet) and a randomised allergen-avoidance arm in the high-risk group, so it is a population study of one disease family designed around environmental exposures; the exposure verdict is a judgement on design emphasis.

label: Population Assessment for Tomorrow's Health Study
quote: Participants were from an existing research registry at St. Joseph's Healthcare Hamilton in which community adults were invited to participate in an in‐person assessment including DNA collection.
note: A registry of community volunteers in Hamilton, with or without addiction problems, built expressly for research on the causes, consequences and treatment of addiction disorder, so a population study of one disease family; substance use is measured as an outcome, not the basis of recruitment, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Peking University-University of Michigan Study of Atherosclerosis
quote: The PUUMA study is a prospective observational cohort study of 9,540 participants age ≥40 years at enrollment between December 2011 and April 2012.
note: A community-based cohort of Beijing adults aged 40 and over set up, as its name says, to study atherosclerosis and cardiovascular traits (blood pressure, haematological traits), so a population study of one disease family; no exposure focus.

label: Singapore Chinese Health Study
exposures: diet | environmental determinants of cancer and other chronic diseases
quote: SCHS is a long-term population-based prospective cohort study focused on the dietary, genetic and environmental determinants of cancer and other chronic diseases in Singapore9.
note: A population-based cohort of Singapore Chinese adults built, like EPIC, around dietary and environmental determinants of cancer, so an exposure cohort by design; cancer is its named disease focus, though the source adds 'other chronic diseases' and later work covers healthy ageing, hence medium confidence for the disease verdict.

label: Sister Study
exposures: environmental exposure to chemicals | environmental risk factors for breast cancer
quote: The Sister Study was designed to address concerns that not enough was being done to evaluate the impact of widespread environmental exposure to chemicals on trends in breast cancer incidence.
note: An NIEHS cohort of women free of breast cancer but with an affected sister, selected for their familial risk and followed with environmental samples to study environmental (chemical) and genetic risk factors for breast cancer: at risk for the disease and designed to study exposures.

label: UroLife study
exposures: lifestyle habits | fluid intake and micturition | physical activity | fruit and vegetable consumption
quote: The main aim of this study is to evaluate whether lifestyle habits are related to prognosis and HRQOL in patients with NMIBC.
note: A Dutch cohort of newly diagnosed non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer patients (a patient series) whose stated main aim is the relation of lifestyle habits (fluid intake, diet, physical activity) to prognosis and quality of life, so lifestyle exposures are its main subject.

label: Chinese Antipsychotics Pharmacogenomics Consortium
note: A randomised pharmacogenetic trial cohort of Han Chinese inpatients with acute-phase schizophrenia; the only 'exposure' is antipsychotic treatment, which does not count.

label: CROATIA-Split Study
quote: This study is based on the Croatian biobank 10,001 Dalmatians [78,79], the most comprehensive research resource for investigating genetic, environmental and social determinants of health and disease in Croatia.
note: The urban Split sub-cohort of the 10,001 Dalmatians population biobank, recruited as a general population sample for genetic, environmental and social determinants of health and disease in general; environment is mentioned only in passing.

label: Epidemiological study on the Genetics and Environment of Asthma
exposures: environmental exposures | tobacco smoking
quote: At each survey, all participants answered standardised and validated questionnaires to identify asthma and to determine respiratory and allergic symptoms, treatments, environmental exposures, and lifestyle characteristics, including tobacco smoking status.
note: A French case-control and family study ascertained through asthma cases (with relatives and population controls), also covering bronchial hyperresponsiveness and atopy; its name and design make the environmental causes of asthma one of its two purposes, with environmental exposures and smoking assessed at every survey, but the sources in hand name only tobacco specifically, hence medium confidence for the exposure verdict.

label: Epidemiologische Studie zu Chancen der Verhütung, Früherkennung und optimierten Therapie chronischer Erkrankungen in der älteren Bevölkerung
quote: The study population was drawn from the ESTHER cohort, an ongoing population-based cohort study conducted in Saarland, Germany.
note: A population-based cohort of older adults recruited at routine GP health check-ups in Saarland for the prevention, early detection and treatment of chronic diseases in general: a broad purpose, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: Gothenburg H70 Birth Cohort Studies and Clinical AD Sweden
note: A Swedish case-control collection for Alzheimer's disease GWAS, combining clinic and population-identified AD cases with dementia-free controls from the Gothenburg population studies; classified by what it collects.

label: Northern California Breast Cancer Family Registry
note: The Northern California site of the Breast Cancer Family Registry: population-based incident breast cancer cases with their relatives and controls, for the genetic epidemiology of breast cancer.

label: Breast Cancer Family Registry
note: A six-site family registry of breast cancer probands and their families (population- and clinic-based) for the genetic epidemiology of breast cancer; affected probands make it a patient collection, and the unaffected relatives are an at-risk group within it.

label: National Institute on Aging Late Onset Alzheimer's Disease Family Study
note: A US family study of multiplex late-onset Alzheimer's disease families (at least two living affected members) with unrelated controls, for genetic studies of the disease.

label: Northern Manhattan Study
note: A community-based cohort of stroke-free northern Manhattan adults recruited by random-digit dialling and followed for incident stroke and vascular risk factors (funded by NINDS, originally the Northern Manhattan Stroke Study), later extended to MRI markers and dementia; the papers in hand show the stroke-free design but do not state the stroke purpose outright.

label: Pittsburgh Orofacial Cleft Study
note: A multiethnic family-based collection of people with nonsyndromic orofacial clefts, their relatives and controls, recruited through cleft centres to study the genetics of orofacial clefts.

label: Australian Genetics of Depression Study
note: A cohort of Australian adults recruited for a lifetime diagnosis of depression, for genetic and environmental risk factors and antidepressant response; environment is mentioned in passing, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Accessible Resource for Integrated Epigenomic Studies
quote: A sub-set of 1018 mother-offspring pairs were included in ARIES and were selected based on availability of DNA samples at two time- for the mother (at an antenatal clinic and at a follow-up clinic when their offspring were mean age 15.5 years) and three time points for the offspring [at birth, childhood, (mean age 7.5 years) and adolescence at mean age 15.5 years].
note: An ALSPAC sub-sample of mother-offspring pairs chosen for DNA availability and profiled for DNA methylation as a general epigenetic resource; a birth-cohort subset with no disease or exposure selection.

label: Bellygenes initiative
note: An international initiative pooling irritable bowel syndrome cases and controls from multiple studies for IBS GWAS; an aggregation classified by the case collections it gathers.

label: CERA cohort
note: A Centre for Eye Research Australia collection of people with (and without) age-related macular degeneration, imaged and genotyped for genetic studies of AMD and reticular pseudodrusen; a patient collection for one disease.

label: Center for International Blood and Marrow Transplant Research - National Marrow Donor Program Research Sample Repository
quote: HLA-genotyped PBMCs from the USA were stored in the National Marrow Donor Program (NMDP)/Be The Match Research Sample Repository (ClinicalTrials.gov protocol NCT04920474) that had been collected from healthy donors before the start of the COVID-19 pandemic.
note: A biorepository defined by a medical procedure, allogeneic haematopoietic cell transplantation, holding recipients with a range of underlying disorders together with their healthy donors, for research on transplant outcomes; the bundle shows it used only as a source of healthy-donor controls, and the cibmtr.org page is not cached, so the verdict rests on the procedure-based design rather than a disease statement.

label: Drug Interaction With Genes in Parkinson's Disease
note: A French multicentre longitudinal cohort of early Parkinson's disease patients followed annually with clinical assessment and genotyping.

label: Duke Genetics of Kidney Disease
note: Duke University's research collection of referred kidney disease patients, chiefly children and young adults with nephrotic syndrome and FSGS, for genetic studies.

label: European Genetic Database
note: A Cologne-Nijmegen case-control database of age-related macular degeneration patients and healthy controls for genetic and non-genetic AMD risk factors; smoking and sunlight are analysed among many risk factors, not the design purpose.

label: Family Atherosclerosis Monitoring In earLY life Study
note: A Canadian birth cohort of families whose stated purpose is the early determinants of adiposity, cardiovascular risk factors and atherosclerosis in children, so a population study of one disease family; environmental exposures are mentioned only generally.

label: Finland-United States Investigation of NIDDM Genetics
note: A Finnish-US collection of affected sib-pair families with type 2 diabetes (NIDDM), later extended with T2D cases and normoglycaemic controls, to map T2D susceptibility genes.

label: Ginkgo Evaluation of Memory Study
quote: Briefly, GEM was a randomized, placebo‐controlled trial that was conducted from 2000 to 2008 across five different academic centers in the United States to assess the effectiveness of Ginkgo biloba on incident dementia in 3069 participants aged ≥ 75, including 2587 cognitively normal individuals and 482 individuals with mild cognitive impairment (MCI).
note: A randomised placebo-controlled trial of Ginkgo biloba to prevent incident dementia in adults aged 75 and over who were cognitively normal or had MCI. The supplement is a treatment, not an environmental exposure; the trial's stated purpose is one disease, dementia, in a disease-free cohort, hence population study of disease.

label: Genito-Urinary BioBank
quote: The biospecimens of the GUB, including blood samples for DNA extraction, were obtained from the patients attending clinics for the suspicion, diagnosis and/or treatment of a genito-urinary tumor (prostate, kidney, bladder, testis, penis) within the Genito-Urinary Oncology division of The Princess Margaret’s Hospital.
note: A hospital biobank of patients attending genito-urinary oncology clinics for suspected or diagnosed prostate, kidney, bladder, testis or penile tumours; its non-muscle invasive bladder cancer patients were used in the GWAS. No exposure basis.

label: Hisayama-FSR study
quote: The individuals with ischemic stroke were recruited from seven hospitals in Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan (Kyushu University Hospital, Hakujyuji Hospital, Fukuoka Red Cross Hospital, Kyushu Medical Center, Imazu Red Cross Hospital, Fukuoka Higashi Medical Center, and Seiai Rehabilitation Hospital) in 2004 (The Fukuoka Stroke Registry [FSR]) .
note: A case-control study pairing hospital-recruited ischaemic stroke patients of the Fukuoka Stroke Registry with stroke-free controls from the Hisayama Study; a disease cohort with no exposure basis.

label: International Genomics of Alzheimer's Project
note: A consortium meta-analysing Alzheimer's disease case-control GWAS from GERAD, EADI, ADGC and CHARGE (17,008 AD cases, 37,154 controls); classified by what it collects. Quote read from the cached full text of PMID:29532500.

label: Mexican-American Coronary Artery Disease Study
quote: Family members of probands with documented coronary artery disease were recruited from the Los Angeles area.
note: A Mexican-American family study recruiting the families of probands with documented coronary artery disease to study the genetics of CAD and insulin resistance; relatives of patients, so at risk. No exposure basis.

label: Genetics UndeRlying DIAbetes in HispaNics
note: A consortium of seven Mexican-American cohorts (family studies of probands with CAD, hypertension or gestational diabetes, plus IRAS and TRIPOD) assembled for GWAS of insulin sensitivity and clearance to explain the raised type 2 diabetes risk of Mexican Americans; its stated purpose is one disease, members are a mix of population and at-risk cohorts. No exposure basis.

label: METASTROKE collaboration
note: A meta-analysis collaboration of ischaemic stroke case-control GWAS cohorts of European ancestry; classified by what it collects. No exposure basis.

label: Monongahela Valley Independent Elders Survey
quote: MoVIES was a prospective study that recruited 1681 individuals aged ≥ 65 residing within the Monongahela Valley, Pennsylvania during 1987 through 1989 using a voter's registration list.
note: A population cohort of adults aged 65 and over sampled from voter registration lists; the sources describe recruitment and dementia ascertainment by CDR but only the definition states that its purpose was cognitive decline and dementia, so the disease verdict is definition only. No exposure basis.

label: Prediction and Prevention of Preeclampsia and Intrauterine Growth Restriction Study
quote: The PREDO study recruited between 12 and 14 gestational weeks (GWs) 1079 pregnant women with known risk factor status for preeclampsia and intrauterine growth restriction from 10 hospitals [26].
note: A Finnish pregnancy cohort recruited by risk-factor status for preeclampsia and intrauterine growth restriction (a high-risk subsample plus a community sample), followed with the children; participants selected for risk of the named pregnancy complications. Prenatal maternal emotions are its exposures of interest, not environmental agents.

label: Risk Assessment of Cerebrovascular Events Study
quote: Risk Assessment of Cerebrovascular Events (RACE) is an on-going existing case-control study of stroke now involving over 5000 imaging confirmed cases of stroke and 5000 controls, recruited from seven centers in Pakistan.
note: A case-control study of imaging-confirmed stroke in Pakistan; smoking is examined as a modifier of genetic effects but is not a recruitment criterion, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Reasons for Geographic and Racial Differences in Stroke
quote: The REGARDS study is one of the largest ongoing prospective population-based studies in the U.S. and was designed to measure stroke incidence and associated risk factors in AA and European-Americans adults ≥45 years of age (8).
note: A national population-based cohort of African American and European American adults aged 45 and over designed to measure stroke incidence and explain geographic and racial differences in stroke. No exposure basis.

label: Selenium and Vitamin E Cancer Prevention Trial
quote: The Selenium and Vitamin E Cancer Prevention Trial (SELECT) was conducted to assess the efficacy of selenium and vitamin E alone, and in combination, on the incidence of prostate cancer.
note: A randomised placebo-controlled trial of selenium and vitamin E supplementation for the prevention of prostate cancer in 35,533 healthy men; the supplements are a treatment, not an environmental exposure, and the trial's stated purpose is one disease in a disease-free cohort.

label: Stroke in Young Fabry Patients
quote: The SIFAP study is a multicenter study carried out to determine the frequency of Fabry disease in an unselected group of young adult patients with acute cerebrovascular events defined as having had an acute ischemic stroke or transient ischemic attack less than three months before enrollment into the study.
note: A European multicentre observational study of 5,023 patients aged 18-55 with acute stroke or TIA, designed to find the frequency of Fabry disease among them; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: SpiroMeta Consortium
quote: The SpiroMeta consortium consists of 14 GWAS studies: ALSPAC, B58C-T1DGC, B58C-WTCCC, EPIC (obese and population-based substudies), the EUROSPAN studies (Korcula, NSPHS, ORCADES and Vis), FTC (incorporating the FinnTwin16 and Finnish Twin Study on Aging), KORA S3, NFBC1966, SHIP and TwinsUK (see Table 1 for definitions of acronyms).
note: A consortium of general-population and twin cohorts meta-analysing GWAS of spirometric lung function, a quantitative trait; COPD is a motivation but the member cohorts are population samples, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: Wisconsin Longitudinal Study
quote: The Wisconsin Longitudinal Study (WLS) is a longitudinal study of men and women who graduated from Wisconsin high schools in 1957 and one of their randomly selected siblings.
note: A life-course cohort of the 1957 Wisconsin high school graduating class and their siblings, followed for health, cognition and mortality; a general population cohort with no exposure or disease basis.

label: Grady Trauma Project
quote: A broad set of phenotype data were collected from GTP research participants who were approached in the waiting rooms of the primary care clinic or obstetrical-gynecological clinic of a large, urban, public hospital in Atlanta, GA while either waiting for their medical appointments or while waiting with others who were scheduled for medical appointments
note: A study of low-income, predominantly African American adults approached in the waiting rooms of an urban public hospital, investigating environmental (trauma) and genetic risk factors for PTSD and depression. Participants were not selected for exposure and psychological trauma is not an environmental agent in scope, so not an exposure cohort; the stated purpose is the trauma-related disorders PTSD and MDD in a clinic population.

label: 10,001 Dalmatians
quote: This study is based on the Croatian biobank 10,001 Dalmatians [78,79], the most comprehensive research resource for investigating genetic, environmental and social determinants of health and disease in Croatia.
note: A Croatian biobank project collecting the general-population cohorts of the islands of Vis and Korcula and the city of Split for genetic, environmental and social determinants of health and disease broadly; neither an exposure nor a disease aggregation.

label: Lothian Birth Cohort 1936
quote: The LBC1936 are a relatively healthy cohort of 1091 individuals who underwent cognitive and medical testing at a mean age of 69.5 (SD=0.8) years.
note: A relatively healthy cohort of people born in 1936 who sat the Scottish Mental Survey of 1947, followed to study non-pathological cognitive ageing; no exposure or disease basis.

label: Lothian Birth Cohort 1921
quote: The LBC1921 are a relatively healthy cohort of 550 individuals who underwent cognitive and medical testing at a mean age of 79.1 (SD=0.6) years.
note: A relatively healthy cohort of people born in 1921 who sat the Scottish Mental Survey of 1932, followed to study non-pathological cognitive ageing; no exposure or disease basis.

label: National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health
quote: We used data from Add Health: a U.S. nationally representative cohort of people born between 1976 and 1982.
note: A nationally representative US cohort enrolled in adolescence and followed into adulthood for health and wellbeing broadly, also used as healthy controls; no exposure or disease basis.

label: Basque Center on Cognition, Brain and Language cohort
note: Spanish schoolchildren sampled at schools across several regions and assessed for reading, attention and IQ, assembled to study the genetics of dyslexia and ADHD (case-control comparisons within the sample) and reading-related skills; a school-sampled cohort whose stated purpose is these disorders. No exposure basis.

label: Botnia Study
quote: To address this question, we studied 2,152 first-degree relatives of patients with NIDDM (FH+) and 528 age- and weight-matched spouses without a family history of NIDDM (FH-) in Western Finland (the Botnia study).
note: A western Finnish family study of patients with type 2 diabetes (NIDDM in the source), their first-degree relatives and spouses without a family history, followed for the inheritance and prediction of type 2 diabetes; relatives of patients, so at risk, with the probands themselves also included. No exposure basis.

label: Colorado Learning Disabilities Research Center cohort
note: A family-based sample selected for dyslexia, ascertained through affected probands and their families and enriched for reading difficulties; a disease cohort (affected probands with their relatives). No exposure basis.

label: DIAGEN Study
note: A Dresden study of people at increased risk of type 2 diabetes given repeated oral glucose tolerance tests, which also supplied type 2 diabetes patients and controls to consortia. The quoted abstract is from a DIAGEN paper but does not name the study, hence medium confidence. No exposure basis.

label: Evaluation of COPD Longitudinally to Identify Predictive Surrogate End-points
exposures: smoking
quote: COPDGene, COGEND, and ECLIPSE are all smoking cohorts and ratios of COPD were consistent across array and WGS datasets, thus we expected no genome-wide significant association signals (controlled type 1 error).
note: An observational cohort of about 2,180 patients with moderate to very severe COPD with smoking and non-smoking controls, followed to define COPD subtypes and predictors of progression. The disease verdict is direct; the exposure verdict rests on GAWMerge calling ECLIPSE a smoking cohort (its COPD subjects and most controls were recruited as smokers), while the design abstract also lists non-smoking controls, hence medium.

label: Early Language in Victoria Study
quote: The Early Language in Victoria Study (ELVS) recruited 1910 8-month-olds in Melbourne in 2003-2004.
note: A population-based community cohort of Melbourne infants followed for language development and its early-life predictors; nobody was selected by exposure or disease, and language development is a developmental trait rather than one disease.

label: German Infant Study on the Influence of Nutrition Intervention plus Air pollution and Genetics on Allergy Development
exposures: Air pollution | road traffic emissions | Nutrition Intervention
quote: GINIplus – The German Infant Study on the Influence of Nutrition Intervention plus Air pollution and Genetics on Allergy Development GINIplus is a prospective population-based birth cohort study.
note: A population-based German birth cohort whose name and design centre on a nutrition (hydrolysed formula) intervention and air pollution (traffic emissions) as influences on allergy; its stated subject is the natural course of atopic diseases, so it is a population study of one disease family.

label: Gothenburg Osteoporosis and Obesity Determinants study
quote: Young men were randomly identified in the greater Gothenburg area in Sweden using national population registers, contacted by telephone, and invited to participate.
note: A population-register sample of young men set up, as its name says, to find the determinants of osteoporosis and obesity, measured as bone and fat mass; 'environmental factors' is mentioned only in passing, so no exposure defines it.

label: Genetics of Overweight Young Adults
quote: From two large Danish cohorts we selected all extremely overweight young men and women (n = 2,633), and equal numbers of population-based controls (n = 2,740, drawn randomly from the same populations as the extremes, representing ∼212,000 individuals).
note: A case-cohort sample of extremely overweight young Danish adults with random population controls, built for GWAS of BMI and obesity; the cases are selected for obesity, and no environmental exposure is involved.

label: International Consortium for Blood Pressure Genome-Wide Association Studies
quote: This genome-wide association study of systolic and diastolic blood pressure, which used a multi-stage design in 200,000 individuals of European descent, identified sixteen novel loci: six of these loci contain genes previously known or suspected to regulate blood pressure (GUCY1A3-GUCY1B3, NPR3-C5orf23, ADM, FURIN-FES, GOSR2, GNAS-EDN3); the other ten provide new clues to blood pressure physiology.
note: A consortium of general-population GWAS of blood pressure as a quantitative trait; hypertension and cardiovascular disease are downstream outcomes rather than the recruitment basis, and a trait-defined consortium is out of scope for both questions.

label: Iowa LI cohort
quote: The Iowa LI cohort is comprised of 219 LI cases and 209 sex- and age-matched, unrelated controls collected at the University of Iowa.
note: A case-control sample of children with language impairment and matched controls; the prenatal-nicotine analysis in the paper was done in ALSPAC, with Iowa used only for genetic replication, so no exposure defines it.

label: Korea-Registries to Overcome Dementia and Accelerate Dementia Research
note: An aggregation of hospital-based Korean dementia cohorts recruited across the Alzheimer's, vascular cognitive impairment and frontotemporal dementia spectra; a patient collection with no exposure component.

label: Mayo Genome Consortia
quote: To create a cohort for cost-effective genetic research, the Mayo Genome Consortia (MayoGC) has been assembled with participants from research studies across Mayo Clinic with high-throughput genetic data and electronic medical record (EMR) data for phenotype extraction.
note: A genotype-plus-EMR resource pooling participants of many Mayo Clinic studies for GWAS of whatever phenotypes the record yields; not selected by exposure and not devoted to one disease.

label: Impact of Migration and Ethnicity on Diabetes in Malmö
quote: The MEDIM cohort (the impact of Migration and Ethnicity on Diabetes in Malmö) is a population-based cohort comprised of people aged 30 to 75 years, born in either Iraq or Sweden, and resident in Malmö.
note: A population-based sample of Iraqi- and Swedish-born Malmö residents whose stated subject is the impact of migration and ethnicity on type 2 diabetes; migration and ethnicity are not environmental exposures in scope.

label: Material and Information Resources for Inflammatory and Digestive Diseases Biobank
note: The Cedars-Sinai IBD biobank of Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis patients with non-IBD controls; a disease biobank with no exposure basis.

label: Lung Cancer and Smoking Phenotypes in African American Cases and Controls
exposures: smoking - cigarettes per day and current or former smoker
quote: No SNPs reached genome-wide significance for either of the main effect models examining smoking - cigarettes per day and current or former smoker.
note: An aggregation of African American lung cancer cases and controls from eight US studies, genotyped for GWAS of lung cancer and, as its name says, of smoking phenotypes (cigarettes per day, smoking status); the disease verdict is direct, the exposure verdict rests on smoking behaviour being a stated study outcome rather than a recruitment criterion.

label: NIDDK IBD Genetics Consortium
note: Patients with confirmed Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis or unclassified IBD recruited by the NIDDK IBD Genetics Consortium centres for gene discovery, with some controls; no exposure basis.

label: Oregon Health and Science University study
note: A case-control set of autopsy-confirmed Alzheimer disease cases and non-demented controls assembled at OHSU from NIA Alzheimer's Disease Center cohorts; no exposure basis.

label: Phenomics and Genomics Sample
note: A Munich case-control resource of about 3,000 psychiatrically screened healthy volunteers plus about 1,000 schizophrenia patients and 300 others; it is mostly drawn on as a healthy-control panel (one paper describes it as healthy volunteers only), but the schizophrenia cases make it a disease case-control sample. No exposure basis.

label: Paediatric Asthma Gene Environment Study
note: Children with physician-diagnosed asthma recruited from Scottish asthma clinics, a patient cohort. Its name states a gene-environment purpose, but the cached papers (pharmacogenetic analyses) describe only generic environmental-history questionnaires and never name the exposures studied; the PAGES design paper is not in the cache, so the exposure question cannot be settled.

label: Risk Stratification and Identification of Immunogenetic and Microbial Markers of Rapid Disease Progression in Children with Crohn's Disease
note: A paediatric inception cohort of newly diagnosed Crohn's disease (with some ulcerative colitis, unclassified IBD and non-inflamed controls) at 28 North American sites; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: Texas Harris Alzheimer's Research Study
note: The Texas Alzheimer's Research and Care Consortium's longitudinal sample of older adults diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease or mild cognitive impairment, with cognitively normal controls; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: Wellcome Language and Reading Project
note: The York longitudinal cohort of children at family risk of dyslexia (at risk) together with children who already had preschool language difficulties and typically developing controls; no exposure basis.

label: Sinai-Helmsley Alliance for Research Excellence
note: A multicentre prospective cohort of inflammatory bowel disease patients at seven US academic centres; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: Shanghai Changfeng Study
quote: The Shanghai Changfeng Study is a community-based prospective cohort study of chronic diseases ongoing since February 2009 in Shanghai, China.
note: A community-based cohort of Shanghai adults aged 40 and over followed for multiple chronic diseases (obesity, diabetes, osteoporosis, liver, cardiovascular and neurological disease); a broad-purpose population cohort, not selected by exposure or devoted to one disease.

label: Collaborative Genetic Study of Nicotine Dependence
exposures: smoking
quote: Nicotine dependent cases and non-dependent smoking controls were identified and recruited from Detroit and St. Louis.
note: A case-control study of nicotine dependence in which both cases and controls are smokers recruited in Detroit and St. Louis; every participant is defined by tobacco exposure, and the cases have nicotine dependence, an addiction.

label: EPIDG cohort
note: Pregnant women recruited after a positive glucose screen at a Málaga diabetes and pregnancy unit, with and without gestational diabetes, followed with their offspring; a disease case-control cohort, and intrauterine GDM exposure is not an environmental exposure.

label: Family Investigation of Nephropathy and Diabetes
note: A multicentre family-based and case-control study of people with diabetes with and without diabetic nephropathy and their relatives, built for nephropathy gene mapping; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: Genetics Of Mortality In Critical Care
note: Critically ill intensive-care patients (sepsis, ARDS, influenza and, from 2020, critical COVID-19) compared with population controls; the participants are patients, and infection here is the disease rather than an exposure defining an uninfected group.

label: Collaborative Oncological Gene-environment Study
note: A genotyping collaboration of four cancer consortia (breast, ovarian, prostate, and BRCA1/2 carriers) whose member studies are cancer case-control series and mutation-carrier cohorts; 'gene-environment' in the name is not borne out by any exposure defining or centring the collection (its interaction analyses concern hormone therapy, a medication).

label: Kentucky Case-Control Study
note: A population-based case-control study of colon cancer in Kentucky, with incident cases from the Kentucky Cancer Registry and random-digit-dialled population controls, so a disease cohort of patients. Diet (glycaemic load, red meat) is analysed as one risk factor among others rather than being a stated design purpose, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: Los Angeles Latino Eye Study
quote: Six thousand three hundred fifty-seven Latinos 40 years and older from 6 census tracts in Los Angeles, California.
note: A population-based sample of Latinos aged 40 and over from six Los Angeles census tracts whose stated purpose is the prevalence and risk factors of eye disease, so a population study of one disease family; no exposure is a design purpose.

label: Mexican Hypertriglyceride Study
note: A case-control sample of Mexican adults ascertained on serum triglyceride levels, with hypertriglyceridaemic cases and normotriglyceridaemic controls; hypertriglyceridaemia is taken as a lipid disorder, so the cases make it a patient cohort. No environmental exposure is involved.

label: San Francisco Bay Area Breast Cancer Study
note: A population-based multiethnic case-control study of invasive breast cancer in the San Francisco Bay Area, with cases from the cancer registry and random-digit-dialled controls, so a disease cohort of patients; exposures are not a design purpose.

label: SIGMA Type 2 Diabetes Consortium
note: A consortium pooling type 2 diabetes case-control samples of Mexicans and other Latin Americans to map type 2 diabetes genetics, so classified by what it collects: patients with one disease. No exposure focus.

label: Mexico City sample 2
note: A case-control sample of Mexican adults with type 2 diabetes and controls from Mexico City used in GWAS of diabetes and lipid traits, so a disease cohort of patients; no exposure is a design purpose.

label: Mexico City sample 1
note: A case-control sample of type 2 diabetes cases (preferentially diagnosed before 55) and normoglycaemic controls from Mexico City, so a disease cohort of patients; no exposure is a design purpose.

label: 1982 Pelotas (Brazil) Birth Cohort Study
quote: In 1982, 5914 live births whose families lived in the urban are of Pelotas were enrolled in the cohort.
note: A population-based birth cohort of all 1982 live births in urban Pelotas followed for mental health, body composition, precursors of chronic disease and human capital: a general birth cohort with a broad purpose, so neither an exposure nor a disease cohort.

label: Agricultural Health Study
exposures: pesticide use | atrazine | agricultural practices
quote: The AHS is a prospective cohort that includes 57,310 licensed pesticide applicators enrolled in Iowa or North Carolina between 1993 and 1997.
note: A prospective cohort of licensed pesticide applicators and their spouses recruited for their agricultural and pesticide exposure and followed for health effects including cancer; the participants are selected by occupational exposure, and the outcomes are many, so it is an exposure cohort but not a disease cohort.

label: Agricultural Lung Health Study
exposures: farm exposures
quote: The Agricultural Lung Health Study (ALHS) is a case-control study of current asthma among farmers and their spouses nested within the prospective Agricultural Health Study (AHS data releases P3REL201209.00, PIREL201209.00 and AHSREL201304.00)
note: A case-control study of current adult asthma whose cases and controls are all farmers and their spouses drawn from the Agricultural Health Study, set up to study farm exposures and asthma; the asthma cases make it a patient cohort, and the occupational (farming) selection inherited from the parent cohort makes it an exposure cohort.

label: AncestryDNA Human Diversity Project
quote: US-based AncestryDNA customers over the age of 18 who had consented to the research, were invited to complete five surveys assessing COVID-19 outcomes, as well as providing other demographic information and comorbidities, as described previously8.
note: A research cohort of consenting consumer genetic-testing customers, unselected for disease or exposure; the COVID-19 and influenza work is a survey of these customers, not a selection of patients, so neither verdict applies.

label: All New Diabetics In Scania
note: A register-style study enrolling all newly diagnosed diabetes patients in Scania to subtype diabetes and study its genetics and complications, so a disease cohort of patients; no exposure focus.

label: Brisbane Longitudinal Twin Study
quote: Twins and their non-twin siblings from Queensland, Australia; mostly from European ancestry.
note: A longitudinal twin sample recruited through Brisbane schools and assessed for many traits (mental health, substance use, cognition, imaging); a twin registry with a broad purpose, so neither an exposure nor a disease cohort, even though the 19Up wave concentrates on mental disorders.

label: Coronary ARtery DIsease Genome wide Replication and Meta-analysis
note: A consortium meta-analysing coronary artery disease case-control GWAS, so classified by what it collects: patients with one disease. No exposure focus.

label: Centers for AIDS Research Network of Integrated Clinical Systems
note: A clinical cohort of people with HIV in care at US HIV clinics, so a disease cohort of patients; the participants are defined by infection, not by exposure without infection, and substance use is measured as an outcome, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: Diabetes Control and Complications Trial/Epidemiology of Diabetes Interventions and Complications Study
note: A randomised trial of glycaemic therapy in people with type 1 diabetes, followed observationally in EDIC, so a disease cohort of patients; the intervention is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Danish National Birth Cohort
exposures: exposures in early life
quote: The Danish National Birth Cohort (DNBC) was established to investigate the causal link between exposures in early life and disease later on and the possibilities for disease prevention.
note: A nationwide pregnancy and birth cohort whose stated founding purpose is the causal link between early-life exposures and later disease, with prospectively collected exposure data, so an exposure-designed cohort (the source names no specific exposure class); the outcomes are disease in general, so it is not a disease cohort.

label: Environment And Genetics in Lung cancer Etiology study
exposures: smoking
quote: We designed a large population-based case-control study that combines a traditional molecular epidemiology design with a more integrative approach to investigate the dynamic process that begins with smoking initiation, proceeds through dependency/smoking persistence, continues with lung cancer development and ends with progression to disseminated disease or response to therapy and survival.
note: A population-based case-control study of incident lung cancer in Lombardy, so a disease cohort of patients; its design is explicitly built around smoking, from initiation and dependence to lung cancer, so it also counts as designed to study a tobacco exposure.

label: EArly Genetics and Lifecourse Epidemiology consortium
quote: The majority of the participating cohorts are longitudinal population-based samples, but other cohorts with data on early childhood phenotypes are also involved.
note: A consortium of population-based pregnancy and birth cohorts pooling GWAS of a wide range of childhood phenotypes (asthma, eczema, psychopathology, cognition), so classified by what it collects: general population cohorts with a broad purpose, neither exposure nor disease.

label: EAGLE BioVU
quote: Epidemiologic Architecture for Genes Linked to Environment (EAGLE)-accessing the Vanderbilt University Medical Center’s biorepository (BioVU)
note: The BioVU biorepository participants as studied by the PAGE EAGLE site: an EHR-linked biobank of unselected patients used for trans-ethnic studies of complex traits, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort; the word Environment in the site's name is not a selection basis.

label: Elucidating Loci Involved in Prostate Cancer Susceptibility
note: A prostate cancer genetics consortium pooling case-control GWAS and genotyping studies, so classified by what it collects: patients with one disease. No exposure focus.

label: Helsinki 2000 Ischemic Stroke Genetics Study
note: A hospital-based case-control study of neuroimaging-confirmed ischaemic stroke patients at Helsinki University Central Hospital with FINRISK controls, designed to find genetic factors for ischaemic stroke, so a disease cohort of patients; no exposure focus.

label: GEN-COVID Multicenter Study
note: A multicentre biobank and registry of SARS-CoV-2-positive individuals in Italy assembled to find host genetic factors for COVID-19 susceptibility and severity, so a disease cohort of patients; the participants are defined by infection, not by exposure without infection.

label: Hawaii Colorectal Cancer Studies 2 and 3
note: A population-based case-control study of colorectal cancer on Oahu with registry-identified cases and matched population controls, listed as a case-control contributor in a pooled analysis of colorectal cancer cases and controls, so a disease cohort of patients; the source text names it only as a case-control study, hence medium confidence. No exposure focus.

label: Heinz Nixdorf Recall Study
quote: Briefly, the study participants, aged 45–75, were randomly selected from the residents’ registration offices of the cities of Bochum, Essen and Mülheim an der Ruhr, Germany.
note: A population-based cohort randomly drawn from city resident registries in the Ruhr area whose stated aim is coronary artery calcification as a predictor of myocardial infarction and cardiac death, so a population study of cardiovascular disease in the Framingham sense; no exposure is a design purpose.

label: INflammation, Health, Ancestry and Lung Epidemiology study
note: A case-control study of lung cancer in Detroit: the participants are lung cancer patients and controls, so it is a disease cohort. Smoking and occupational exposures are recorded as risk factors among others, not the basis of recruitment or the stated design purpose.

label: Malmö Diet and Cancer Study–Cardiovascular Cohort
quote: The MDC study included a random sample of individuals from Malmö, Sweden, born between 1926 and 1945 and included between March 1991 and September 199611.
note: A random subsample of the population-based Malmö Diet and Cancer Study enrolled into a sub-study of carotid artery disease epidemiology, so a population study of cardiovascular disease. Diet is the parent cohort's subject, not the stated design of this cardiovascular sub-cohort, so exposure is no here.

label: MiaLAtinX Consortium
note: Hispanic IBD cases and non-IBD controls recruited at four US centres for IBD genetics: a disease case-control cohort, with no environmental exposure in its design.

label: Northern Finland Birth Cohort 1986
quote: The study was based on the Northern Finland Birth Cohort 1986 (NFBC1986) [20], which is an unselected, general population sample based on 9432 live-born children with an expected date of birth between July 1 st, 1985 – June 30th, 1986, in the provinces of Oulu and Lapland [21].
note: An unselected general-population birth cohort of northern Finland followed for health and development broadly; its catalogue entry in the exposome catalogue does not make exposure its design purpose, and no disease is its stated focus.

label: Ragama Health Study
quote: Adults between 35 and 64 years of age were recruited using an age stratified random sampling technique in 2007.
note: A population-based cohort of randomly sampled adults in a semi-urban Sri Lankan area followed for mortality and its predictors: a general population cohort with neither an exposure nor a single disease as its design.

label: Singapore Chinese Eye Study
quote: 3353 Chinese adults who participated in the baseline SCES-1 (2009-2011) were invited for the 6-year follow-up SCES-2 (2015-2017).
note: A population-based cohort of Chinese adults in Singapore set up to report the prevalence, incidence, progression and risk factors of age-related eye diseases, so a population study of one disease family; no environmental exposure is part of its design.

label: Singapore Epidemiology of Eye Diseases Study
quote: We conducted a multiethnic population-based cohort study using subjects recruited from the Singapore Epidemiology of Eye Diseases (SEED) study.
note: The multiethnic population-based umbrella of the Singapore Malay, Indian and Chinese Eye Studies, named and designed for the epidemiology of eye diseases and visual impairment; the verdict follows from the name and the sub-cohorts' stated designs rather than from a direct purpose statement in the bundle. No exposure design.

label: Singapore Indian Eye Study
quote: A total of 2200 adults had participated in baseline SINDI (2007-2009, mean age [range] = 57.8 [42.7-84.1] years) and SINDI-2 (2013-2015, 56.5 [48.4-90.2] years).
note: A population-based cohort of Indian adults in Singapore aimed at diabetic retinopathy and other age-related eye diseases, so a population study of a disease family. Migration status is its comparison, not an environmental exposure in scope.

label: TAICHI Consortium
note: A Taiwanese consortium that collected and genotyped coronary artery disease cases and controls with the CardioMetaboChip; its stated scope is atherosclerosis- and metabolic-related traits, so the disease verdict rests on the CAD case-control collection it describes. No exposure design.

label: University of Southern California Hormone Replacement Therapy Colorectal Cancer Study
note: A population-based case-control study of colon cancer in Los Angeles women, so a disease cohort. Its subject, menopausal hormone therapy, is a medication and not an environmental exposure.

label: UK Dyslexia Cohort
note: A clinical cohort of children and families recruited for reading difficulties to study the genetics of dyslexia, a neurodevelopmental disorder; families include siblings, so some members are relatives rather than affected. No exposure design.

label: African Ancestry Prostate Cancer Consortium
note: A consortium of prostate cancer case-control studies in men of African ancestry assembled for GWAS of prostate cancer susceptibility, so a disease aggregation. No exposure design.

label: Prevalence, Prediction and Prevention of Diabetes-Botnia Study
quote: The Prevalence, Prediction and Prevention of Diabetes (PPP)-Botnia study is a population-based study in Western Finland, which includes a random sample of 5,208 individuals aged 18 to 75 years identified through the national Finnish Population Registry.
