note: A population-based random sample from the Botnia region whose stated purpose, in its name, is the prevalence, prediction and prevention of diabetes, so a population study of type 2 diabetes. Physical activity and diet are measured among other variables, not the design purpose.

label: The Cleft Collective
note: A UK cohort of children born with cleft lip and/or palate and their families recruited through cleft centres, so a patient cohort of a congenital condition. No exposure design.

label: Children's Oncology Group
note: A clinical trials network for childhood and adolescent cancer whose genetic studies use trial participants, such as children treated for acute lymphoblastic leukemia, so an aggregation of patient cohorts. Chemotherapy is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Collaborative Study on the Genetics of Alcoholism
exposures: alcohol use
quote: Participants range in age from 7 to 97, with many having longitudinal assessments, providing a valuable opportunity to study alcohol use and problems across the lifespan.
note: A family study ascertained through probands in treatment for alcohol use disorder, with their relatives and community comparison families, designed to study alcohol use and its genetics across the lifespan. Alcohol use is its main subject, so it is an exposure cohort; addiction counts as a disease, so it is also a disease cohort of patients and their at-risk relatives.

label: Colorectal Transdisciplinary Study
note: A colorectal cancer genetic epidemiology consortium pooling case-control GWAS data from colorectal cancer studies, so a disease aggregation. No exposure design.

label: Genetic Associations and Mechanisms in Oncology
note: A network of five cancer GWAS consortia (colorectal, breast, prostate, ovarian, lung), each built on case-control data, so an aggregation of cancer patient cohorts. No exposure design.

label: DAHANCA cohort
note: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma patients treated with radiotherapy in DAHANCA protocols and scored for toxicity, so a patient cohort. Radiotherapy is a medical treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: DiscovEHR study
quote: In short, the DiscovEHR cohort is a subset of individuals enrolled in the Geisinger Healthcare system who consented to participate in Geisinger's MyCode Community Health Initiative.
note: A health-system biobank of unselected MyCode participants sequenced and linked to electronic health records for precision medicine broadly: neither an exposure nor a disease cohort.

label: Epidemiological Investigation of Multiple Sclerosis
exposures: environmental exposures and lifestyle factors | combustion-related ambient air pollution | smoking and passive smoking | sun exposure habits
quote: GEMS and EIMS are nationwide case-control studies examining the genetic and environmental risk factors for prevalent and incident MS, respectively.
note: A Swedish population-based case-control study of incident multiple sclerosis whose stated design is to examine genetic and environmental risk factors, with questionnaires on environmental exposures and lifestyle factors and residential air-pollution assessment, so both a disease cohort of MS patients and a cohort designed to study exposures.

label: Swedish MS registry
note: A national quality registry of patients with multiple sclerosis, so a disease registry. No exposure design.

label: EUGENE2 study
note: Non-diabetic offspring of type 2 diabetes patients from five European populations, phenotyped for insulin secretion and sensitivity: relatives of patients selected for their risk of the disease. No exposure design.

label: Multi-Site Collaborative Study for Genotype-Phenotype Associations in Alzheimer's Disease
note: A case-control study of Alzheimer's disease recruited from Canadian memory clinics with unimpaired controls, so a disease cohort. No exposure design.

label: Hospital-based Epidemiologic Research Program at Aichi Cancer Center
note: A hospital-based programme enrolling first-visit outpatients of a cancer centre hospital as the base for case-control studies of cancers (oesophageal, breast), with non-cancer outpatients as controls, so a disease cohort of cancer cases with controls; its non-cancer participants are also used as healthy controls elsewhere. Lifestyle is recorded by questionnaire but exposure is not the stated design in the bundle.

label: Japanese Consortium of Genetic Epidemiology Studies
quote: The J-CGE consists of data analyzed among healthy participants from the Tohoku Medical Megabank Community-Based Cohort (TMM) Study, the Japan Public Health Centre-based Prospective (JPHC) Study, the Japan Multi-Institutional Collaborative Cohort (J-MICC) Study, and the Hospital-based Epidemiologic Research Program at Aichi Cancer Center (HERPACC) Study (Table 1).
note: A consortium pooling GWAS data on healthy participants of Japanese population-based and hospital-based cohorts for anthropometric traits (BMI, height, weight); neither exposure nor disease is its subject.

label: Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective Study
quote: The Japan Public Health Center-based prospective Study conducted a baseline survey for 140 000 registered residents aged 40-69 years within 11 public health center areas nationwide in 1990-94.
note: A population-based cohort of registered residents whose stated subject is cancer and cardiovascular diseases (its full name), so a population study of those disease families; lifestyle (diet, smoking, drinking) is collected by questionnaire among many variables but the sources state no exposure-centred design purpose, so not an exposure cohort.

label: MEGASTROKE consortium
note: A GWAS meta-analysis consortium of 29 studies contributing 67,162 stroke cases and 454,450 controls, mainly case-control sampling with clinically defined stroke; it collects stroke patient series, not an exposure.

label: MEMENTO cohort
note: Memory-clinic patients with subjective cognitive complaints or MCI but no dementia, followed to study the natural history of Alzheimer's disease and related disorders: a pre-disease (at risk) cohort for dementia; no exposure focus.

label: Miami Stroke Registry
note: A hospital registry of consecutive patients admitted with stroke or TIA: a disease patient series with no exposure basis.

label: Malmö Preventive Project
quote: MPP is also population-based, including 33,346 participants recruited by pre-specified birth year groups for health examinations from 1974 to 1992.
note: A population-based cohort of Malmö residents recruited by birth year for health examinations; the source describes general-population recruitment, not selection by exposure or disease.

label: NeuroDys cohort
note: A European case-control sample of school-age children with dyslexia (a neurodevelopmental disorder, so a disease here) and controls assembled for genetic study; no exposure basis.

label: Nutrition and Health of Aging Population in China
exposures: nutrition | environmental factors
quote: The participants were from a population-based cohort entitled the Nutrition and Health of Aging People in China (NHAPC) study, which was designed to investigate environmental and genetic factors and their interactions on cardiometabolic diseases [21,22].
note: A population-based cohort of older Beijing and Shanghai adults run by a nutrition institute, whose name centres on nutrition and whose stated design is to investigate environmental and genetic factors in cardiometabolic diseases; the source names no specific exposure beyond nutrition and environmental factors, so the exposure verdict rests on the stated design purpose.

label: NUgene Project
quote: NUgene collects and stores DNA samples and associated health information from patients at Northwestern Medicine–affiliated hospitals and clinics to be used by scientists to examine the role genes play in the development and treatment of common diseases.
note: A hospital-system genomic biobank of unselected Northwestern Medicine patients for research on common diseases in general (a broad purpose), providing case and control samples; not selected by exposure or by one disease.

label: RADIOGEN cohort
note: Spanish cancer patients (prostate, lung, head and neck sub-cohorts) treated with radiotherapy and followed for radiation toxicity: a patient cohort; the radiation is a medical treatment, which does not make it an environmental exposure cohort.

label: Religious Orders Study
note: Older Catholic clergy enrolled without dementia and followed with annual evaluations and brain donation in a clinical-pathologic study whose stated subject is aging and Alzheimer's disease: a cohort of initially unaffected people set up to study one disease; no exposure basis.

label: Study of Addiction: Genetics and Environment
exposures: alcohol | nicotine | cocaine
quote: The SAGE aggregated data containing common measures from three large scale studies in the substance abuse field: the Collaborative Study on the Genetics of Alcoholism (COGA), the Family Study of Cocaine Dependence (FSCD), and the Collaborative Genetic Study of Nicotine Dependence (COGEND).
note: A GWAS dataset aggregating three substance-abuse studies of alcohol, cocaine and nicotine dependence: its subject is use of alcohol, tobacco and cocaine (lifestyle exposures), and its members are dependence cases (addiction counts as disease) with controls.

label: Study of African Americans, Asthma, Genes and Environments
exposures: environmental basis of childhood-onset asthma | early-life air pollution
quote: GALA II and SAGE are two clinic-based case-control studies focused on untangling the genetic and environmental basis of childhood-onset asthma disease in minority ethnic groups of the United States of America [22].
note: A clinic-based case-control study of childhood-onset asthma in African American children (physician-diagnosed cases and controls), whose stated focus, carried in its name, is the genetic and environmental basis of asthma; the paper cites SAGE work on early-life air pollution but names no other specific exposure, so the exposure verdict rests on the stated design purpose.

label: Shanghai Breast Cancer Study
note: A population-based case-control study of breast cancer among women in urban Shanghai: breast cancer cases with controls; lifestyle factors are covariates, not a design purpose.

label: Singapore Malay Eye Study
note: A population-based, age-stratified random sample of Singapore Malays aged 40-79 examined to measure the prevalence and risk factors of age-related eye diseases: a population study of one disease family; no exposure basis.

label: Spanish Bladder Cancer Study
exposures: disinfection by-products (trihalomethanes) in drinking water | occupational exposures | smoking
quote: Participants provided a lifetime residential history, occupational history from 16 years of age, water source at each residence and job, and average daily water consumption.
note: A hospital-based case-control study of newly diagnosed bladder cancer in Spain (EPICURO) built around lifetime residential, occupational and drinking-water exposure histories, used for gene-environment analyses of trihalomethanes, occupational exposures and smoking: a bladder cancer patient cohort whose design centres on environmental exposure assessment.

label: Shenzhen Maternal and Neonatal NIPT cohort
quote: We recruited 121,556 pregnancy participants from Shenzhen Baoan Women’s and Children’s Hospital (referred to as Baoan) and Longgang District Maternity and Child Healthcare Hospital of Shenzhen City (referred to as Longgang).
note: A hospital-based cohort of unselected pregnant women who had NIPT at two Shenzhen hospitals, used for GWAS of pregnancy traits and complications broadly (platelet counts, gestational diabetes); pregnancy is not a disease and the cohort is not selected for one condition or any exposure.

label: Translational Genomics Research Institute series 2
note: A brain-donor series of Alzheimer disease cases and cognitively normal controls assembled by TGen from Alzheimer's Disease Center and dementia brain banks and used as an ADGC case-control study of late-onset AD; the sources show the brain-bank sample sources and its use in AD case-control GWAS but the cached texts contain no sentence describing TGen's cases directly.

label: Transdisciplinary Research in Cancer of the Lung
note: A lung cancer genetic epidemiology consortium integrating lung cancer case-control GWAS (29,266 patients, 56,450 controls); smoking is studied as a risk factor but does not define the collection.

label: UK Millennium Cohort Study
quote: The UK Millennium Cohort Study (MCS) is an observational, multidisciplinary cohort study that was set up to follow the lives of children born at the turn of the new century.
note: A nationally representative UK birth cohort following children's health, development, education and social circumstances; a general birth cohort with no exposure or disease design purpose (its listing in the exposome catalogue does not change its design).

label: University Medical Center Groningen Head and Neck cancer Study
note: A prospective cohort of head and neck cancer patients treated with radiotherapy at UMCG and followed for radiation toxicity: a patient cohort; radiotherapy is a medical treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: University of Pittsburgh Alzheimer's Disease Research Center
note: Alzheimer disease cases and cognitively normal controls recruited by the University of Pittsburgh ADRC for GWAS of late-onset AD: a disease case-control cohort; no exposure basis.

label: Vanderbilt Memory & Aging Project
note: A case-control longitudinal study of vascular health and brain aging enrolling adults with mild cognitive impairment (a pre-dementia state) and matched cognitively normal controls to study pathways to Alzheimer's disease; no exposure basis.

label: Treatment of Pulmonary Hypertension and Sickle Cell Disease with Sildenafil Therapy
note: A cohort of sickle cell disease patients screened for pulmonary hypertension to assess eligibility for a sildenafil trial: a patient cohort; no exposure basis.

label: Wisconsin Epidemiologic Study of Diabetic Retinopathy
note: A population-based cohort of people with diabetes in southern Wisconsin followed for diabetic retinopathy and other complications: a patient cohort defined by diabetes; no exposure basis.

label: Washington Heights-Inwood Columbia Aging Project
quote: Established through several recruitment waves, participants were first recruited in 1992 from a random sample of Medicare‐eligible adults (aged ≥65 years) residing in the neighborhoods of Washington Heights and Inwood in northern Manhattan.
note: A random-sample population cohort of Medicare-eligible adults aged 65+ in northern Manhattan, described by its source as a study of aging and dementia; dementia is the stated disease focus, and no environmental exposure is a design purpose.

label: Han Chinese in Beijing, China
quote: These included all HapMap Phase I and II samples, along with further samples from the same four populations: individuals from the Centre d’Etude du Polymorphisme Humain collected in Utah, USA, with ancestry from northern and western Europe (CEU); Han Chinese in Beijing, China (CHB); Japanese in Tokyo, Japan (JPT); and Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI).
note: A HapMap/1000 Genomes reference population sample of unselected Han Chinese individuals in Beijing, used as a reference for human genetic variation; not selected for any disease or exposure.

label: Japanese in Tokyo, Japan
quote: These included all HapMap Phase I and II samples, along with further samples from the same four populations: individuals from the Centre d’Etude du Polymorphisme Humain collected in Utah, USA, with ancestry from northern and western Europe (CEU); Han Chinese in Beijing, China (CHB); Japanese in Tokyo, Japan (JPT); and Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI).
note: A HapMap/1000 Genomes reference population sample of unselected Japanese individuals in Tokyo, used as a reference for human genetic variation; not selected for any disease or exposure.

label: Rush Memory and Aging Project
quote: MAP started in 1997 and enrolls lay persons from across northeastern Illinois.
note: A clinical-pathologic cohort of older persons without dementia enrolled from retirement communities by the Rush Alzheimer's Disease Center; its stated purpose is chronic conditions of aging with an emphasis on Alzheimer's disease, so it is taken as a population study of that disease (medium: the purpose statement is broader than one disease). No exposure design.

label: Social Science Genetic Association Consortium
quote: The SSGAC is a cooperative enterprise among medical researchers and social scientists that coordinates genetic association studies for social science outcomes and provides a platform for interdisciplinary collaboration and cross-fertilization of ideas.
note: A consortium coordinating GWAS of social-science outcomes (educational attainment, income, occupational status) across contributing cohorts; socio-economic status by itself is not an environmental exposure and no disease is its subject.

label: Three-City Study
quote: Participants were recruited from three French cities: Bordeaux (South-West), Dijon (North-East) and Montpellier (South-East).
note: A population-based cohort of adults aged 65+ in three French cities set up to study the relation between vascular diseases and dementia; the source states that disease purpose directly. No exposure design.

label: Association STudy Evaluating RISK for sporadic colorectal cancer
note: A French case-control study of sporadic colorectal cancer whose cases are patients recruited in regional hospitals, with matched controls; a disease cohort in the patients role. Diet is measured in the GECCO gene-environment analyses but is not a design purpose of this study.

label: Aston Dyslexia Cohort
note: Children and adolescents referred by schools to the Aston Dyslexia and Developmental Assessment Unit for reading difficulties; the source tabulates the cohort as clinical (children with reading difficulties) and describes its cohorts as enriched for dyslexia, a neurodevelopmental disorder counted as a disease here. Medium because participants are referred for assessment rather than all diagnosed. No exposure.

label: Brescia Bladder Cancer Study
exposures: occupational exposure to aromatic amines (AAs) | occupational exposure to polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) | lifetime smoking
quote: Data were collected on lifetime smoking, coffee drinking, dietary habits and lifetime occupation, with particular reference to exposure to aromatic amines (AAs) and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs).
note: A hospital-based case-control study of male bladder cancer patients in Brescia designed around occupational exposure to aromatic amines and PAHs, smoking and other environmental risk factors, with lifetime occupational exposure assessment; a disease cohort (patients) that is also an occupational-exposure study. Medium for the exposure verdict since participants were selected by disease, not exposure.

label: Beijing Eye Study
quote: The Beijing Eye Study is a population-based study which included 4439 of 5324 subjects (aged > or = 40 years) who were initially examined in 2001.
note: A population-based ophthalmic study of adults aged 40+ in Greater Beijing measuring the prevalence, causes and risk factors of eye diseases and visual impairment; taken as a population study of one disease family (eye disease). No exposure design.

label: Biomarkers of Cognitive Decline Among Normal Individuals
note: Cognitively normal, mostly middle-aged adults enrolled from 1995 to study the earliest phases of Alzheimer's disease, about 75% recruited for having a first-degree relative with dementia; an at-risk disease cohort. No exposure.

label: French Prostate Cancer Case-Control Study
note: A hospital-based case-control study whose cases are histologically confirmed prostate cancer patients treated in French urology departments, with screened unaffected controls; a disease cohort in the patients role. No exposure.

label: Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood 2010
exposures: the human microbiome | maternal nutrition during pregnancy
quote: We hypothesize that perinatal exposures, in particular the human microbiome and maternal nutrition during pregnancy, interact with the genetic predisposition to cause an abnormal immune modulation in early life towards a trajectory to chronic inflammatory diseases such as asthma and others.
note: An unselected Danish mother-child birth cohort whose design centres on perinatal exposure assessment (the early microbiome, maternal diet, nested nutritional trials) and its effect on asthma, eczema and allergy; a population study of asthma/allergic disease that is also designed to study exposures. Medium because the exposures studied (microbiome, maternal diet) sit at the edge of the environmental-exposure scope.

label: Cohort of Swedish Men
exposures: food consumption (96-item food frequency questionnaire) | lifestyle factors
quote: In late fall 1997, 48,850 men (49% response rate) and 39,227 women (70% response rate) completed a 96-item food frequency questionnaire (FFQ) and answered questions about lifestyle factors (the questionnaires are available: https://www.simpler4health.se/researchers/questionnaires/).
note: A population-based cohort of all men born 1918-1952 in two central Swedish counties, enrolled through a food frequency questionnaire and lifestyle questions and used with the Swedish Mammography Cohort to study diet and lifestyle in relation to chronic disease; a diet cohort of the EPIC type (medium: the source shows the design rather than stating the purpose). Its outcomes span many chronic diseases, so no disease focus.

label: Czech Republic Colorectal Cancer Study
note: A hospital-based case-control study of colorectal cancer with cases collected at Czech oncology departments; a disease cohort in the patients role. Lifestyle data are covariates, not a design purpose.

label: Etude des Déterminants/Interaction de la Thrombose veineuse
note: A hospital-based case-control study at Brest enrolling consecutive patients with confirmed venous thromboembolism and matched hospital controls; a disease cohort in the patients role. The 'environmental risk factors' it assesses are clinical/acquired ones (cancer, statin use), not environmental agents, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Johannesburg Cancer Study
note: A case-control study enrolling Black patients with incident cancer of any type in Johannesburg, using patients with unrelated cancers as controls; a disease cohort in the patients role. It studies lifestyle and infection (HIV) risk factors for cancer, but the cohort is defined by disease and its risk-factor work is general cancer epidemiology, not an exposure design.

label: French Bladder Cancer Study
note: A hospital-based case-control study of bladder cancer in France (190 cases, 316 controls) tabulated among the International Consortium of Bladder Cancer studies; a disease cohort in the patients role. Smoking is a covariate in the consortium analyses, not a design purpose.

label: NCI Familial Testicular Cancer Study
note: An NCI Clinical Genetics Branch study enrolling families with two or more cases of testicular germ cell tumour, so both affected patients and their relatives (at-risk role chosen for the family-based design). No exposure.

label: GEnetic Factors for OSteoporosis Consortium
note: An international consortium pooling study populations with bone density and GWAS data to find genetic variants for osteoporosis and bone traits; its member cohorts are largely population studies, so it is classified as a population study of one disease. No exposure.

label: Human Early Life Exposome
exposure categories: air pollution | chemical | metal | pesticide | tobacco | diet | physical activity | noise | built environment | water | radiation | climate or weather
exposures: ambient air pollutants | road traffic noise levels | natural spaces green and blue spaces | built environment | ultraviolet (UV) radiation | meteorological variables | organochlorine compounds and brominated compounds | perfluoroalkyl substances | metals | phthalate metabolites | phenols | organophosphate pesticide metabolites | cotinine | drinking water disinfection by-products | environmental tobacco smoke | diet | physical activity
quote: The aim of the Human Early Life Exposome (HELIX) study was to measure and describe multiple environmental exposures during early life (pregnancy and childhood) in a prospective cohort and associate these exposures with molecular omics signatures and child health outcomes.
note: A European exposome cohort built across six population-based birth cohorts to measure chemical, air-pollution, noise, built-environment, UV, meteorological, water-contaminant and lifestyle exposures in pregnancy and childhood and relate them to omics and child health; an exposure cohort by stated design. Child health outcomes are broad (obesity, asthma, allergy, ADHD), so no disease focus.

label: Helix Exome+ and Healthy Nevada Project COVID-19 Phenotypes
note: The COVID-19 case-control phenotype set of participants sequenced with the Helix Exome+ assay, including the Healthy Nevada Project population health study, contributed to COVID-19 Host Genetics Initiative analyses; classified by the COVID-19 phenotypes the term represents (cases with controls), not by the underlying population study. Medium because the case definitions quoted are the HGI-wide ones applied to this data set. No exposure.

label: International Network Against Venous Thrombosis Consortium
note: A consortium meta-analysing GWAS of venous thromboembolism cases and controls from case-control and population studies; classified by what it collects (VTE cases). No exposure.

label: Los Angeles Bladder Cancer Study
note: A population-based case-control study of bladder cancer in Los Angeles County with neighbourhood controls; a disease cohort in the patients role. Smoking, hair dyes and diet are among many risk factors examined, but exposure is not a stated design purpose.

label: Influence of Life-style factors on Development of the Immune System and Allergies in East and West Germany plus Air Pollution and Genetics on Allergy Development
exposures: traffic emissions | life-style factors
quote: LISA The influence of Life-style factors on the development of the Immune System and Allergies in East and West Germany PLUS the influence of traffic emissions and genetics (LISAplus) Study is a population based birth cohort study.
note: A German population-based birth cohort of healthy term newborns whose name and design state its purpose: the influence of lifestyle factors and traffic emissions (air pollution) on immune development and allergic diseases; both an exposure cohort by design and a population study of allergic disease.

label: Mayo Clinic Venous Thromboembolism Study
note: Case-control study of adults with objectively diagnosed venous thromboembolism and age- and sex-matched controls at the Mayo Clinic; the participants were selected for the disease, and no environmental exposure defines them.

label: Multicase-Control Study in Spain
exposures: trihalomethanes in drinking water | nitrate in drinking water
quote: Long-Term Exposure to Nitrate and Trihalomethanes in Drinking Water and Prostate Cancer: A Multicase-Control Study in Spain (MCC-Spain)
note: Hospital-based multicase-control study of common cancers with population controls, so a disease cohort of patients (stated directly). The exposure verdict is indirect: the definition and the MCC-Spain papers cited in the bundle (drinking-water trihalomethanes and nitrate, swimming-pool attendance) show an environmental-exposure programme, but the rationale paper stating the study's aims (PMID 25613680) is not cached.

label: Microisolates in South Tyrol Study
quote: The MICROS study is a population-based survey on three small, isolated villages, characterized by: old settlement; small number of founders; high endogamy rates; slow/null population expansion.
note: Population-based survey of adult volunteers from three isolated Alpine villages, run for the genetic epidemiology of Mendelian and complex diseases in general; neither an exposure nor a single disease defines it.

label: MrOS Sweden
note: Randomly selected older men from the Swedish population register, followed with the stated main aim of identifying risk factors for osteoporosis and fracture: a population study of one disease, not an exposure cohort.

label: New England Bladder Cancer Study
exposures: trihalomethanes in drinking water | disinfection by-products | arsenic in water supply
quote: In New England, a trained study interviewer visited participants’ homes and administered a computer-assisted personal interview (CAPI) that elicited information on a variety of factors, including global positioning system (GPS) coordinates of the current residence, and a lifetime residential history that was used to reconstruct lifetime water source information.
note: Population-based case-control study of newly diagnosed bladder cancer in Maine, New Hampshire and Vermont (stated directly). The study reconstructed lifetime residential water-source histories to estimate trihalomethane, disinfection by-product and arsenic exposure, so drinking-water contaminants are part of its design, although no sentence in the bundle states the aim outright.

label: NINDS Parkinson's Disease dataset
note: Parkinson's disease patients and neurologically normal controls from the NINDS repository, genotyped for public release; a patient series with controls, no exposure involved.

label: NPDPSC pathology-confirmed rpAD
note: Autopsied cases referred to the National Prion Disease Pathology Surveillance Center with rapidly progressive dementia in whom prion disease was excluded and Alzheimer's disease confirmed; a pathology-confirmed patient series, no exposure involved.

label: Outcome Modifying Genes in Sickle Cell Disease
note: Cross-sectional cohort of adult sickle cell disease patients enrolled at sickle cell centres in the southeastern United States for genetic studies of clinical outcomes; a patient cohort, no exposure involved.

label: Oxford Parkinson's Disease Centre Discovery Cohort
note: Population-based incidence cohort of recently diagnosed Parkinson's disease patients recruited from Thames Valley hospitals and followed for progression and subtypes; a patient cohort, no exposure involved.

label: Australian Alcohol and Nicotine Studies
exposures: heavy smoking | alcohol dependence | heaviness of drinking
quote: Index cases from these families, their full siblings and parents were recruited for three coordinated studies: (i) the NAG (Nicotine Addiction Genetics) Study which ascertained heavy smoking index cases; (ii) the OZALC-EDAC study, which ascertained index cases with a history of alcohol dependence or scoring above the 85th centile for heaviness of drinking factor score
note: Australian twin-family sample whose index cases were ascertained as heavy smokers (NAG) or for alcohol dependence or heavy drinking (OZALC-EDAC), together with their siblings and parents; tobacco and alcohol use define the cohort, and alcohol and nicotine dependence, which count as addictions, are the conditions studied.

label: Parkinson's Disease Biomarkers Program
note: NINDS biomarker programme collecting longitudinal data and biosamples from Parkinson's disease patients, other parkinsonism and controls; a patient collection built around one disease, no exposure involved.

label: Pakistan Genomic Resource
quote: PGR is a growing biobank that aims to enroll 1 million participants across Pakistan and as of September 2023, ~250,000 participants across n = 48 clinical sites in n = 17 cities from all over Pakistan have been enrolled.
note: National biobank and consortium of case-control studies enrolling at clinical sites across Pakistan for some 50 diseases; its purpose is broad rather than one disease or disease family, and no exposure defines it.

label: Pharmacogenetics of Nicotine Addiction Treatment
exposures: cigarette smoking, at least 10 cigarettes per day
quote: PNAT2 participants were eligible adult smokers (report smoking at least 10 CPD) from four clinical sites in North America and were randomized to placebo, nicotine patch, or varenicline based on their NMR at intake.
note: Randomised smoking-cessation trial that enrolled treatment-seeking adult smokers of at least 10 cigarettes a day; smoking defines the cohort, and the participants have tobacco dependence, an addiction, for which they were being treated.

label: Riesgo de Enfermedad TROmboembólica VEnosa
note: Spanish case-control study of consecutive venous thromboembolism patients sampled after anticoagulant treatment, with healthy population controls; a disease cohort of patients, no exposure involved.

label: Recurrent Venous Thromboembolism Risk Stratification Evaluation
note: Multicentre prospective cohort of patients with a first unprovoked venous thromboembolism followed after stopping anticoagulation to predict recurrence; every participant has the disease, no exposure involved.

label: Suivi Temporaire Annuel Non-Invasif de la Santé des Lorrains Assurés Sociaux
quote: Subjects were considered healthy at the baseline visit (V1) with absence of any acute or chronic diseases, thereby allowing observation of the development of diseases and intermediary phenotypes.
note: Longitudinal family cohort of initially healthy people from the Lorraine region recruited at a preventive medicine centre and followed for cardiovascular and metabolic traits; healthy families with a broad trait focus rather than one disease, and no exposure defines them.

label: Strong Heart Study
note: Population cohort of American Indian adults recruited from tribal communities in four states; its design paper, cited in the bundled paper, is titled as a study of cardiovascular disease in American Indians, so it is a general population followed for one disease family, not an exposure cohort.

label: South London Ethnicity and Stroke Study
note: Consecutive black and white stroke patients admitted to three South London hospitals, with community controls, to study stroke subtypes and genetics in African-ancestry people; a patient series, no exposure involved.

label: SLI Consortium cohort
note: Nuclear families ascertained through a proband with specific language impairment, a developmental disorder, collected across the UK for linkage and association studies; the probands are affected cases and their relatives are included, and no exposure is involved.

label: US Servicemen's Testicular Tumor Environmental and Endocrine Determinants Study
exposures: environmental determinants of testicular germ cell tumours
quote: using existing data from the US Servicemen's Testicular Tumor Environmental and Endocrine Determinants (STEED) case-control study
note: Case-control study of testicular germ cell tumours among US servicemen with serum stored in the Department of Defense Serum Repository (stated directly); military service is only the sampling frame. Its name states that it was set up to study environmental and endocrine determinants, but the bundled paper concerns childhood infections and names no environmental agent, so the exposure verdict rests on the study's name and the definition.

label: Tromsø Study
quote: The Tromsø Study is a population-based study conducted in 1974 in the municipality of Tromsø, Norway.17 It consists of seven waves, known as Tromsø1 through Tromsø7, and a total of 45 473 people attended one or more surveys.
note: Repeated population-based health survey of the residents of Tromsø covering chronic diseases and their risk factors in general; a general population cohort with a broad purpose, no exposure or single disease defines it.

label: Texas Bladder Cancer Study
note: Hospital-based case-control study of newly diagnosed bladder cancer at MD Anderson and Baylor with matched controls; a disease cohort of patients, no exposure involved.

label: Asia Breast Cancer Consortium
note: Consortium of breast cancer genetic association studies in Asian women, pooling breast cancer cases and unaffected controls; an aggregation of disease case-control studies, no exposure involved.

label: Atrial Fibrillation Genetics Consortium
note: Consortium of case-control and population-based studies pooled for genome-wide association meta-analyses of atrial fibrillation, whose cases have atrial fibrillation or flutter; an aggregation built around one disease, no exposure involved.

label: ASPirin in Reducing Events in the Elderly
quote: The ASPREE was a large-scale placebo-controlled randomized trial (NCT01038583) of daily low-dose (100 mg) enteric-coated aspirin conducted in 19 114 adults aged over 70 years residing in Australia and the USA (≥ 65 years for US minorities) who had no prior cardiovascular events, dementia, or independence-limiting physical disability at trial enrolment.
note: Randomised trial of low-dose aspirin in initially healthy community-dwelling older adults without prior cardiovascular disease, dementia or disability, followed afterwards for healthy ageing; healthy volunteers, and aspirin is a medication rather than an environmental exposure.

label: Austrian Stroke Prevention Study
note: Community-based cohort of stroke- and dementia-free elderly people randomly drawn from the Graz community register and set up, as its name and its 1994 research-goals paper on cerebrovascular risk profiles state, to study the cerebral effects of vascular risk factors (white matter lesions, brain atrophy, cognition): a general elderly sample studied for one disease family, so a population study of disease rather than a patient series. Vascular risk factors are measured but no environmental exposure is a design purpose.

label: Austrian Stroke Prevention Family Study
note: Family-based extension of the Austrian Stroke Prevention Study (ASPS participants and their first-degree relatives) with the same protocol and purpose, the cerebral effects of vascular risk factors in people without stroke or dementia; it inherits the classification of ASPS. No environmental exposure is a design purpose.

label: B-Vitamins for the PRevention Of Osteoporotic Fractures
note: Randomized trial in people aged 65 and over selected for an elevated homocysteine concentration, the hypothesised fracture risk factor the trial targets, with osteoporotic fracture as the primary outcome: a group selected for fracture risk, hence at risk. The intervention is a vitamin supplement, not an environmental exposure. The trial calls its sample a general elderly population, so the verdict rests on the homocysteine selection criterion.

label: Canadian Partnership for Tomorrow's Health
note: Pan-Canadian confederation of regional general-population cohorts (about 300,000 volunteers aged 30 to 74) built as a research platform on genetics, behaviour and environment in cancer and other chronic diseases; environment is one measured factor among many and the disease purpose is broad, so no on both counts.

label: DeCOI cohort
note: Cohort of individuals with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection across the spectrum from asymptomatic to critical COVID-19, recruited at 16 sites for host-genetics whole genome sequencing; defined by the infection itself, a disease, not by exposure to an infectious agent while uninfected.

label: EU-RLS-GENE consortium
note: International consortium of restless legs syndrome case collections recruited by expert clinicians in movement-disorder and sleep clinics, with ancestry-matched controls, pooled for RLS GWAS: a disease consortium with no exposure design.

label: Familial Influences on Literacy Abilities
note: Dutch family dataset of children and adults tested for word and nonword reading fluency, phonological awareness and rapid naming to study genetic influences on reading and language: a quantitative-trait population dataset, not a disease or exposure cohort. Only the abstract is cached, so recruitment through a dyslexic proband cannot be excluded, but the paper calls it a population dataset.

label: Female Lung Cancer Consortium in Asia
quote: FLCCA is an international consortium focusing on never-smoking Asian women, with participating studies from Mainland China, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taiwan, South Korea, and Japan.
note: Consortium of lung cancer case-control studies of never-smoking Asian women pooled for lung cancer (mainly adenocarcinoma) GWAS: a disease consortium. Selection for never having smoked is the absence of an exposure and the stated aim is genetic risk, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: GlobalGout Genetics Consortium
note: International consortium of gout genetics groups whose own case-control sample set (people with clinically diagnosed or ARA-criteria gout and controls) was genotyped for a gout GWAS of 2.6 million people: a disease consortium with no exposure design.

label: Growing Up in Singapore Towards healthy Outcomes
quote: Briefly, the primary objective of the GUSTO study is to evaluate exposures and influences in early development on adverse metabolic functions and body composition later in life.
note: Singapore mother-offspring birth cohort of unselected pregnant women followed for how early-life influences (maternal nutrition, mental health and other developmental factors) shape later metabolic function, body composition and development: the 'exposures' are developmental-origins influences rather than environmental agents, and the outcomes are broad metabolic and developmental traits rather than one disease, so no on both counts.

label: Hawaii Adenoma Study
note: Case-control study of first-time colorectal adenoma on Oahu with cases from screening clinics and controls with normal endoscopy: the cases of a case-control study, hence patients; lifestyle exposures were collected by questionnaire among many risk factors, not as the design purpose.

label: Henry Ford Heart Failure Pharmacogenomic Registry
note: Prospective pharmacogenomic registry of Black and White patients with heart failure in the Henry Ford Health System, enrolled on a HF diagnosis and reduced ejection fraction: a patient registry; the only 'exposure' studied is beta-blocker medication, which is treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: HS Program for Research and Care Excellence
note: Cohort of hidradenitis suppurativa patients recruited at a university dermatology department for genetic association studies of the disease: a patient series with no exposure design.

label: IARC Multicenter Case-Control Study
note: Multicentre hospital-based case-control study of lung cancer in six Central European countries coordinated by IARC, whose genotyped cases and controls form the IARC lung cancer GWAS used by lung cancer consortia (the quote is the study's row in the meta-analysis table of lung cancer GWASs): the cases of a case-control study, hence patients. The cached texts describe no exposure-based design.

label: Identification and prevention of Dietary- and lifestyle-induced health EFfects In Children and infantS
exposures: diet | physical activity | lifestyle
quote: The European IDEFICS (Identification and prevention of Dietary- and lifestyle-induced health EFfects In Children and infantS)/I.Family cohort is a multi-centre population-based children’s study that aimed to identify risk factors for diet- and lifestyle-related diseases, with a focus on childhood overweight and metabolic disorders [14, 15].
note: Multi-centre population-based cohort of 16,228 European children whose stated purpose, carried in its name, is the health effects of diet and lifestyle, with a community obesity-prevention intervention on diet, physical activity and stress: designed to study lifestyle exposures, and a general-population cohort focused on one disease family (childhood overweight and metabolic disorders), hence a population study of disease.

label: Insulin Resistance Atherosclerosis Study
note: Multiethnic epidemiologic cohort of over 1,600 adults recruited to span normal, impaired and diabetic glucose tolerance, designed to relate directly measured insulin resistance to atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease and followed for conversion to type 2 diabetes: a cohort built around one cardiometabolic disease family, hence a population study of disease; no environmental exposure is a design purpose.

label: Personalized Medicine Research Project
note: Population-based biobank of about 20,000 adults around Marshfield, Wisconsin, with DNA and samples linked to electronic medical records for genetic and gene-environment research generally: unselected donors with no disease or exposure focus, so no on both counts.

label: MD Anderson Cancer Center lung cancer study
exposures: cigarette smoking (current and former smokers)
quote: In the discovery phase, we analyzed 315,450 tagging SNPs in 1,154 current and former (ever) smoking cases of European ancestry and 1,137 frequency-matched, ever-smoking controls from Houston, Texas.
note: Hospital-based case-control study of lung cancer at MD Anderson in which both cases and controls were restricted to current or former smokers: the cases make it a patient cohort (high confidence), and the ever-smoking inclusion criterion means participants were recruited as smokers, which the rules count as defined by exposure, though the restriction serves the genetic aim rather than studying smoking itself (hence medium).

label: MD Anderson Cancer Center melanoma study
note: Hospital-based case-control study of cutaneous melanoma at MD Anderson with non-Hispanic white patients and cancer-free companion controls, genotyped for melanoma GWAS: the cases of a case-control study, hence patients; no exposure design.

label: National Center for Geriatrics and Gerontology Biobank
note: Biobank of the National Center for Geriatrics and Gerontology hospital in Obu, Japan, holding DNA and clinical data from tens of thousands of registrants and used for dementia GWAS (late-onset Alzheimer's disease and dementia with Lewy bodies cases against cognitively normal controls from the hospital and a neighbourhood cohort). The cached texts do not say who registers with the biobank, whether dementia patients specifically or all patients of a geriatric hospital across age-related conditions, so it cannot be settled whether it is a disease biobank or a broad geriatric hospital biobank; no exposure design is described.

label: Nulliparous Pregnancy Outcomes Study: Monitoring Mothers-to-Be
note: Prospective multicentre cohort of 10,038 unselected nulliparous women recruited in the first trimester specifically to understand and predict adverse pregnancy outcomes (preterm birth, preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, pregnancy loss), which the paper calls diseases: an unselected pregnancy cohort whose stated purpose is one family of pregnancy complications, hence a population study of disease; pregnancy itself is not a disease, so the verdict rests on that purpose. No environmental exposure design.

label: Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort
note: Population-based cohort of youths aged 8 to 21 recruited through non-psychiatric paediatric clinics and assessed for brain development and cognition: a non-clinical developmental cohort with no disease or exposure focus, so no on both counts.

label: ProHealth Study
note: Kaiser Permanente Northern California study ascertaining African-American prostate cancer cases, genotyped with other KP cohorts for prostate cancer GWAS: a patient series with no exposure design.

label: Radiogenomics Consortium
note: International consortium of cohorts of cancer patients treated with radiotherapy, pooled to find genetic variants for radiation-induced normal-tissue toxicity: a consortium of patient cohorts. The ionising radiation is a medical treatment, which the rules exclude as an environmental exposure.

label: Study of Epidemiology and Risk Factors in Cancer Heredity
note: Population-based case-control study in East Anglia of people with cancer registered with the regional cancer registry and general-practice controls, contributing cases to the breast, ovarian, colorectal and prostate cancer consortia (BCAC, OCAC, GECCO, PRACTICAL): the cases of a case-control study of cancer heredity, hence patients; no exposure design.

label: SEARCH for Diabetes in Youth
quote: SEARCH for Diabetes in Youth is an observational, multicenter study focusing on physician-diagnosed diabetes in individuals <20 years old.
note: Multicentre US surveillance study that ascertains prevalent and incident cases of physician-diagnosed diabetes in people under 20 in defined populations and health plans; the participants are the diabetes cases, and no environmental exposure is part of the design.

label: Swedish Rheumatology Quality Register Biobank
quote: SRQb is an ongoing research project currently holding blood samples from >5500 RA patients, with either early RA or starting a bDMARD.
note: Biobank of blood samples from rheumatoid arthritis patients in the Swedish Rheumatology Quality Register, used for genetic and treatment-response studies; a patient collection with no exposure design.

label: Swedish Rheumatology Quality Register
quote: SRQ is a nationwide quality register established in the mid-1990s used by most rheumatologists in Sweden to monitor the disease course of patients as part of standard care.
note: Nationwide Swedish rheumatology quality register of patients monitored by rheumatologists in routine care, so a disease registry; the source names the patients only through the rheumatologists who monitor them (the paper uses its rheumatoid arthritis patients), so the disease family follows from the register's design.

label: Skåne University Hospital memory clinic cohort
quote: Skåne University Hospital, Sweden (SWEDEN) The samples included in this cohort were evaluated at memory disorder unit at Skåne University Hospital.
note: Clinical sample of patients evaluated at the memory disorder unit of Skåne University Hospital whose CSF Alzheimer's biomarkers entered a GWAS meta-analysis stratified into AD cases and controls; the supplement (not in the cache) states only the memory-clinic evaluation and the paper's acknowledgements call the Swedish clinical samples 'Clinical AD Sweden', so the AD label rests on that context and the definition. No exposure design.

label: Toledo Study for Healthy Aging
quote: Data were taken from the Toledo Study for Healthy Aging, a population-based study conducted on 2,488 individuals aged 65 years and older.
note: Population-based random sample of older adults in Toledo, Spain, set up to study frailty and healthy ageing; frailty syndrome is an ageing phenotype rather than a disease and the purpose is broad, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: Berlin Aging Study II
quote: Baseline recruitment of the BASE-II cohort was recently completed and has led to the sampling of 1600 older adults (age range 60-80 years), as well as 600 younger adults (20-35 years) serving as the basic population for in-depth analyses.
note: Multidisciplinary volunteer cohort of older and younger adults in Berlin studying factors of healthy versus unhealthy ageing across many domains; a general ageing cohort with no disease or exposure focus.

label: Rotterdam Study II
quote: In 2000, the RS was extended with a second subcohort (RS-II) of 3011 participants who moved to Ommoord or turned 55 years old.
note: Second population-based subcohort of the Rotterdam Study, enrolling district residents aged 55 and over to study chronic diseases of mid- and late life broadly; its listing in the Global Exposome Cohort Catalogue does not make exposure a stated design purpose.

label: MrOS Malmö
quote: In summary, participants were randomly selected from the Swedish national population register and invited by mail.
note: Malmö site of MrOS Sweden, a population-based sample of older men drawn from the national population register whose stated main aim is risk factors for osteoporosis and fracture; a population study of one disease, not an exposure cohort.

label: Longitudinal Aging Study Amsterdam
quote: The study started in 1992 with a nationally representative sample of older adults aged 55-84 years.
note: Nationally representative prospective cohort of older adults in the Netherlands describing trajectories of physical, cognitive, emotional and social functioning; a general ageing cohort with no disease or exposure focus.

label: Finnish Gestational Diabetes Study
quote: The prospectively collected case-control cohort consists of 1146 pregnant women with GDM and 1066 women without GDM, their children from the index pregnancy and the children’s fathers.
note: Finnish multicentre case-control study of women with and without gestational diabetes, their children and the fathers, plus a register arm, set up to study the causes and consequences of gestational diabetes; the cases define the cohort. No exposure design.

label: MrOS Gothenburg
quote: In summary, participants were randomly selected from the Swedish national population register and invited by mail.
note: Gothenburg site of MrOS Sweden, a population-based sample of older men drawn from the national population register whose stated main aim is risk factors for osteoporosis and fracture; a population study of one disease, not an exposure cohort.

label: African Ancestry Anthropometry Genetics Consortium
quote: We performed large scale meta-analyses and replications in up to 52,895 individuals for BMI and up to 23,095 individuals for WHRadjBMI from the African Ancestry Anthropometry Genetics Consortium (AAAGC) using 1000 Genomes phase 1 imputed GWAS to improve coverage of both common and low frequency variants in the low linkage disequilibrium African ancestry genomes.
note: Consortium of African-ancestry GWAS cohorts (BioMe, CARDIA, Cleveland Family Study, Maywood) meta-analysed for continuous anthropometric traits such as BMI and waist-hip ratio; adiposity is studied as a trait, not as a collection of obesity patients, and there is no exposure design.

label: Accelerating Medicines Partnership Parkinson's Disease
quote: The clinical diagnosis of participants in version 1 release includes 2005 idiopathic PD patients, 963 healthy controls, 64 prodromal subjects, 62 clinically diagnosed PD subjects without evidence of dopamine deficit, and 705 participants of genetically enriched cohorts carrying PD risk-associated GBA variants or LRRK2 variants, of whom 304 were affected.
note: Programme harmonising Parkinson's disease cohorts (PPMI, PDBP, Harvard Biomarkers Study, BioFIND) whose participants are mainly PD patients with controls, prodromal subjects and GBA/LRRK2 carriers; a disease aggregation with no exposure design.

label: Salus in Apulia Study
quote: Participants of the present study were recruited from the electoral rolls of Castellana Grotte, Bari, Southern Italy.
note: Population-based cohort of older adults drawn from the electoral rolls of Castellana Grotte, Apulia, to study ageing, frailty and cognitive decline broadly; a general ageing cohort, not a disease or exposure cohort.

label: Beijing Atherosclerosis Study
quote: BAS study consisted of 505 cases of MI and 1,021 controls.
note: Han Chinese case-control collection from Beijing of myocardial infarction cases with community controls, assembled for genetic studies of coronary artery disease; the cases define it and there is no exposure design.

label: BIObanks Netherlands Internet Collaboration
quote: We conducted a genome-wide association (GWAS) mega-analysis of DSM-defined lifetime major depressive disorder (MDD) in 64 941 participants (25.7% cases) from the Dutch BIObanks Netherlands Internet Collaboration (BIONIC) consortium.
note: Dutch consortium pooling sixteen mostly population (and some clinical, e.g. NESDA) cohorts given uniform DSM-based depression phenotyping for a case-control mega-analysis of MDD; its single stated purpose is one disease, so a population study of disease. No exposure design.

label: Bone Mineral Density in Childhood Study
quote: Participants included 1554 healthy children (761 male, 793 female), ages 6-16 yr, of all ethnicities.
note: Longitudinal study of healthy children at five US centres measured annually by DXA to produce bone density reference curves; healthy volunteers about growth, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: Canadian Breast Cancer Study
quote: In brief, the Canadian Breast Cancer Study, a population-based case-control study, invited women with in situ or invasive breast cancer, diagnosed from April 2005 to May 2009 [12].
note: Population-based case-control study of women with in situ or invasive breast cancer in Vancouver and Kingston with matched controls; the cases define it, and lifestyle factors are covariates rather than a stated exposure design.

label: NIHR Cambridge BioResource
quote: Donors registered with National Health Service Blood and Transplant (NHSBT) were invited to join the National Institute for Health Research BioResource, a cohort of volunteers who have consented to be recalled for studies by genotype.
note: Panel of healthy volunteers in Cambridge, largely blood donors, consenting to recall by genotype or phenotype; a biobank of unselected donors with no disease or exposure focus.

label: Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1 and BRCA2
quote: CIMBA contains about 30 affiliated groups who together have collected DNA and clinical data from approximately 10,000 BRCA1 and 5,000 BRCA2 mutation carriers.
note: International consortium collecting BRCA1 and BRCA2 mutation carriers to find genetic modifiers of breast and ovarian cancer risk; participants are selected as high-risk carriers (many affected), so an at-risk disease aggregation with no exposure design.

label: UROMOL project
quote: Here, we report an integrative multi-omics analysis of NMIBC tumors from a total of 834 patients included in the UROMOL project.
note: European multicentre prospective series of patients with non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer with tumour multi-omics, germline genotypes and follow-up; a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: Cardiometabolic Risk in Chinese Study
quote: In the cardiometabolic risk in Chinese (CRC) study, we performed a community-based health examination survey for 6,431 individuals (18-93y) who were randomly selected from residents living in the urban area of Xuzhou, China, in 2009.
note: Community-based health examination survey of randomly selected, apparently healthy urban residents of Xuzhou studying cardiometabolic risk factors (insulin resistance, hypertension, early atherosclerosis); a general population survey with a broad risk-factor purpose rather than one disease, and no exposure design.

label: Cooperative Research Centre Cohort
quote: Participants were included if they: (1) were aged 18 years or older, (2) had a primary diagnosis of schizophrenia spectrum disorder (SSD), and (3) were using clozapine (no minimum duration of treatment).
note: Australian cohort of clozapine-treated patients with schizophrenia spectrum disorder recruited around Melbourne for pharmacogenomic studies of treatment outcome; a patient cohort, and clozapine treatment is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: Consortium for Refractive Error and Myopia
quote: Thus, we conducted the largest GWAS meta-analysis of CC to date, incorporating both European and Asian cohorts in a single analysis from the Consortium for Refractive Error and Myopia (CREAM) and validated our findings in the United Kingdom (UK) Biobank.
note: International consortium pooling population and clinical eye cohorts (Beaver Dam Eye Study, AREDS, ANZRAG) for GWAS of refractive error, myopia and ocular biometry; myopia, an eye disorder, is its stated subject, though the analysed phenotypes are continuous ocular traits, so borderline with a trait consortium. No exposure design.

label: Doetinchem Cohort Study
exposures: lifestyle | smoking | physical activity | alcohol consumption | nutrition
quote: Originated from a monitoring study on cardiovascular disease risk factors, the Doetinchem Cohort study has been expanded to a study on lifestyle and other determinants of chronic conditions and ageing, with individual data covering 25 years.
note: Population-based RIVM cohort of Doetinchem inhabitants that began as cardiovascular risk-factor monitoring and is now explicitly a study of lifestyle (smoking, physical activity, alcohol, nutrition) and other determinants of chronic conditions and ageing, so lifestyle exposure is a stated design purpose, though shared with other determinants; its disease purpose (chronic conditions, ageing) is broad.

label: Genes-environments & Admixture in Latino Americans
exposures: environmental basis of childhood-onset asthma
quote: GALA II and SAGE are two clinic-based case-control studies focused on untangling the genetic and environmental basis of childhood-onset asthma disease in minority ethnic groups of the United States of America [22].
note: GALA II is a clinic-based case-control study of Latino children and young adults with and without physician-diagnosed asthma, so it is a disease cohort (direct statement). Its stated aim is the genetic and environmental basis of childhood asthma, which makes exposure a declared design purpose, but the bundle names no specific exposures for GALA II, so the exposure verdict is medium and the category is 'other'.

label: Groningen Expert Center for Kids with Obesity Drenthe study
quote: The GECKO (Groningen Expert Center for Kids with Obesity) Drenthe study is a population-based birth cohort with a focus on early risk factors for overweight and obesity.
note: GECKO Drenthe is a population-based Dutch birth cohort whose stated focus is early risk factors for overweight and obesity, a single disease focus in a general birth cohort. Lifestyle behaviours (diet, activity, screen time, sleep) are studied as risk factors but exposure is not the organising principle, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: Genes and Environment in Multiple Sclerosis
exposures: environmental exposures and lifestyle factors | smoking | passive smoking | alcohol | sun exposure | combustion-related air pollution
quote: GEMS and EIMS are nationwide case-control studies examining the genetic and environmental risk factors for prevalent and incident MS, respectively.
note: GEMS is a Swedish population-based case-control study of prevalent multiple sclerosis drawn from the national MS registry, so a patient cohort. Its declared aim is genetic and environmental risk factors, with a dedicated questionnaire on environmental exposures and lifestyle factors (smoking, passive smoking, alcohol, sun exposure) and residential air-pollution assessment, so exposure is a stated design purpose alongside genetics; medium because the design is disease-first.

label: Georgia Stress and Heart Study
quote: All participants were recruited using family health history questionnaires obtained from a county-wide (Richmond County, Georgia) public school screening of children in kindergarten through grade 8 whose families were interested in health research.
note: GSH is a longitudinal cohort of normotensive children recruited by public-school screening and followed into adulthood; its stated design is to evaluate the development of cardiovascular risk factors, one disease family, so it is a population study of cardiovascular disease. Psychosocial stress and lifestyle are covariates, not environmental exposures defining the cohort.

label: Health and Ageing in Africa: A Longitudinal Study of an INDEPTH Community in South Africa
quote: Socio-demographic data, infection history, and cognitive performance data were collected from 5059 consented participants (male (n = 2345) and female (n = 2714)) aged 40 years and older recruited from Bushbuckridge, Mpumalanga (November 2014 to November 2015) and a sub-set of 2246 of these participants (male (n = 935) and female (n = 1311)) had genotype data.
note: HAALSI is a population-based study of adults aged 40 and over in a rural South African surveillance area, collecting health and ageing data; a broad health-and-ageing purpose with no exposure or disease selection.

label: Agincourt Health and Socio-demographic Surveillance System
quote: The HDSS (90 000 people), based on an annual update of resident status and vital events, now supports multiple investigations into the causes and consequences of complex health, population and social transitions.
note: The Agincourt HDSS is a whole-population health and demographic surveillance system in rural South Africa supporting many studies of health, population and social transitions; neither exposure nor disease defines it.

label: Health2006 Study
quote: Health2006 is a population-based epidemiological study of general health, diabetes and cardiovascular disease of 3,471 individuals aged 18–74 years [48].
note: Health2006 is a random population sample from the Danish civil register studied for general health, allergy, diabetes and cardiovascular disease: a broad general-population purpose covering several disease areas, so not a disease cohort, and exposures are not a design focus.

label: Heidelberger Langzeitstudie zu Risikofaktoren und Diagnose chronischer Erkrankungen
quote: Briefly, HeiDE (‘Heidelberger Langzeitstudie zu Risikofaktoren und Diagnose chronischer Erkrankungen’) is a population-based study carried out in the German city of Heidelberg and surrounding area with an initial aim of characterising associations of personality and somatic disease.
note: HeiDE is a population-based cohort of Heidelberg adults assessed for health-related personality traits and followed for chronic (somatic) disease in general; a broad chronic-disease purpose and no environmental exposure focus.

label: Heart Failure Molecular Epidemiology for Therapeutic Targets Consortium
quote: The HERMES (HEart failure Molecular Epidemiology for Therapeutic targetS) consortium aims to identify the genomic and molecular basis of heart failure.
note: HERMES is a consortium of 51 studies pooling heart failure cases (with controls) from population cohorts, EHR cohorts, case-control studies and trials for heart failure genetics, so a disease aggregation classified by what it collects; no exposure focus.

label: International Glaucoma Genetics Consortium
quote: The IGGC is a large international consortium established to identify glaucoma genetic risk genes through large-scale meta-analysis43,44.
note: The IGGC is an international consortium meta-analysing primary open-angle glaucoma case-control GWAS and glaucoma endophenotypes, so a disease aggregation; nothing about environmental exposure.

label: International HIV Controllers Study
quote: To determine the genetic basis for this rare phenomenon, we established a multinational consortium (www.hivcontrollers.org) to recruit HIV-1 controllers, who are defined by at least three measurements of plasma virus load (VL) < 2000 RNA copies/ml over at least a 12-month period in the absence of antiviral therapy.
note: The International HIV Controllers Study recruits people living with HIV-1 who spontaneously control viral load, for host genetics of HIV control; participants are selected by infection status (a disease), not as exposed-uninfected, so it is a patient cohort and not an exposure cohort.

label: Immunomodulation and Multiple Sclerosis Epidemiology
quote: Current projects include an incidence cohort (EIMS), post-marketing cohorts of patients on novel disease-modifying drugs (IMSE), and a prevalence cohort (GEMS).
note: IMSE is a set of Swedish phase IV post-marketing cohorts of multiple sclerosis patients treated with disease-modifying drugs, followed through the Swedish MS registry; a patient cohort whose only 'exposure' is medication, which is out of scope.

label: International Parkinson Disease Genomics Consortium
quote: This work has centered on available genome wide SNP genotyping of IPDGC members case and control cohorts from the USA, Canada, England, Wales, The Netherlands, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Austria, Finland, Norway, Estonia, and Australia (Fig. 1).
note: The IPDGC pools Parkinson disease case and control cohorts worldwide for collaborative genetics research, so a disease aggregation; no exposure focus.

label: Japan PGx Data Science Consortium Database
quote: The database contains the genotypes of 2.5 million single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and 5 human leukocyte antigen loci from 2994 Japanese healthy volunteers, as well as 121 kinds of clinical information, including self-reports, physiological data, hematological data and biochemical data.
note: The JPDSC database is a collection of 2994 healthy Japanese volunteers assembled as control data for pharmacogenomics studies: healthy volunteers, no disease and no exposure selection.

label: Justification for the Use of Statins in Prevention: an Intervention Trial Evaluating Rosuvastatin
quote: JUPITER was a randomized, double‐blind, placebo‐controlled trial of rosuvastatin 20 mg daily versus placebo in the primary prevention of CVD in 17 802 asymptomatic men ≥50 years and women ≥60 years with low‐density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL‐C) <130 mg/dL and hsCRP (high‐sensitivity C‐reactive protein) ≥2.0 mg/L who were monitored for a median follow‐up period of 1.9 years (maximum 5 years).
note: JUPITER is a primary-prevention statin trial in asymptomatic older adults selected for elevated high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (chronic inflammation), a cardiovascular risk marker, so participants were chosen for their risk of cardiovascular disease rather than having it. The only intervention is a medication, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: KOALA Birth Cohort Study
exposures: lifestyle | anthroposophy | dietary habits (organic, vegetarian) | breastfeeding and breast milk composition | infections during the first year of life
quote: The aim of the KOALA Birth Cohort Study in the Netherlands is to identify factors that influence the clinical expression of atopic disease with a main focus on lifestyle (e.g., anthroposophy, vaccinations, antibiotics, dietary habits, breastfeeding and breast milk composition, intestinal microflora composition, infections during the first year of life, and gene-environment interaction).
note: KOALA is a Dutch birth cohort set up to identify factors influencing atopic disease, so a population study of one disease family (direct statement). Its design centres on lifestyle exposures, recruiting an 'alternative lifestyle' group (organic or vegetarian diet, anthroposophy, no vaccination or antibiotics) for contrast with conventional families, which makes lifestyle exposure a stated design purpose; medium because these are lifestyle rather than classical environmental agents.

label: Mayo Clinic Breast Cancer Study
quote: The Mayo Clinic Breast Cancer Study (MCBCS) is an on-going clinic-based case-control study initiated in February 2001 at Mayo Clinic, Rochester, MN.
note: MCBCS is a clinic-based case-control study of women with invasive breast cancer and cancer-free controls at Mayo Clinic, so a patient cohort; no exposure focus.

label: Mayo Mammography Health Study
quote: The MMHS prospectively enrolled patients scheduled for a screening mammogram from October 2003 through September 2006 at the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, MN.
note: MMHS is a prospective cohort of women without prior breast cancer enrolled at routine screening mammography, established to study mammographic density and breast cancer risk (it is a BCAC member). Participants are an unselected screening population, so the role is population study of one disease rather than patients or at risk; no exposure focus.

label: North American Rheumatoid Arthritis Consortium
quote: The North American Rheumatoid Arthritis Consortium, using well-defined clinical criteria, has collected 257 families containing 301 affected sibling pairs with RA.
note: NARAC is a collection of multiplex rheumatoid arthritis families (affected sibling pairs) later extended with RA case-control collections, so a patient cohort; no exposure focus.

label: National Biobank of Korea
quote: As of December 2011, a total of 525,416 biospecimens with related information have been secured: 325,952 biospecimens from the general population obtained through cohort studies and 199,464 biospecimens of patients from regional biobanks.
note: The National Biobank of Korea is the national hub biobank holding general-population cohort samples (KoGES) and hospital patient samples across many diseases; a broad biobank aggregation with neither a single disease nor an exposure focus.

label: Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study
quote: The NSHDS is a population-based prospective longitudinal cohort comprising >140 000 participants in the two northernmost regions in Sweden, Norrbotten and Västerbotten, with >240 000 blood samples and 1.5 million person-years of follow-up.
note: NSHDS is a population-based prospective cohort combining the Västerbotten Intervention Programme, Northern Sweden MONICA and the Mammography Screening Project. The cohort profile says it was initiated with a cancer focus to complement the cardiovascular focus of VIP and MONICA, so as a whole its purpose spans cancer, cardiovascular and other diseases: a broad health-and-disease cohort rather than a study of one disease; no exposure focus.

label: Ontario Familial Breast Cancer Registry
quote: Epidemiology questionnaire data are available for 6779 affected probands (with a personal history of breast cancer), 4116 unaffected probands, and 16,526 relatives with or without a personal history of breast or ovarian cancer.
note: The OFBCR is the Ontario site of the Breast Cancer Family Registry, enrolling women with invasive breast cancer identified through the Ontario Cancer Registry together with their relatives and population controls; the registry is built around affected probands (relatives are at risk), so patients, breast cancer. The quote describes the whole registry of which Ontario is a site. No exposure focus.

label: Prolonged Anticoagulation During eighteen months vs placebo after Initial Six-month treatment for a first episode of idiopathic Pulmonary Embolism
quote: 371 adult patients who had experienced a first episode of symptomatic unprovoked pulmonary embolism (ie, with no major risk factor for thrombosis) and had been treated initially for 6 uninterrupted months with a vitamin K antagonist were randomized and followed up between July 2007 and September 2014 in 14 French centers.
note: PADIS-PE is a randomised trial of extended anticoagulation in adults after a first unprovoked pulmonary embolism, so all participants have the disease; the only exposure is a medication, which is out of scope.

label: Polish Breast Cancer Study
quote: Incident cases from 2000–2003 identified through a rapid identification system in participating hospitals covering ∼90% of all eligible cases; periodic check against the cancer registries in Warsaw and Łódź to assure complete identification of cases
note: The Polish Breast Cancer Study is a population-based case-control study of incident breast cancer in Warsaw and Lodz (the quote is its entry in a table of breast cancer case series), so a patient cohort; no exposure focus.

label: Predicting Risk Of Cancer At Screening
quote: We recruited women (aged 47–73 years) into the PROCAS (Predicting Risk Of Cancer At Screening; Manchester, UK: 2009–2013) Study.
note: PROCAS recruited women attending routine NHS breast screening in Greater Manchester, collecting risk-factor questionnaires and breast density to predict breast cancer risk; an unselected screening population studied for one disease, so population study of breast cancer (the name states the purpose). No exposure focus.

label: Qingdao Twin Registry
quote: Over 11,000 pairs of twins and multiples of all ages have been recruited into the registry.
note: A registry of twins and multiples of all ages in Qingdao, sampled for heritability and gene-environment studies of chronic disease, metabolic disorders, health behaviours and ageing. A twin registry with a broad chronic-disease remit is neither an exposure nor a disease cohort; tobacco and alcohol use are studied as outcomes among many, not a recruitment basis.

label: Chinese National Twin Registry
quote: Materials and Methods Study Sample All participants were recruited from the Chinese National Twin Registry (CNTR), the first established, largest population-based twin registry in China.
note: A population-based twin registry of over 61,000 twin pairs from 11 Chinese provinces used to analyse genetic and environmental influences on chronic diseases, especially cardiovascular. The remit is broad and the participants are unselected twins, so no on both counts; sampling disease-concordant and discordant pairs for specimens does not make the registry a disease cohort.

label: Reproductive Genetics Consortium
quote: The ReproGen consortium is an international network of investigators interested in better understanding the genetic basis of reproductive ageing.
note: A GWAS meta-analysis consortium on reproductive ageing and timing (age at menarche, age at natural menopause) across many population cohorts. Menopause and reproductive timing are normal variation, not disease, and no environmental exposure is its subject.

label: Singapore and Sweden Breast Cancer Study
quote: The Singapore and Sweden Breast Cancer Study (SASBAC) is a population-based case-control study of postmenopausal breast cancer in women aged 50 to 74 years born in Sweden.
note: A population-based case-control study of postmenopausal breast cancer in Sweden (also CAHRES, Cancer Hormone Replacement Epidemiology in Sweden), with incident cases from the cancer registries and population controls. The cases make it a disease cohort; hormone replacement therapy is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: Samuel Lunenfeld Research Institute Study
note: The Toronto lung cancer study of the Samuel Lunenfeld Research Institute, listed in Table 1 of the TRICL meta-analysis as a hospital-based case-control study of 331 lung cancer cases and 499 controls, and described as the lung cancer study from Canada (University of Toronto and Samuel Lunenfeld Research Institute). Smoking is analysed as a covariate, not a recruitment basis.

label: Seoul National University Bundang Hospital cohort
quote: The Seoul National University Bundang Hospital (SNUBH) cohort comprises 1,216 participants, consisting of 610 patients with GC and 606 non-cancer controls, with ages ranging from 26 to 80 years, who were recruited from the enrolled participants who visited the Digestive Disease Center, SNUBH.
note: A hospital-based case-control cohort of gastric cancer patients and non-cancer controls at the Digestive Disease Center of SNUBH, Korea, genotyped to study gastric cancer risk by histological type and sex. Helicobacter pylori status and smoking are adjustment covariates, not the recruitment basis.

label: Tohoku Medical Megabank Community-Based Cohort Study
exposures: Great East Japan Earthquake
quote: We established a community-based cohort study to assess the long-term impact of the Great East Japan Earthquake on disaster victims and gene-environment interactions on the incidence of major diseases, such as cancer and cardiovascular diseases.
