note: A community cohort of adults living in Miyagi and Iwate Prefectures, the areas devastated by the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake, established to assess the long-term impact of the disaster on its victims (with disaster-effect and psychological-distress data) alongside gene-environment interactions. Residents of a disaster area followed for that exposure; the disease remit (cancer, cardiovascular disease) is broad, so not a disease cohort.

label: Tohoku Medical Megabank Project Birth and Three-Generation Cohort Study
exposures: Great East Japan Earthquake (GEJE) and subsequent tsunami
quote: In this study, we collected in utero and subsequent exposure and outcome information, including disaster-related information, of newborns and other family members.
note: A birth and three-generation cohort of pregnant women, their fetuses and extended families in Miyagi Prefecture, run by the Tohoku Medical Megabank Project, which the profile says was established because of concern about the middle- and long-term health impacts of the 2011 earthquake and tsunami on affected people; the cohort records personal GEJE experience and disaster-related information. A disaster-area cohort, though its main stated purpose is genome and omics study of disease risk across generations, hence medium; that broad remit is not a disease focus.

label: TRacking Adolescents' Individual Lives Survey Clinical Cohort
note: The TRAILS clinical cohort: 543 Dutch children referred to a child psychiatric outpatient clinic before age 11 (predominantly ADHD, disruptive behaviour and autism-spectrum diagnoses), followed alongside the TRAILS population cohort. A patient series of child psychiatric disorders; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Taiwan-US Diabetic Retinopathy Study
note: A Taiwanese collection of Chinese people with type 2 diabetes, with (124) and without (654) severe non-proliferative or proliferative diabetic retinopathy, assembled 1996-2011 for genetic studies of diabetic retinopathy (Table 1 of the pooled Mendelian randomization paper). The quoted case and control definition applies to all 18 DR GWAS in that paper, TUDR among them, hence medium; all participants are diabetic patients.

label: Breakthrough Generations Study
quote: The Breakthrough Generations Study is a long-term prospective cohort study focussed on potential aetiological factors for breast cancer in women.
note: A UK general-population cohort of 112,049 women (and some men) recruited by generational referral from 2003, with repeated questionnaires and blood samples, whose stated purpose is breast cancer aetiology. A general population cohort set up for one disease; endogenous and exogenous risk factors are studied, but no environmental agent defines the design.

label: DiaGene Study
note: A prospective cohort of 1886 patients with type 2 diabetes from primary care and outpatient clinics in Eindhoven, with 854 diabetes-free controls, studying the aetiology and vascular complications of type 2 diabetes. Patients with one disease; no exposure basis.

label: Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood
note: The Danish COPSAC programme collects two mother-child birth cohorts built around childhood asthma: COPSAC2000, 411 children of mothers with doctor-diagnosed asthma (a high-risk cohort), and COPSAC2010, 700 children of unselected mothers followed for the same asthma remit. Classified by the at-risk member and the programme's single disease focus; nothing environmental defines recruitment.

label: ProHealth Kaiser GWAS
note: A GWAS sample assembled from Kaiser Permanente studies (RPGEH, the ProHealth Study and the California Men's Health Study) for prostate cancer cases, with GERA men without a prostate cancer diagnosis as controls. An aggregation built around prostate cancer cases; no exposure basis.

label: Genetics of Pancreatic Beta-cell Failure in Mexican-Americans
note: A family study of Mexican Americans in Los Angeles designed to find genetic determinants of pancreatic beta-cell function, within the GUARDIAN diabetes consortium: probands are non-diabetic women with prior gestational diabetes, a group at high risk of type 2 diabetes, with their relatives and women without GDM as comparison. At-risk selection follows from the design; no exposure basis.

label: Gene-Lifestyle Interactions in Dental Endpoints
note: A consortium of population cohorts (ARIC, SHIP, NFBC1966, MDC, TWINGENE, HCHS/SOL, WGHS, BBJ) and dental registries formed to meta-analyse GWAS of dental caries and periodontitis. Classified by its dental-disease remit, like a meta-analysis consortium on one topic; despite the word lifestyle in its name, the described work is genetic association on dental endpoints, not exposure measurement, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Harvard Aging Brain Study
note: A longitudinal study of cognitively normal older volunteers (CDR 0, MMSE above 25) in Boston with amyloid PET, MRI and cognitive testing, whose single stated purpose is preclinical Alzheimer's disease. Participants are neither patients nor selected for elevated risk, so population study of one disease; no exposure basis.

label: Hong Kong Osteoporosis Study
note: A prospective cohort of community-dwelling Southern Chinese adults in Hong Kong recruited 1995-2010 and set up to study osteoporosis and fracture, followed through territory-wide electronic health records. A community cohort with one disease family as its purpose; coffee intake and other exposures are analysed but do not define the design.

label: Study of Asthma Phenotypes and Pharmacogenomic Interactions by Race-Ethnicity
note: Henry Ford Health System members aged 12-56 in metropolitan Detroit enrolled with and without a clinical diagnosis of asthma (per the definition) to study asthma phenotypes and pharmacogenomics across racial and ethnic groups; the food-allergy paper adjusts for asthma status within the cohort. The study's name states the disease, but the supplementary file describing recruitment is not cached, so the with/without-asthma design rests on the definition, hence medium.

label: South Asian Birth Cohort
quote: The South Asian Birth Cohort Study (START) will investigate the environmental and genetic basis of adiposity among 750 South Asian offspring recruited from highly divergent environments, namely, rural and urban India and urban Canada.
note: A birth cohort of pregnant South Asian women free of significant chronic disease and their offspring in rural and urban India and Canada, studying determinants of adiposity and related metabolic abnormalities. Adiposity is a trait, and the type 2 diabetes motivation is background rather than the design, so not a disease cohort; the environment studied is rural/urban setting, diet, activity and the intrauterine milieu, not environmental agents, so not an exposure cohort.

label: TRanslational Initiative on Unique and novel strategies for Management of Patients with Heart failure
note: An observational prospective cohort of 496 patients admitted with acute heart failure to 14 Dutch hospitals, with repeated blood sampling over a year to validate prognostic biomarkers. A patient series; no exposure basis.

label: Australian Stroke Genetics Collaborative
note: A case-control GWAS sample of 1,162 ischemic stroke patients admitted to four Australian hospitals 2003-2008 and 1,244 population controls from the Hunter Community Study. The cases make it a disease cohort; no exposure basis.

label: Early Growth Genetics Consortium
quote: The Early Growth Genetics (EGG) Consortium exists to facilitate joint analysis of genetic data from multiple studies in order to identify human genomic loci that impact a variety of human traits related to early growth (fetus to young adult).
note: A GWAS meta-analysis consortium of population and birth cohorts on early growth traits: birth weight and length, gestational duration, head circumference, childhood BMI and pubertal growth. Growth traits are not a disease (childhood obesity is one trait among them, not the defining subject) and no exposure is its subject.

label: Oxford Vascular Study
note: A population-based incidence study in which every patient presenting with an acute vascular event (transient ischaemic attack, stroke, coronary and peripheral events) in a defined Oxfordshire population of 92,728 has been ascertained and followed since 2002. The followed cohort is the patients with vascular disease; no exposure basis.

label: Prospective Epidemiological Risk Factor Study
quote: PERF is comprised of 5855 post-menopausal Danish women, enrolled at baseline (PERF I) between 1999 and 2001.
note: An observational cohort of 5855 postmenopausal Danish women who had earlier taken part in trials or screenings at the Center for Clinical and Basic Research, followed through the Danish registries to identify risk factors for age-related diseases. Menopause is not a disease and the remit is broad, so no on both counts; no exposure basis.

label: Multiethnic Genome-wide Scan of Prostate Cancer
quote: Cases of cancer within these men were identified by annual linkage to the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) registries in California and Hawaii.
note: A nested case-control GWAS of incident invasive prostate cancer within the Multiethnic Cohort, with participants selected as SEER-identified prostate cancer cases and matched controls, so a disease cohort. The parent MEC is a diet-and-health cohort, but this sub-study's design is genetic case-control and has no exposure purpose of its own.

label: Army Study to Assess Risk and Resilience in Servicemembers
exposures: Army service
quote: in 2008 the US Army and US National Institute of Mental Health funded the Army Study to Assess Risk and Resilience in Servicemembers (Army STARRS), a multicomponent epidemiological and neurobiological study of risk and resilience factors for suicidal thoughts and behaviors, and their psychopathological correlates among Army personnel.
note: Epidemiological study of US Army soldiers (new recruits, active-duty soldiers and deploying combat teams) set up to find risk and resilience factors for suicidal behaviour and related mental disorders. Military service defines the participants, and the stated purpose is one disease family, so both verdicts are yes.

label: Barbados Asthma Genetics Study
quote: Pediatric probands were recruited through referrals at local polyclinics or the Accident and Emergency Department at the Queen Elizabeth Hospital, and their nuclear and extended family members were subsequently recruited.
note: Family-based asthma genetics study of paediatric asthmatic probands referred from clinics and their nuclear and extended families in Barbados. House dust endotoxin was measured in one analysis, but the design is a disease family study, not an exposure cohort.

label: CECILE Breast Cancer Study
exposures: organochlorine compounds (DDE, PCB153) | lifetime occupational history
quote: Plasma levels of the OCs p,p'-dichlorodiphenyl dichloroethene (DDE) and polychlorinated biphenyl congener 153 (PCB153) were measured in 695 cases and 1055 controls of a population-based case-control study conducted in France (CECILE study).
note: Population-based case-control study of breast cancer in two French départements: a patient cohort (high confidence). The bundle shows it measures organochlorine pollutants in cases and controls, records lifetime occupational and residential history and is funded by the environmental and occupational health agency, and the definition says it studies occupational and environmental risk factors, but no source in the bundle states that aim, so the exposure verdict rests on indirect evidence.

label: Cardiovascular Health Improvement Project
quote: Participants were recruited to the Cardiovascular Health Improvement Project (CHIP), a longitudinal cardiovascular biobank within the Michigan Medicine Frankel Cardiovascular Center, initiated in 2013; biobank recruitment is ongoing [15].
note: Longitudinal cardiovascular biobank of patients treated at the Michigan Medicine Frankel Cardiovascular Center, recruiting mainly patients with aortic disease: a patient biobank of one disease family, with no exposure design.

label: GENetic and clinical Predictors Of treatment response in Depression
quote: The GenPod trial is a multi-centre randomised controlled trial. GPs referred patients aged between 18-74 years presenting with a new episode of depression, who did not have any medical contraindications to antidepressant medication and who had no history of psychosis or alcohol/substance abuse.
note: Randomised trial of citalopram versus reboxetine in primary-care patients with a new episode of depression, to find genetic and clinical predictors of response. Participants have the disease; antidepressant treatment is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: Tyypin 1 Diabetekseen Sairastuneita Perheenjäsenineen
quote: We analysed data from six cohorts, independent cases from the UK Genetic Resource Investigating Diabetes (GRID) cohort [2], the Northern Irish GRID (NI) cohort (used here for the first time), and the Finnish IDDMGEN (Tyypin 1 Diabetekseen Sairastuneita Perheenjäsenineen) and T1DGEN (Tyypin 1 Diabeteksen Genetiikka) cohorts [10]
note: Finnish collection of people with type 1 diabetes and their family members, contributing independent T1D cases (with parents and siblings as controls) to the ImmunoChip age-at-diagnosis study and other T1D genetic studies. A patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: Indianapolis-Ibadan Dementia Project
quote: A total of 2459 community-dwelling Yoruba residents of Ibadan, Nigeria, without dementia, and 2147 community-dwelling African American residents of Indianapolis, Ind, without dementia (all aged 65 years or older).
note: Population-based cohorts of dementia-free elderly African Americans in Indianapolis and Yoruba in Ibadan, followed with identical methods to compare the incidence of dementia and Alzheimer disease: a population study of one disease family, with no exposure design.

label: European Study into Digestive Illnesses and Genetics
quote: We used the resources from the PanGenEU case-control study conducted in Spain, Italy, Sweden, Germany, UK, and Ireland, between 2009 and 2014 [17, 18].
note: Multicentre European case-control study of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with newly diagnosed patients and hospital or population controls. Lifestyle and environmental-exposure questionnaires are part of the case-control design, not its purpose, so it is a disease cohort only.

label: Seoul Breast Cancer Study
quote: The parent study was the Seoul Breast Cancer Study (SeBCS), which is a multicenter case-control study of incident breast cancer patients and controls recruited from hospitals or the community that has been conducted beginning in 1995.
note: Multicentre hospital-based case-control study of incident female breast cancer in Seoul since 1995: a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: Molecular Epidemiology of non-Hodgkin lymphoma
quote: Briefly, eligible patients were identified through the cancer registry and met the following criteria at diagnosis: aged 20–85 years, resident of one of the six Bay Area counties and able to complete an in-person interview in English.
note: Population-based case-control study of incident non-Hodgkin lymphoma in six San Francisco Bay Area counties, with registry-ascertained cases and random-digit-dialling and Medicare controls: a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: Janssen lifetime suicide attempt cohort
quote: The Janssen lifetime suicide attempt cohort consisted of subjects of European ancestry and was drawn from multiple clinical trial samples (NCT00044681, NCT00397033, NCT00412373, NCT00334126, NCT01193153, NCT00094926) conducted by Janssen Research & Development, LLC
note: Case-control sample for lifetime suicide attempt drawn from Janssen clinical trials of patients with clinician-diagnosed major depression, schizophrenia, schizoaffective or bipolar disorder, plus healthy repository controls: a psychiatric patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: Enhancing NeuroImaging Genetics through Meta-Analysis Consortium
note: International neuroimaging-genetics consortium pooling MRI and genetic data from many sites, both patient groups for many psychiatric and neurological disorders and healthy or population samples, to study the brain in health and disease; its first project was a GWAS of hippocampal and intracranial volume. Its purpose is broad rather than one disease or disease family, and it has no exposure design.

label: Tirschenreuth Study
quote: In brief, 4203 randomly selected inhabitants of Tirschenreuth aged 14 years or older participated in the baseline survey of the TiKoCo study (response rate: 64.3%).
note: Random population sample of a Bavarian county hit hard by SARS-CoV-2, followed for seroprevalence, infection fatality ratio and new infections: a population study of one infectious disease. The outbreak is the disease under study rather than an environmental exposure that defines the participants.

label: Amsterdam Cohort Studies on HIV infection and AIDS
exposures: drug use
quote: In this manuscript, we describe how the Amsterdam Cohort Studies (ACS) among people who use drugs (PWUD) was conceived within the context of the Dutch HR approach, including the challenges scientists faced while establishing this cohort.
note: Open prospective cohorts in Amsterdam of men who have sex with men (since 1984) and of people who use drugs (1985-2016), followed for HIV infection and AIDS: groups selected for their HIV risk, so a disease cohort in the at-risk role. The drug-user cohort is recruited for its drug use, a lifestyle exposure outside the listed categories (hence 'other'); the MSM cohort is defined by sexual behaviour, which is not an environmental exposure, so the exposure verdict is medium confidence.

label: Broad Cardiovascular Disease Initiative Study
quote: It is a multi-study case control collection at the Broad institute focused on cardiovascular diseases including atrial fibrillation, mitral valve prolapse, Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT), Supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) and Bradyarrhythmia.
note: Multi-study case-control collection at the Broad Institute, extending the Broad AF study, of patients with atrial fibrillation and other arrhythmias or cardiovascular diseases, jointly genotyped; classified by what it collects as a patient aggregation with no exposure design.

label: Canadian Multicentre Osteoporosis Study
quote: Participants were recruited via randomly selected household telephone listings.
note: Population-based prospective cohort of randomly recruited Canadian adults followed with bone density measurements and questionnaires to measure the incidence of osteoporosis and fractures: a population study of one disease, with no exposure design.

label: Cardiovascular and Metabolic Disease Etiology Research Center-High Risk
quote: Briefly, CMERC-HI is a prospective cohort study aimed at developing more specific preventive strategies for patients with a high risk of CVD (clinicaltrials.gov NCT02003781).
note: Prospective hospital cohort in Seoul of adults at high risk of cardiovascular disease (high-risk hypertension, diabetes with albuminuria, dialysis, atherosclerosis, atrial fibrillation, relatives of early MI patients), enrolled to develop preventive strategies: selected for disease risk, not for an exposure.

label: French CF Modifier Gene Study
quote: Patients with CF treated in 38 participating CF centers between January 2004 and January 2017 were enrolled in the French CF Modifier Gene Study.
note: Cohort of cystic fibrosis patients enrolled at French CF centres since 2004 to study modifier genes of the disease: a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: German Dupuytren Study
quote: In all cohorts, the DD-affected case subjects were individuals who had undergone surgical treatment for their disease.
note: Case collection of surgically treated Dupuytren disease patients from Germany and Switzerland, with population controls from PopGen and KORA, for genetic studies: a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: German Study on the Genetics of Addiction
exposures: alcohol dependence
quote: The target sample comprised 1333 male patients with German ancestry having severe AD requiring hospitalization and 1307 population-based controls, previously described in Treutlein et al.
note: Case-control sample of men hospitalised for severe alcohol dependence with population-based controls, assembled for genetic studies of alcoholism. Addiction counts as a disease (patients role); alcohol is also the cohort's defining lifestyle exposure and main subject, so it is tagged as an alcohol exposure cohort, an interpretation of the rule rather than a stated design, hence medium confidence.

label: Korean Psychiatric GWAS Project
quote: A cohort of 1538 individuals diagnosed with bipolar I or II disorder (DSM-IV) and 2271 healthy controls were recruited from seven academic institutions and their affiliated hospitals in South Korea through the Korean Psychiatric Genome-Wide Association Study (GWAS) Project.
note: Multicentre Korean case-control sample of patients with DSM-IV bipolar disorder (and, per the definition, schizophrenia) with shared healthy controls for psychiatric GWAS: a patient cohort with no exposure design. The bundle's source names bipolar disorder; schizophrenia comes from the definition.

label: Quebec Founder Population cohort
note: Genizon's Alzheimer's disease case-control sample from the Quebec founder population (probable or autopsy-confirmed AD cases and cognitively normal controls), used as a replication set in AD GWAS: a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: German Sepsis Competence Network
quote: SepNet is integrated by the VISEP (recruitment in 2003-2005, registration number: NCT00135473) and MAXSEP (recruitment in 2007-2010, registration number: NCT00534287) randomised controlled trials and includes European ancestry patients with all-cause sepsis from German hospitals (Scherag et al., 2016).
note: German sepsis research network whose genetic cohort combines patients with all-cause sepsis from the VISEP and MAXSEP randomised trials: an aggregation of patient trials with no exposure design.

label: Study of ALS Reversals 2: Genetic Analyses
quote: All contactable patients with an ALS Reversal phenotype in our database were invited to participate in this genetic study named Study of ALS Reversals 2: Genetic Analyses (StAR2).
note: Patients who met criteria for ALS (or progressive muscular atrophy) and then improved substantially and lastingly, recruited from a database of such cases for whole-genome sequencing: a patient series with no exposure design.

label: Steno 2007
note: A DanDiabKids sub-cohort of children newly diagnosed with type 1 diabetes, sampled within three months of onset; a patient series, with no environmental exposure in its design.

label: Studies of a Targeted Risk Reduction Intervention through Defined Exercise
exposures: exercise interventions of differing amount, intensity and mode | caloric restriction
quote: A total of 947 adults with dyslipidemia (STRRIDE I, STRRIDE AT/RT) or prediabetes (STRRIDE-PD) were randomized to either inactive control or to 1 of 10 exercise interventions, ranging from doses of 8-23 kcal/kg/week, intensities of 50%-75% V˙O2 peak, and durations of 6-8 months.
note: Three randomised trials of supervised exercise training (one arm with caloric restriction) in sedentary adults with overweight or obesity plus dyslipidaemia or prediabetes. Physical activity is the trials' main subject, so it counts as a lifestyle-exposure design; the participants have obesity and dyslipidaemia (prediabetes being a pre-disease state), so they are a patient cohort.

label: Rare Variants for Hypertension in Taiwan Chinese
note: A TOPMed study of rare variants for hypertension combining hypertensive sibships (SAPPHIRe) with hospital-based cohorts matched to them; the participants were ascertained through hypertension, and no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Trans-Omics for Precision Medicine Program
note: NHLBI programme adding whole-genome sequencing to existing, diverse population and disease cohorts to study heart, lung, blood and sleep disorders: a broad multi-system remit spanning many disease families rather than one, and no exposure focus, so neither an exposure nor a disease cohort.

label: Umeå Fracture and Osteoporosis Study
note: Nested case-cohort of hip and forearm fracture cases and controls drawn from the Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study; the cases define it as a disease cohort. 'Gene-by-environmental determinants' is a general aim, not an exposure-based design.

label: Multicenter Study of Hydroxyurea in Sickle Cell Anemia
note: Randomised trial of hydroxyurea in adults with sickle cell anaemia, with observational follow-up; a patient cohort. Hydroxyurea is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: PanCareLIFE Work Package 4b
note: Subgroup of PanCareLIFE: childhood cancer patients treated with cisplatin without cranial irradiation, assembled for a GWAS of cisplatin-induced hearing loss. Cisplatin is a medical treatment, so the ototoxicity exposure does not make it an environmental exposure cohort.

label: African American Breast Cancer Consortium
note: Consortium of nine breast cancer case-control studies of African American women genotyped together for GWAS; classified by what it collects, a breast cancer patient (case-control) aggregation with no exposure design.

label: African American-Diabetes Heart Study
note: Unrelated African Americans with type 2 diabetes recruited alongside the Diabetes Heart Study to study calcified plaque and related traits; all participants have type 2 diabetes, and there is no exposure focus.

label: Anti-Aging Study Cohort
quote: This medical check‐up is provided to general residents of Ehime Prefecture, Japan, and is specifically designed to evaluate ageing‐related disorders, including atherosclerosis, cardiovascular disease, physical function, and mild cognitive impairment.
note: General residents of Ehime Prefecture attending a health check-up programme on ageing-related disorders (atherosclerosis, cardiovascular disease, cognition, physical function) followed in J-SHIPP; a population cohort with a broad health-and-ageing purpose rather than one disease, and no exposure design.

label: Department of Defense Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
exposures: military service in the Vietnam War | traumatic brain injury
quote: These studies are collectively termed “DOD ADNI,” and aim to enroll approximately 400 elderly Veterans who served in Vietnam.
note: ADNI extension enrolling Vietnam War veterans with PTSD and/or TBI plus veteran controls to see whether these conditions lead to Alzheimer's disease. Veterans of a deployment are an exposure-defined group (war or military); the participants have PTSD/TBI (patients) and are studied as at risk of Alzheimer's disease.

label: Anorexia Nervosa Genetics Initiative
note: International collection of people with a lifetime anorexia nervosa diagnosis and matched controls for GWAS; a case-control disease cohort with no exposure design.

label: Ashford study
exposures: domestic aeroallergen exposure in infancy (house dust mite Der p 1 and cat Fel d 1)
quote: A multicentre, prospective cohort study of childhood asthma was established in three European countries; the purpose of the project is the examination of factors which modify the relationship between allergen exposure in infant life and subsequent atopy and asthma.
note: Unselected birth cohort in Ashford, Kent (UK arm of the Asthma Multicentre Infant Cohort Study) built around measuring house-dust allergen exposure in infancy and its relation to atopy and asthma: an exposure-designed cohort whose stated purpose is one disease family.

label: Serial Biomarker Measurements and New Echocardiographic Techniques in Chronic Heart Failure Patients Result in Tailored Prediction of Prognosis
note: Prospective cohort of stable chronic heart failure outpatients with serial biomarker sampling for prognosis; a patient cohort without exposure design.

label: Bonn Study of COVID Genetics
note: Bonn study recruiting adults with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection from the general population for host-genetic studies of COVID-19 and long COVID; the bundle and cached texts only name BoSCO and say it recruits from the general population, so the disease verdict rests on the definition only. Infection is the disease here, not an exposure.

label: Biobanque québécoise de la COVID-19
note: Québec COVID-19 biobank of SARS-CoV-2 PCR-positive (hospitalised and not) participants with PCR-negative controls, self-described as disease-oriented; a patient cohort, with infection as the disease rather than an environmental exposure.

label: Childhood Asthma Management Program
note: Randomised trial of inhaled asthma treatments in children with mild to moderate asthma, followed into adulthood; a clinical trial whose participants have the condition, with medications rather than environmental exposures.

label: Continental Origins and Genetic Epidemiology Network
note: Network of population-based cohorts of African and other under-represented ancestries whose consortia meta-analyse complex traits (white blood cell count, blood pressure, kidney traits); it collects general population cohorts across several trait areas, so neither an exposure nor a single-disease aggregation.

label: Center for Oral Health Research in Appalachia
note: Family-based and pregnancy cohorts of northern Appalachia set up to find the causes of poor oral health (dental caries and other oral diseases); a population cohort whose stated purpose is one disease family. Environmental factors are among many determinants, not the design basis.

label: Diabetes Genetics Initiative
note: Type 2 diabetes patients and matched non-diabetic controls from Finland and Sweden genotyped for the Broad/Lund/Novartis GWAS; a case-control disease cohort with no exposure design.

label: DIAbetes Meta-ANalysis of Trans-Ethnic association studies
note: Consortium assembling type 2 diabetes case-control GWAS across ancestries for meta-analysis; classified by what it collects, a type 2 diabetes aggregation with no exposure design.

label: Discovery, Biology, and Risk of Inherited Variants in Breast Cancer
note: GAME-ON breast cancer genetics consortium meta-analysing breast cancer GWAS and genotyping breast cancer cases and controls on the OncoArray; a breast cancer case-control aggregation with no exposure design.

label: European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition–Cardiovascular Disease Study
exposures: alcohol consumption | dietary fatty acids and their food sources | smoking status
quote: We harmonised exposure data across participating countries on alcohol consumption, smoking status, and other lifestyle characteristics, and studied validated CVD outcomes.
note: Case-cohort of incident coronary heart disease and stroke cases with a random subcohort, nested in EPIC, the diet-and-cancer cohort, to investigate CVD determinants including harmonised alcohol, diet and smoking exposures alongside biomarkers and genotypes; the incident cases make it a disease cohort, and its inherited EPIC exposure design and dietary/alcohol analyses make it an exposure cohort.

label: Fangshan Family-based Ischemic Stroke Study in China
note: Family-based study of ischaemic stroke in Fangshan District, Beijing, recruiting stroke probands with their parents and siblings (relatives at risk) and later community participants aged 40+; a stroke cohort. Environmental risk factors are studied among others, not as the design basis.

label: International FTLD-TDP Whole-Genome Sequencing Consortium
note: Consortium whole-genome sequencing pathologically confirmed FTLD-TDP patients (and clinically diagnosed FTLD subtypes) with neurologically normal controls; a patient aggregation with no exposure design.

label: Genetic Epidemiology of Lung Cancer Consortium
note: Family study of lung cancer: pedigrees ascertained through lung cancer probands with several affected relatives, plus unaffected relatives and matched controls. Smoking histories are collected as a covariate, not as the recruitment basis.

label: Genetics of Hypertension Associated Treatment
note: Pharmacogenetic ancillary study of the ALLHAT trial: every participant is a hypertensive aged 55 or older; the randomised antihypertensive drugs are treatments, not environmental exposures.

label: Genetics of Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease
exposures: current or former smoker with ≥2.5 pack-years of smoking history
quote: Enrolment criteria were: 1) self-reported Caucasian; 2) aged > 40 years; 3) current or former smoker with ≥2.5 pack-years of smoking history; and 4) no severe α1-antitrypsin deficiency.
note: COPD case-control study in Bergen in which every participant, case or control, was enrolled as a current or former smoker with at least 2.5 pack-years; the cases have at least moderate COPD and the controls are smokers with normal lung function, so smoking defines the cohort as well as the disease.

label: Genetic Links to Anxiety and Depression Study
note: Recontactable cohort recruiting people with lifetime depression or anxiety into the NIHR Mental Health BioResource, with a smaller group without any history of mental disorder as comparison; environmental data are collected but exposure is not the design basis.

label: Genetics of the Scottish Health Research Register
quote: GoSHARE is a parallel project which additionally aims to get permission to collect spare blood from people attending for routine clinical tests at hospital or GP clinics, that would otherwise to go to waste after the necessary tests had been performed [http://www.goshare.org.uk/].
note: Biobank sub-study of the Scottish Health Research Register collecting spare blood from unselected registrants attending routine clinical tests; not selected for any disease or exposure.

label: Genes, Reading and Dyslexia Study
note: Case-control study of reading disability (developmental dyslexia) in Hispanic American and African American children; dyslexia is counted here as a neurodevelopmental disorder rather than a trait, hence medium confidence.

label: Genetic Resource Investigating Diabetes
note: Collection of people with type 1 diabetes diagnosed before age 17, recruited from NHS diabetes clinics across mainland UK; a pure patient collection.

label: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Registry
note: International prospective registry and natural history study of patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

label: Hypertension-Insulin Resistance Family Study
note: Family study recruiting the relatives of probands with documented hypertension in the Los Angeles area to study the genetic basis of hypertension and insulin resistance; the families are at familial risk of hypertension.

label: International AMD Genomics Consortium
note: Consortium of 26 case-control studies of age-related macular degeneration whose cases were mostly recruited from ophthalmology clinics; classified by what it collects.

label: International Stroke Genetics Consortium intracerebral hemorrhage GWAS
note: Meta-analysis of six case-control GWAS of spontaneous intracerebral haemorrhage under the International Stroke Genetics Consortium; the cases are ICH patients ascertained by neurologists.

label: UK lung cancer GWAS from the Institute for Cancer Research
note: Case-control GWAS of lung cancer: GELCAPS lung cancer patients from UK oncology centres versus 1958 Birth Cohort controls; smoking is analysed only as a covariate.

label: Indian Migration Study
exposure categories: built environment | diet | physical activity | other
exposures: rural-to-urban migration | urbanisation | diet | physical activity
quote: Migrants of rural origin, their rural dwelling sibs, and those of urban origin together with their urban dwelling sibs were assessed by interview, examination, and fasting blood samples.
note: Sib-pair study selecting factory workers who had migrated from rural to urban India together with their rural-dwelling siblings, to measure the effect of migration and urban living (diet, physical activity) on obesity, diabetes and cardiovascular risk factors; migration to the urban environment is treated as the defining exposure and obesity and diabetes as the target disease family.

label: Institute of Rheumatology, Rheumatoid Arthritis
note: Single-centre observational registry of rheumatoid arthritis patients treated at the Institute of Rheumatology, Tokyo Women's Medical University.

label: International Suicide Genetics Consortium
note: Consortium meta-analysing GWAS of suicide attempt and suicide death from psychiatric, suicide-ascertained and biobank cohorts; suicidal behaviour is treated here as a psychiatric outcome alongside mental disorders, hence medium confidence.

label: Myocardial Applied Genomics Network
note: Biorepository of left ventricular tissue from failing hearts at transplantation with non-failing donor hearts as controls, plus genotyped heart failure patients; a tissue bank of one disease.

label: Massachusetts General Hospital Atrial Fibrillation Study
note: Case series of atrial fibrillation patients at Massachusetts General Hospital, with affected and unaffected relatives of probands with a strong family history; early-onset cases were sequenced in TOPMed.

label: NIMH Alzheimer's Disease Genetics Initiative
note: Family study ascertaining families with two or more members affected by Alzheimer's disease (mostly affected sibling pairs) plus unaffected relatives, for linkage and association studies.

label: Genomic Health Initiative
quote: The Genomic Health Initiative (GHI) is a community-based healthcare biobank established at Endeavor Health (Evanston, Illinois, USA), designed to integrate genomic data with comprehensive EHR.
note: Health-system research biobank enrolling consenting patients of NorthShore/Endeavor Health with EHR linkage; not selected for any disease or exposure.

label: MRC National Survey of Health and Development
quote: NSHD is a population-based prospective birth cohort study whose participants were infants from single births born in England, Scotland and Wales during 1 week in March 1946 (N = 5,362) to women with husbands24.
note: The 1946 British birth cohort, a social-class-stratified sample of one week's births followed into old age as a general study of lifelong health and ageing; no disease or exposure defines it.

label: Oxford Down Syndrome Cohort Study
note: Prospective cohort of newborns with Down syndrome enrolled at birth in 18 UK hospitals; all have Down syndrome and are screened for GATA1 mutations and followed for transient abnormal myelopoiesis and the risk of myeloid leukaemia.

label: Pharmacogenetics of Opioid Substitution Treatment Response
note: Prospective cohort of patients receiving methadone or buprenorphine-naloxone for opioid use disorder at Ontario addiction clinics; addiction counts as a disease and the substitution treatment is not an environmental exposure.

label: PROCAM-2 Study
quote: The independent studies recruited participants of European descent from the population living in and around the cities of Münster, Marburg, Greifswald and Leipzig, Germany.
note: Employee-based volunteer cohort examined for cardiovascular risk as the second part of the Prospective Cardiovascular Münster study; the sources on disk only name the arteriosclerosis institute that ran it and treat the sample as general population, so the cardiovascular purpose rests on the definition only. Recruitment through workplaces is not an occupational exposure.

label: PsyCourse Study
note: Longitudinal deep-phenotyping study of patients with schizophrenia-spectrum, bipolar and recurrent depressive disorders recruited at clinical centres in Germany and Austria, with healthy controls.

label: Queensland Study of Melanoma: Environmental and Genetic Associations
exposures: sun exposure
quote: The principal aim of Q-MEGA is to provide a large and well-described population-based sample of CMM cases and their families, with blood collection for genetic purposes and detailed information on sun exposure and phenotype to explore the effect that environmental and genetic factors, and their interaction, play in the etiology of CMM.
note: Follow-up of four population-based Queensland melanoma patient samples with blood for genetics and detailed sun-exposure histories, designed to study environmental and genetic factors and their interaction in melanoma; sun exposure (UV) is the environmental factor at the centre of the design, so the exposure verdict is medium.

label: Royal Brompton & Harefield Cardiovascular Research Centre Biobank
quote: The Cardiovascular Research Centre Biobank collects samples and associated clinical data from adult and paediatric patients attending Royal Brompton & Harefield NHS Trust for investigation or treatment of cardiovascular conditions.
note: Hospital research biobank of adult and paediatric patients attending the Royal Brompton and Harefield hospitals for cardiovascular conditions (its DCM and HCM series are the ones used in GWAS), plus relatives; a patient biobank of one disease family, with no environmental exposure focus.

label: Genome-Wide Association Study of Breast Cancer in the African Diaspora
quote: We used data from the genome-wide association study (GWAS) of breast cancer in the African diaspora (The Root consortium), which included 3686 participants of African ancestry from Nigeria, USA, and Barbados.
note: Consortium pooling the cases and controls of six breast cancer case-control studies in women of African ancestry for a breast cancer GWAS; classified by what it collects (breast cancer cases and controls), no exposure design.

label: Study of Eczema and Asthma To Observe the influence of Nutrition
exposures: antenatal dietary exposures | maternal antioxidant intake in pregnancy
quote: SEATON is an unselected birth cohort study established in 1997 in Aberdeen, UK, which was designed to explore the relationship between antenatal dietary exposures and asthma outcomes in childhood (Martindale et al., 2005).
note: Unselected Aberdeen birth cohort whose stated design is the effect of maternal diet (antioxidant intake) in pregnancy on childhood asthma and eczema: a diet-exposure birth cohort and a population study of one disease family (asthma and atopic disease).

label: Treatment of Emphysema with a Gamma-Selective Retinoid Agonist
exposures: former smokers with COPD
quote: TESRA subjects were former smokers with COPD who experienced two or fewer exacerbations requiring outpatient treatment with antibiotics or oral steroids or one exacerbation requiring hospitalization within the prior year.
note: Drug trial whose participants all had smoking-related COPD with emphysema, so a patient cohort; every participant was also required to be an ex-smoker, so smoking is a selection criterion and the exposure verdict is yes with medium confidence (the trial's purpose is treatment, not the exposure itself).

label: TRoglitazone In the Prevention Of Diabetes
quote: The primary aim of the TRIPOD trial is to test the hypothesis that chronic administration of troglitazone to nondiabetic women with prior gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) will improve whole-body insulin sensitivity and reduce the incidence of non-insulin-dependent diabetes (NIDDM).
note: Prevention trial in nondiabetic Hispanic women selected for prior gestational diabetes, a high-risk group for type 2 diabetes; the only exposure is the trial medication, so exposure is no.

label: UK Digital Heart Project
quote: Healthy volunteers without self-reported cardiovascular disease or a family history of disease were recruited prospectively via advertisement to the UK Digital Heart Project (https://digital-heart.org/) at the MRC-CSC, Imperial College, London69.
note: Healthy adult volunteers without cardiovascular disease recruited by advertisement for cardiac MRI and genotyping; neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: Vitamin Intervention for Stroke Prevention
quote: 3680 adults with nondisabling cerebral infarction at 56 university-affiliated hospitals, community hospitals, private neurology practices, and Veterans Affairs medical centers across the United States, Canada, and Scotland.
note: Randomised trial of B-vitamin doses in patients with a recent nondisabling ischaemic stroke; a patient cohort whose intervention is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Women of African Ancestry Breast Cancer Study
quote: The WAABCS is a hospital-based case-control study originally started in Nigeria in 1998 and was expanded to Uganda and Cameroon in 2011 with the same questionnaires and protocol
note: Hospital-based case-control study of breast cancer in Nigeria, Uganda and Cameroon; cases of one disease, no exposure design.

label: Wake Forest School of Medicine Study
quote: Diabetic subjects with type 2 diabetes and end stage renal disease were recruited from dialysis facilities in the southeastern U.S.
note: Wake Forest case-control collection of African Americans with type 2 diabetes and end-stage kidney disease (and later other diabetes/kidney groups) against community controls; a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: University of Miami/Texas Alzheimer's Research Care Consortium Wave 2/Case Western Reserve University
quote: UM/CWRU/TARCC2: The UM/CWRU/TARCC2 sample included 256 cases and 189 controls from the University of Miami, Case Western Reserve University, and the Texas Alzheimer’s Research Care Consortium (wave 2).
note: Alzheimer's Disease Genetics Consortium case-control dataset of late-onset Alzheimer's disease cases and cognitively normal controls from three US sites; a patient dataset with no exposure design.

label: MexGen-COVID Initiative
quote: MexGen-COVID Initiative Mexico MexGen-COVID AMR Cases: 55.6 years; Controls: 41.1 years The Ethics Committee of the Instituto Nacional de Ciencias Médicas y Nutrición Salvador Zubiran (INCMNSZ), Mexico City.
note: Mexican COVID-19 host genetics study of COVID-19 cases and controls contributed to the COVID-19 HGI and its long COVID GWAS; a disease case-control cohort. SARS-CoV-2 here defines the disease, not an exposed-uninfected group, so exposure is no.

label: Genetics of Long COVID
quote: We compared two subpopulations of long COVID patients from Sano Genetics’ Long COVID GOLD study cohort, focusing on patients with severe or fatigue dominant phenotypes.
note: Sano Genetics study of people with COVID-19 and long COVID recruited for at-home DNA testing and symptom questionnaires; a patient cohort of one disease, no exposure design.

label: Japan COVID-19 Task Force
quote: The Japan COVID-19 Task Force is conducting host genome analysis of hospitalized patients with COVID-19 from more than 70 institutions nationwide in Japan.
note: Nationwide Japanese hospital consortium collecting samples and clinical data from patients hospitalised with COVID-19 for host genetics; a patient cohort, no exposure design.

label: NIDDM-Atherosclerosis Study
quote: Family members of probands with T2D were recruited in the Los Angeles area.
note: Family study recruiting Hispanic relatives of type 2 diabetes probands to study the genetic basis of subclinical atherosclerosis and diabetes; relatives of patients, so at risk; no exposure design.

label: Dementia Genetics Spanish Consortium
quote: Additional cases and controls were obtained from dementia cohorts included in the Dementia Genetics Spanish Consortium (DEGESCO)33.
note: Spanish national consortium that brings together dementia case-control cohorts to study the genetics of neurodegenerative dementias; classified by what it collects (dementia cases and controls), no exposure design.

label: COVID-19 Ioannina Biobank
quote: Covid-19 Ioannina Biobank Greece Approximately 80 participants returned to the hospital 6 months after their hospitalisation and were administered a symptoms questionnaire (pasted below) among other clinical testing.
note: Biobank of patients hospitalised with COVID-19 at the University Hospital of Ioannina, contributed to the COVID-19 HGI long COVID GWAS with population controls; the available sentence shows hospitalised COVID-19 participants but does not describe recruitment directly, hence medium. No exposure design.

label: Australian Breast Cancer Family Study
quote: The Australian Breast Cancer Family Study (ABCFS) is a population-based, case–control-family study of breast cancer with an emphasis on early-onset disease, that was carried out in Melbourne and Sydney, Australia.
note: Population-based case-control-family study of breast cancer (Australian site of the Breast Cancer Family Registry); cases of one disease with controls and relatives, no exposure design.

label: Asia Colorectal Cancer Consortium
quote: We analyzed genetic data from 22,775 patients with CRC (cases) and 47,731 individuals without cancer (controls) from 14 studies in the Asia Colorectal Cancer Consortium.
note: Consortium pooling colorectal cancer cases and cancer-free controls from East Asian studies for CRC GWAS; classified by what it collects, no exposure design.

label: AIDS Clinical Trials Group
quote: ACTG is the world’s largest and longest running clinical trials network focused on HIV and other infectious diseases and the people living with them.
note: Clinical trials network whose trial participants are people living with HIV (its DNA bank and the HIV controllers GWAS progressors come from these trials); classified as a patient aggregation. HIV here is the participants' disease, not an exposed-uninfected design, so exposure is no.

label: genetic Association study in individuals from Diverse Ancestral backgrounds with Multiple Sclerosis
quote: The genetic Association study in individuals from Diverse Ancestral backgrounds with Multiple Sclerosis (ADAMS) project aims to gather genetic and phenotypic data on a large cohort of ancestrally-diverse individuals with MS living in the UK.
note: Case-only UK genetic cohort of adults with multiple sclerosis from diverse ancestries; a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: ADVANCE trial
quote: The ADVANCE study in South Africa was a phase 3 clinical trial (clinicaltrial.gov NCT03122262) in which 1,053 HIV-positive, ART-naïve participants were randomly assigned to one of three treatment arms: 1) dolutegravir, tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) and emtricitabine; 2) dolutegravir, tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) and emtricitabine; or 3) efavirenz, TDF and emtricitabine (8).
note: Phase 3 trial of first-line antiretroviral regimens in treatment-naive people with HIV-1 in Johannesburg; a patient trial cohort whose only exposure is the treatment.

label: Atherosclerotic Disease, Vascular Function, and Genetic Epidemiology Study
quote: Adult members of Kaiser between the ages of 45 to 75 years with no prior history of CHD who first presented with new symptoms of CHD (either stable exertional angina or acute myocardial infarction) between October 28, 2001 and December 31, 2003 were enrolled into the Atherosclerotic Disease, VAscular functioN, and genetiC Epidemiology (ADVANCE) Study [23].
note: Kaiser Permanente case-control genetic study of coronary artery disease (early-onset CAD, incident angina or MI) with cardiovascular-disease-free controls; a patient cohort, no exposure design.

label: Antioxydants, Lipides Essentiels, Nutrition et maladies OculaiRes
exposures: nutritional factors | antioxidants | lutein and zeaxanthin | omega 3 polyunsaturated fatty acids
quote: The Alienor (Antioxydants, Lipides Essentiels, Nutrition et maladies OculaiRes) Study aims at assessing the associations of eye diseases with nutritional factors, determined from plasma measurements and estimation of dietary intakes.
note: Population-based ophthalmological follow-up of elderly Three-City participants in Bordeaux whose stated aim is the association of age-related eye diseases with nutritional factors (plasma antioxidants, carotenoids, omega-3 fatty acids, dietary intake): a diet-exposure design and a population study of one disease family.

label: Autopsy-Confirmed Parkinson Disease GWAS Consortium
quote: The APDGC was formed to conduct a genome-wide association study in individuals with neuropathologically confirmed Parkinson Disease (PD) and neuropathologically normal controls.
note: Case-control sample of autopsy-confirmed Parkinson's disease cases and neuropathologically normal controls from twelve US autopsy centres; a patient cohort, no exposure design.

label: Alcohol-Related Cancers and Genetic susceptibility in Europe
exposures: consumption of alcoholic beverages | tobacco smoking | intake of vegetables and fruits
quote: Moreover, the role of pattern of smoking and drinking, as well as the exact nature of the implicated dietary variables, has not been clarified. To address these issues, the International Agency for Research on Cancer initiated in 2002 the alcohol-related cancers and genetic susceptibility (ARCAGE) in Europe project, with the participation of 15 centers in 11 European countries.
note: IARC multicentre case-control study of upper aerodigestive tract cancers, so a patient cohort; it was set up explicitly to clarify the role of smoking and drinking patterns and dietary variables and their interplay with genetic susceptibility, which makes the lifestyle exposures a stated design purpose (medium confidence, since genetic susceptibility is the primary aim).

label: Base de Datos de Ictus del Hospital del Mar
note: A hospital-based register of patients admitted with acute stroke, so a disease cohort of patients. One paper uses it for a case-crossover analysis of air pollution, but the register is not designed around exposure, so exposure is no.

label: Bavarian Breast Cancer Cases and Controls Study
note: A hospital-based case-control study of women with invasive breast cancer and controls; the cases make it a disease cohort. No exposure is part of its design.

label: Breast Cancer Employment and Environment Study
exposures: occupational exposure to ionizing radiation
quote: To evaluate current breast cancer risk due to occupational exposure to ionizing radiation.
note: A population-based case-control study of incident breast cancer built, as its name says, to study employment and environmental risk factors; the bundled paper uses it for occupational ionizing radiation. The exposure verdict follows from the study's name and use rather than a design statement, since the founding paper is not in the bundle.

label: BiDirect Study
note: Two of its three parallel cohorts are patients (acute depression; acute myocardial infarction or coronary syndrome), followed with population controls to study the depression-arteriosclerosis relationship, so a disease cohort of patients. No exposure focus.

label: Blue Mountains Eye Study
quote: The study involved eligible permanent residents aged 49 years and older, living in two postcode areas in the Blue Mountains, west of Sydney, Australia.
note: A population-based cohort of all older residents of two postcode areas whose stated purpose is common eye diseases (cataract, macular degeneration, glaucoma), so a population study of one disease family. Recruitment by residence, not by exposure.

label: Bonn OMNI cohort
note: A case-control sample of Alzheimer's disease patients and controls assembled for GWAS, so a disease cohort of patients; no exposure element.

label: Bio-Repository of DNA in Stroke
note: A hospital-based DNA repository of stroke patients (with controls) across three ancestral populations, so a disease cohort of patients; nothing about exposure.

label: Breast Oncology Galicia Network
note: A population-based case-control study of breast cancer in Galicia contributing cases and controls to the Breast Cancer Association Consortium; the bundled sentence gives its setting, and that its participants are breast cancer cases follows from its name and consortium membership rather than a sentence naming the cases. No exposure design.

label: Kita-Nagoya Genomic Epidemiology Study
note: A community-based cohort of local residents enrolled at health check-ups whose stated purpose is the genetic basis of cardiovascular disease, so a population study of one disease family; exposures are not its subject.

label: Cleveland Clinic Atrial Fibrillation Study
note: A biobank case set of patients with (early-onset, lone) atrial fibrillation and controls, so a disease cohort of patients; no exposure element.

label: California Childhood Cancer Record Linkage Project
note: A record-linkage case-control study whose cases are California-born children with cancer (leukaemia, glioma) in the state cancer registry, matched to cancer-free controls, so a disease cohort of patients; not defined by any exposure.

label: CLOZUK study
note: A sample of people prescribed clozapine for treatment-resistant schizophrenia, drawn from clozapine monitoring services, so a disease cohort of patients. Clozapine is a medication, which does not count as an environmental exposure.

label: Colorado Longitudinal Twin Study
quote: The Colorado sample (COLORADO) includes same sex monozygotic (MZ) and dizygotic (DZ) twins recruited from the Colorado Longitudinal Twin Sample that was designed to investigate genetic and environmental influences on cognitive and emotional development.
note: A twin registry sample followed for psychological and cognitive development; 'environmental influences' here is the behaviour-genetics sense (shared and non-shared environment), not a measured environmental exposure, and the cohort is not about a disease.

label: Combined Small Datasets Collection
note: An Alzheimer's Disease Genetics Consortium aggregation that merges six small Alzheimer's disease case-control datasets (fewer than 100 cases or cognitively normal elders each) for association analysis, so classified as what it collects: patients with Alzheimer's disease. The quote gives the case-control composition; the disease comes from the ADRD meta-analysis it serves.

label: Columbia University COVID-19 Biobank
note: A biobank of consecutive PCR-confirmed COVID-19 patients treated at one medical centre, so a disease cohort of patients; the participants are infected patients, not an exposed-uninfected group, so exposure is no.

label: FIN-D2D 2007
quote: The cohort included 2766 Finnish subjects (45-74 years) from the population-based FIN-D2D survey.
note: A random population sample examined in 2007 to evaluate FIN-D2D, Finland's national type 2 diabetes prevention programme, by measuring the prevalence of diabetes, obesity and their risk factors; a general-population survey whose stated purpose is one disease, so a population study of disease. Not an exposure cohort.

label: DietBB sample
note: A subsample of the AgeCoDe primary-care cohort selected for a methylation study of dementia: participants dementia-free at baseline with DNA, of whom some developed dementia during follow-up while 'The additional 200 remain free of dementia until last follow up of AgeCoDe', so a nested case-control sample of incident dementia cases with controls. Despite the Diet-Body-Brain name, the bundle shows no exposure-based selection or design.

label: Dietary, Lifestyle and Genetic Determinants of Obesity and Metabolic Syndrome study
exposures: dietary determinants of obesity and metabolic syndrome | lifestyle determinants of obesity and metabolic syndrome
quote: Participants were Finnish aged 25-74 years who attended the DIetary, Lifestyle and Genetic determinants of Obesity and Metabolic syndrome study at baseline in 2007 and follow-up in 2014.
note: A population-based FINRISK 2007 sub-study set up, as its name states, to study dietary, lifestyle and genetic determinants of obesity and metabolic syndrome: diet and lifestyle are its main subject, so an exposure cohort designed to study exposures, and a general-population cohort whose stated purpose is obesity and metabolic syndrome, so a population study of disease. The design is stated only through the study's name and one aim sentence, hence medium.

label: Finnish Diabetes Prevention Study
note: A randomised trial of overweight adults with impaired glucose tolerance, a pre-diabetic state, so a disease cohort of people at risk of type 2 diabetes. The diet and exercise counselling is the trial's intervention (a treatment), not an environmental exposure defining the cohort, so exposure is no.

label: Duke study of Functional Endpoints for Age-related Macular Degeneration
note: A single-centre natural-history study enrolling patients with early or intermediate age-related macular degeneration plus normal controls, so a disease cohort of patients; no exposure element.

label: Epidemiology of Endometrial Cancer Consortium
note: A consortium of endometrial cancer case-control and cohort studies pooling cases and controls to study the aetiology of endometrial cancer, so classified by what it collects: patients with endometrial cancer. Not an exposure consortium.

label: Epidemiology of Dementia in Singapore
note: A population-based sub-study of the Singapore Epidemiology of Eye Diseases study whose stated purpose is the prevalence and risk factors of dementia and cognitive impairment, so a population study of one disease; exposures are not its subject.

label: Early-Onset Venous Thrombosis
note: A case-control study whose cases had idiopathic venous thrombosis before age 50, with healthy SU.VI.MAX controls, so a disease cohort of patients; no exposure element.

label: Family History Risk Study
note: Women attending a breast cancer family history risk and prevention clinic, referred for their family history of breast and ovarian cancer, recruited to validate risk prediction models, so a disease cohort of people at risk of breast cancer (it also holds a nested case-control of women who developed the disease). Not defined by any exposure.

label: German Aortic Stenosis Cohort
note: A cohort of patients with aortic valve stenosis from two German centres genotyped for the aortic stenosis GWAS, so a disease cohort of patients; nothing about exposure.

label: Greater Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky Stroke Study
quote: We are identifying all hospitalized and autopsied cases of stroke and transient ischemic attack (TIA) among the 1.3 million inhabitants of a five-county region of Greater Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky for the period 7/1/93-6/30/94.
note: Population-based ascertainment of all hospitalised and autopsied stroke and TIA cases among residents of the Greater Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky region in repeated one-year periods; the participants are stroke patients. No environmental exposure defines the study.

label: Genotek COVID-19 study
quote: We conducted a genome-wide association study (GWAS) on 7,124 individuals (comprising 6,400 controls who had mild to moderate COVID-19 and 724 cases with severe COVID-19).
note: Genotek customers who reported COVID-19 in online questionnaires, contributed as mild-to-moderate COVID-19 controls to the severe-COVID GWAS and studied for long COVID; all had the infection, so a patient cohort for COVID-19. SARS-CoV-2 infection is here the disease, not an environmental exposure.

label: Genetics of Kidneys in Diabetes Study
quote: A large number of individuals with type 1 diabetes were screened to identify two subsets, one with clear-cut kidney disease and another with normal renal status despite long-term diabetes.
note: DNA collection of people with type 1 diabetes enrolled as diabetic nephropathy cases or long-duration normoalbuminuric controls, with parents as trios; all probands are diabetes patients. No exposure design.

label: Graz Stroke Study
quote: GRAZ Between 1994 and 2003, subjects with first-ever and recurrent ischemic strokes admitted to the stroke unit of the Department of Neurology, Medical University of Graz (Graz, Austria) were included.
note: Hospital-based series of ischaemic stroke patients admitted to the Graz stroke unit, a SiGN genetic research centre contributing cases. No exposure design.

label: Head and Neck 5000
quote: Head and Neck 5000 is an observational study that recruited people with head and neck cancer from across the United Kingdom.
note: Prospective clinical cohort of people newly diagnosed with head and neck cancer recruited before treatment across UK centres. Lifestyle questionnaires are covariates, not the design purpose.

label: International Agency for Research on Cancer Central Europe Study
exposures: alcohol consumption | tobacco consumption
quote: This increase is likely to be due to patterns of alcohol and tobacco consumption. Genetic susceptibility to upper aerodigestive tract cancer in relation to such exposures is an important aspect that should be investigated among populations in this region.
note: Hospital-based case-control study of upper aerodigestive tract cancer in six central European centres, so a patient cohort. Its stated rationale is genetic susceptibility in relation to alcohol and tobacco exposure in a high-incidence region, which makes alcohol and tobacco a design purpose rather than incidental covariates; medium confidence because the bundle holds only the abstract's framing.

label: Institute for Behavioral Genetics
quote: The Colorado Twin Registry (CTR) is a population-based registry housed at the Institute for Behavioral Genetics at the University of Colorado.
note: Aggregation of the Colorado Adoption Project and the population-based Colorado Twin Registry, general behavioural-development samples analysed for childhood psychiatric traits; neither a disease nor an exposure selection.

label: International Collaboration for the Genomics of HIV
quote: The International Collaboration for the Genomics of HIV was established as a platform to combine all available genome-wide SNP data sets obtained on HIV-1 infected individuals worldwide.
note: Consortium pooling HIV cohorts of people living with HIV-1 for host-genetic studies of acquisition, viral load and control; the members are patient cohorts. HIV infection is the disease here, not an environmental exposure.

label: International Endometriosis Genetics Consortium
quote: The IEGC is a collaborative effort that aggregates data from multiple international studies to investigate the genetic factors of endometriosis4.
note: Consortium of endometriosis GWAS (surgically confirmed, record- or self-reported cases with controls), so an aggregation of case-control studies of one disease. No exposure design.

label: INGI-Val Borbera
quote: As a part of a research program aimed at the identification of genes and variants associated to common disorders, we present here the analysis of a cohort of 1803 adult subjects from Val Borbera, selected based on their ancestry to represent the general population in the valley.
note: Population isolate cohort of adults selected by ancestry to represent the general population of the Val Borbera, for gene mapping of common disorders and quantitative traits; a general population sample with a broad purpose.

label: Ischemic Stroke Genetics Study
quote: The ISGS is a prospective case-control genetic association study of patients with first-ever ischemic stroke at 5 US tertiary stroke centers.
note: Multicentre case-control study of adults with first-ever ischaemic stroke and matched stroke-free controls at five US centres. Smoking is an exploratory covariate, not the design purpose.

label: Karolinska Mammography Project for Risk Prediction of Breast Cancer
quote: The KARMA study aims to study and determine the roles and interactions of mammographic density, genetic determinants and lifestyle in the risk of breast cancer to build a comprehensive risk prediction model including all known and established risk factors for breast cancer.
note: Prospective cohort of women attending mammography in Sweden, set up specifically to study breast cancer risk and build risk prediction models: a population study of one disease. Lifestyle is one of many risk factors, not an exposure design.

label: Kathleen Cuningham Foundation Consortium for Research into Familial Breast Cancer
quote: Based in Australia, the primary aim of kConFab is to facilitate high-quality research by amassing a large and comprehensive resource of epidemiological and clinical data with biospecimens from individuals at high risk of breast and/or ovarian cancer, and from their close relatives.
note: Resource of multiple-case breast/ovarian cancer families recruited through family cancer clinics, holding affected and unaffected members and BRCA1/2 carriers; a high-risk family cohort (also containing patients). No exposure design.

label: Krakow stroke genetics study
quote: KRAKOW All consecutive subjects with ischemic stroke (fulfilling WHO criteria12 (3)) who were admitted to the Stroke Unit at the Jagiellonian University (Krakow, Poland) and who provided informed consent were included in the study.
note: Single-centre hospital-based series of consecutive ischaemic stroke patients admitted to the Krakow stroke unit, with stroke-free controls; a SiGN genetic research centre. No exposure design.

label: Leuven Stroke Genetics Study
quote: Cases of European descent with cerebral ischemia, defined as a clinical stroke with imaging confirmation or a TIA with a new ischemic lesion on diffusion-weighted imaging, who were admitted to the Stroke Unit of the University Hospitals (Leuven, Belgium) were enrolled in the LSGS between 2005 and 2009.
note: Hospital-based study of patients with cerebral ischaemia admitted to the Leuven stroke unit, with controls from the same population; a SiGN genetic research centre. No exposure design.

label: Men of African Descent and Carcinoma of the Prostate
quote: We tested this infrastructure by collecting epidemiologic, medical record, and genomic data from a total of 311 patients with CaP and 218 matched controls recruited at the seven SSA centers.
note: Clinic-based case-control study of histologically confirmed prostate cancer in men of African descent at seven sub-Saharan African centres, with cancer-free controls. No exposure design.

label: Maywood Cohort
quote: Participants from the US were recruited into the Genetic Study of Hypertension in Blacks between 1995–1999 and the Fat Reduction Intervention Trial in African-Americans (FRITAA) between 1995–1998.
note: Random population sample of African-American families in Maywood, Illinois, enrolled by Loyola for its blood-pressure and hypertension genetics studies (the US site of the hypertension-in-Blacks programme), later used for anthropometric GWAS; a population sample whose stated purpose is hypertension. No exposure design.

label: Minnesota Breast Cancer Family Study
quote: The Minnesota Breast Cancer Family Study is a historical cohort study of relatives of a consecutive series of 426 breast cancer cases (probands) identified between 1944 and 1952.
note: Historical cohort of relatives of breast cancer probands followed for cancer incidence; the participants are selected as relatives of patients. No exposure design.

label: Middlesex County Ischemic Stroke Study
quote: Middlesex County Ischemic Stroke Study (MCISS) The MCISS was initiated as a prospective hospital based stroke registry at the New Jersey Neuroscience Institute (Edison, NJ, U.S.A.).
note: Prospective hospital-based registry of adults admitted with ischaemic stroke to the New Jersey Neuroscience Institute; a SiGN genetic research centre. No exposure design.

label: HARMONISATION study
quote: The Harmonization study is an ongoing prospective study which recruited patients from memory clinics of the National University Hospital and St. Luke’s Hospital in Singapore, aiming to examine cognitive deterioration and associated biomarkers in older Asian individuals with cognitive impairment and dementia due to AD and/or cerebrovascular disease (CeVD).
note: Memory-clinic cohort of older Singaporeans with no cognitive impairment, MCI or dementia due to Alzheimer's disease and/or cerebrovascular disease, followed to study vascular cognitive impairment and AD; a patient cohort. No exposure design.

label: Genes Affecting Stroke Risk and Outcome Study
quote: MGH Genes Affecting Stroke Risk and Outcome Study (MGH-GASROS) Cases were all consecutive patients aged 18 years presenting with ischemic stroke and admitted to the Massachusetts General Hospital (MGH) Stroke Unit through the Emergency Department, or evaluated in the MGH Neurology outpatient clinics, as well as on the inpatient Medical and Vascular Surgical services from January 2003 to July 2008.
note: Hospital-based study of consecutive acute ischaemic stroke patients at Massachusetts General Hospital with matched stroke-free controls, for stroke risk and outcome genetics; a SiGN genetic research centre. No exposure design.

label: Melanoma Institute Australia cohort
quote: With written, informed consent, patients with histo-pathological confirmed CM cases managed at MIA, Sydney, Australia were identified from this Biospecimen Bank and Database.
note: Patients with histopathologically confirmed cutaneous melanoma from the Melanoma Institute Australia biospecimen bank, followed for melanoma-specific survival. Australia's high UV setting is context, not a selection by exposure.

label: Montrachet Study
quote: The Montrachet (Maculopathy Optic Nerve nuTRition neurovAsCular and HEarT diseases) Study is a population‐based study designed to find associations between age‐related eye diseases and neurologic and heart diseases in the elderly as a primary objective.
note: Population-based eye study of Dijon 3C participants aged 75 and over, whose primary objective is age-related eye diseases and their associations with neurologic and heart diseases; a general population sample set up around one disease family, hence medium confidence. Nutrition appears in the name but is not the recruitment basis or stated design.

label: MUNICH stroke study
quote: Cases were consecutive European Caucasians recruited from a single dedicated Stroke Unit at the Department of Neurology, Klinikum Großhadern, Ludwig-Maximilians-University, Munich.
note: Hospital-based collection of consecutive ischaemic stroke patients from the Munich stroke unit, genotyped in WTCCC2 and contributing to METASTROKE, SiGN and MEGASTROKE. No exposure design.

label: Murcia Twin Registry
quote: The Murcia Twin Registry (MTR) was created in 2006, under the auspices of the University of Murcia and the regional Health Authority, aiming to develop a research resource in Spain intended to stimulate current research and new investigation on the analysis of genetic factors related to health and health-related behaviors.
note: Population-based register of adult twins in Murcia for research on genetic and environmental influences on health and health-related behaviours; a twin registry with a broad purpose, neither disease- nor exposure-selected.

label: Norwegian, Exeter and King's College Consortium for Genetics of Neuropsychiatric Symptoms in Dementia
note: A consortium that pools Alzheimer's disease patients from Norwegian registries and nursing-home cohorts, AddNeuroMed and Italian and Greek clinics to study the genetics of psychosis and affective symptoms in dementia; every participant of the GWAS it fed was diagnosed with AD. No environmental exposure in its design.

label: NeuroGenetics Research Consortium
note: A clinic-recruited case-control sample of Parkinson's disease patients and healthy controls in four US states; environmental risk factors are covariates, not the recruitment basis.

label: Genetics of Hypertension in Blacks
note: Community-recruited Yoruba adults with normal or elevated blood pressure from Igbo-Ora and Idikan, gathered for a long-term study of hypertension and analysed as hypertensives versus normotensives (consortium papers call it a case-control study of hypertension). Environmental factors are mentioned only in passing.

label: Nanjing Medical University Global Screening Array project
note: A Chinese case-control sample of histologically confirmed non-small-cell lung cancer patients and cancer-free controls genotyped by Nanjing Medical University; smoking is a covariate, not the design.

label: Parkinson's Disease Cognitive Genetics Consortium
note: A consortium of US Parkinson's disease research centres that pools PD patients with a shared cognitive battery to find genetic risk factors for cognitive impairment in PD.

label: Poland Ovarian Cancer Study
note: A Polish case-control study of ovarian cancer within the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Screening Across the Lifespan Twin survey, Younger cohort
quote: The target population was the younger part of the SALT cohort born between 1943 and 1958.
note: A questionnaire and saliva-collection wave of the Swedish Twin Registry's SALT cohort (twins born 1943-1958) run with epidemiologists, clinicians, political scientists and economists: a twin registry sample with a broad purpose, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort, although the registry itself was founded to study smoking and alcohol.

label: Severe Asthma Research Program
note: An NHLBI network recruiting adults and children with severe and non-severe asthma for deep phenotyping of severe asthma mechanisms.

label: Sickle Cell Clinical Research and Intervention Program
note: A St. Jude lifespan cohort of patients with sickle cell disease; geospatial and social-determinant data are collected but exposure is not the design.

label: Asian Indian Diabetic Heart Study/Sikh Diabetes Study
note: A family-based then case-control study of type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease in Punjabi Sikhs of North India; 'environmental factors' are mentioned generically, not as an exposure design.

label: Sickle Cell Genome Project
note: A whole-genome-sequenced cohort of sickle cell disease patients from Baylor and the SCCRIP cohort.

label: St George's stroke cohort
note: A hospital-based collection of ischaemic stroke patients at St George's London, one of the WTCCC2 and SiGN stroke case collections.

label: Sisters in Breast Screening Study
note: Cancer-free women and their female relatives recruited through NHS breast screening, not selected for risk, but the study's stated purpose is the genetics of breast-cancer intermediate phenotypes (mammographic density, sex hormones), so it is a population study of one disease.

label: St. Jude Lifetime Cohort Study
note: Survivors of paediatric cancer treated at St. Jude, followed for late effects of the cancer and its treatment; chemotherapy and radiotherapy are medical treatments, so this is not an environmental exposure cohort.

label: Swedish Low-risk Colorectal Cancer Study
note: Consecutive colorectal cancer patients from 14 hospitals in central Sweden with spouse controls; a lifestyle questionnaire was collected but exposure is not the design.

label: Screening Markers for Colorectal Cancer Study
note: A case-control study of colorectal polyps (adenomas and serrated polyps) versus polyp-free controls among Group Health colonoscopy patients; adenoma is a pre-cancerous state, so the cases are at risk of colorectal cancer, and its advanced-adenoma cases feed colorectal cancer consortia.

label: Siblings With Ischemic Stroke Study
note: Affected sibling pairs with ischaemic stroke (plus some stroke-free siblings) enrolled at US and Canadian centres for linkage and family-based association.

label: Saguenay Youth Study
exposures: prenatal exposure to maternal cigarette smoking
