quote: The SYS is a retrospective study of long-term consequences of prenatal exposure to maternal cigarette smoking (PEMCS) in which multiple quantitative phenotypes are acquired over five sessions (telephone interview, home, hospital, laboratory, and school).
note: Adolescent sibships from the Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean founder population, half selected as prenatally exposed to maternal smoking and matched with non-exposed adolescents, so an exposure-defined cohort; its disease aim ('common cardiometabolic and brain diseases') is broad, not one disease.

label: ThyroidOmics Consortium
note: A consortium of mostly population-based cohorts whose stated purpose is thyroid disease and thyroid function; much of its output concerns thyroid hormone levels (a trait), but it also meta-analyses hypo- and hyperthyroidism, so it counts as a population study of one disease family.

label: Treatment Options for Type 2 Diabetes in Adolescents and Youth
note: A randomised trial (with observational follow-up) of children and adolescents with recent-onset type 2 diabetes; the lifestyle arm is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Tracking Parkinson's
note: A UK multicentre longitudinal study of recent- and young-onset Parkinson's disease patients (with some unaffected siblings) to explain phenotypic variation.

label: Universitatsklinikum Saarlandes case-control dataset
note: A German case-control cohort of clinically diagnosed sporadic Alzheimer's disease patients and matched population controls.

label: Viborg Vascular
note: A randomised population screening trial of all men aged 65-74 in the Central Denmark Region, invited to screening for abdominal aortic aneurysm, peripheral arterial disease and hypertension: a general population sample whose stated purpose is one vascular disease family, so a population study of disease rather than a patient cohort.

label: West Bank Cancer Registry
note: The Palestinian Ministry of Health's cancer registry for the West Bank, continuing the West Bank part of the population-based Palestinian Cancer Registry; a disease registry of incident cancer cases.

label: Washington University St. Louis Stroke Study
note: A hospital-based collection of ischaemic stroke patients admitted to Barnes-Jewish Hospital in St. Louis, one of the SiGN genetic research centres.

label: Sea Islands Genetics Network – Reasons for Geographic and Racial Differences in Stroke
note: The SIGNET-genotyped subset of REGARDS: African American participants with type 2 diabetes plus matched diabetes-free controls (and Low Country residents), contributed to the MEDIA consortium as one of 17 type 2 diabetes case-control GWAS. The parent REGARDS is a stroke cohort, but this subset was selected for diabetes; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium 2 Parkinson's disease study
note: Case-control GWAS of UK patients with idiopathic Parkinson's disease against WTCCC2 controls; a disease patient series, no exposure.

label: CALGB 80303
note: Phase III trial whose participants all have locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer; the bevacizumab intervention is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: CALGB 90401
note: Phase III trial of men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer; treatment is not an exposure.

label: Colonomics
note: Multi-omics series of stage II colon cancer patients (tumour and paired normal mucosa) with healthy-donor mucosa as reference; a patient series, no exposure.

label: CALGB 40503
note: Trial of women with hormone receptor-positive advanced breast cancer; endocrine therapy and bevacizumab are treatments, not exposures.

label: 23Mofang cohort
quote: Participants were recruited from 23Mofang Inc.—a Chinese direct-to-consumer genetic testing company—through organic posts on their official app.
note: Research cohort of customers of a Chinese direct-to-consumer genetic testing company with self-reported traits; individual GWAS pick self-reported cases (myopia, photic sneeze reflex) from it, but the cohort itself is unselected for disease or exposure.

label: 3D Facial Norms cohort
quote: All individuals were recruited as part of the 3DFN project, which was limited to individuals of self-identified European ancestry who had no history of craniofacial trauma, congenital malformation, or surgery.
note: Normative craniofacial repository of healthy people screened to exclude craniofacial conditions; a control/normative cohort about facial morphology, not disease or exposure.

label: 4D-SZ cohort
quote: As the first time point for the vagino-cervical microbiome of the 4D-SZ cohort, 516 Chinese volunteers joined from May to July during an annual physical examination in 2017.
note: Multi-omics cohort of adult volunteers recruited at annual physical examinations in Shenzhen; diet and lifestyle are recorded among many variables for host-microbiome study, but exposure is not a stated design purpose and no disease selects the participants.

label: Age-Related Eye Disease Study
note: Retinal-clinic cohort recruited with a spectrum of AMD and lens opacity (from none to advanced) to follow the clinical course of AMD and cataract, with embedded randomised trials of antioxidant vitamins and zinc for both; most participants have some disease, and the supplements are a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Age-Related Eye Disease Study 2
note: Phase 3 trial of people with bilateral intermediate AMD or advanced AMD in one eye, at risk of progression to advanced AMD; nutritional supplements are the intervention, not an exposure.

label: African Research on Kidney Disease
note: Kidney-function study embedded in general population cohorts in Malawi, South Africa and Uganda, enrolling adults with and without CKD by baseline serum creatinine to measure GFR and determine CKD; its stated purpose is one disease, so a population study of kidney disease; no environmental exposure.

label: Berkeley Aging Cohort Study
quote: Seventy‐eight cognitively healthy OA were recruited through the Berkeley Aging Cohort Study (BACS), an ongoing longitudinal study of typical cognitive aging in community‐dwelling older adults.
note: Community volunteers with normal cognition followed for typical cognitive aging with amyloid and tau PET; preclinical Alzheimer's pathology is studied in them, but they are healthy volunteers not selected for disease or risk and the stated purpose is normal aging, so not a disease cohort; no exposure.

label: Diabetes UK Warren 1 Repository
note: DNA repository of British families with two or more siblings affected by type 1 diabetes (and their parents) for linkage and association studies; a disease family collection, no exposure.

label: Brain Development and Air Pollution Ultrafine Particles in School Children
exposures: traffic-related air pollution | elemental carbon | nitrogen dioxide | ultrafine particles
quote: We conducted a prospective study of children (n = 2,715, aged 7 to 10 y) from 39 schools in Barcelona (Catalonia, Spain) exposed to high and low traffic-related air pollution, paired by school socioeconomic index; children were tested four times (i.e., to assess the 12-mo developmental trajectories) via computerized tests (n = 10,112).
note: Schoolchildren cohort built to measure the effect of traffic-related air pollution (EC, NO2, ultrafine particles) on cognitive and brain development, with schools chosen as high/low pollution pairs (so also selected by exposure); typically developing children, no disease.

label: National Cancer Institute Breast and Prostate Cancer Cohort Consortium
note: Consortium pooling nested case-control studies of breast and prostate cancer from large prospective cohorts; classified by what it collects (cancer cases and controls). Some member cohorts (EPIC, ATBC) are diet cohorts, but the consortium's purpose is genetic and gene-environment analysis of the two cancers, not exposure.

label: Biomarkers and Stratification To Optimise outcomes in Psoriasis
note: Prospective observational study and biobank of patients with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis starting systemic therapy; a patient cohort, no exposure.

label: Black Women's Health Study
quote: Black Women’s Health Study (BWHS) is a U.S. prospective cohort study of 59,000 United States Black women who enrolled in the study in 1995 and have been followed by biennial questionnaires since then.
note: General prospective cohort of Black women followed for many conditions (breast cancer, lupus, hypertension, diabetes, fibroids); a broad-purpose population cohort, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: Coronary Artery Calcification in Type 1 Diabetes Study
note: Adults with long-standing type 1 diabetes and non-diabetic controls followed for coronary artery calcification; participants selected for the disease, the outcome is subclinical coronary atherosclerosis; no exposure.

label: Collaborative Association Study of Psoriasis
note: Pooled case-control collection of dermatologist-diagnosed psoriasis cases and controls from three US groups, genotyped through GAIN; a disease case-control cohort, no exposure.

label: California and Uganda Prostate Cancer Study
note: Case-control study of prostate cancer in men of African ancestry (SEER-identified cases in Los Angeles, incident cases at Mulago Hospital, Kampala) used as a prostate cancer GRS replication set; a disease case-control cohort, no exposure.

label: Cryptosporidiosis and Enteropathogens in Bangladesh Birth Cohort
note: Birth cohort in urban and rural Bangladesh followed with surveillance and monthly stools to study the incidence, immunity and genetic susceptibility of cryptosporidiosis (and other enteropathogens) and its effect on growth; a birth cohort whose stated purpose is one infectious disease. Children are not selected by exposure, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Childhood Cancer Survivor Study
note: Retrospective cohort of five-year survivors of childhood cancer (with sibling comparisons) for research on late effects; participants all had cancer. Its 'exposures' are cancer treatments (radiotherapy, anthracyclines), which are medical treatments and out of scope.

label: Collaborative European NeuroTrauma Effectiveness Research in Traumatic Brain Injury
note: Prospective observational cohort of patients presenting to hospital with traumatic brain injury across Europe and Israel; a patient cohort, no environmental exposure.

label: Cystic Fibrosis-Related Diabetes Study
note: Johns Hopkins study enrolling people with cystic fibrosis with and without CF-related diabetes, a contributor to the Cystic Fibrosis Genome Project; a patient cohort, no exposure.

label: US Cystic Fibrosis Twin and Sibling Study
note: Family-based study of twins and siblings who all have cystic fibrosis, recruited on the basis of having CF, to find genetic and environmental modifiers of CF outcomes; the participants are patients, and the 'environmental' modifiers are generic clinical covariates, not a defining environmental exposure.

label: Chicago Health and Aging Project
note: Population-based cohort of older adults in four Chicago neighbourhoods whose stated purpose is common chronic conditions of late life, especially risk factors for incident Alzheimer's disease, with clinical evaluation for AD in stratified random samples; the purpose is broad but centred on Alzheimer's disease. Air-pollution analyses were done later on modelled exposures, not as the design purpose, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: Christchurch Health and Development Study
quote: The Christchurch Health and Development Study (CHDS) is a longitudinal cohort study that enrolled at birth 1265 people born in Christchurch, New Zealand in 1977.
note: Population-based birth cohort of all children born in Christchurch over four months in 1977, followed on health, development and wellbeing across the life course; a general birth cohort with no disease or exposure as its purpose (earthquake exposure was asked about retrospectively at age 35, not a recruitment basis).

label: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke Exploratory Trials in Parkinson's Disease Long-Term Study-1
note: Phase III placebo-controlled trial population of adults with early treated Parkinson's disease, randomised to creatine or placebo; a patient cohort, and the only 'exposure' is a trial drug.

label: Dunedin Multidisciplinary Health and Development Study
quote: Participants were members of the Dunedin Multidisciplinary Health and Development Study, a longitudinal study of 1037 people born in New Zealand in 1972-1973.
note: Complete birth cohort born in Dunedin in 1972-1973, followed from age 3 into midlife on health and behaviour across seven research themes (mental health, cardiovascular, respiratory, oral, sexual health, psychosocial); a general birth cohort with no single disease or exposure purpose.

label: European Community Respiratory Health Survey
quote: The European Community Respiratory Health Survey (ECRHS) is a multicentre population-based cohort study that began in 1990–1994.
note: Multicentre cohort of adults aged 20-44 selected at random from population registers to compare the prevalence, risk factors and treatment of asthma and allergic disease across countries, followed for asthma, allergy, lung function and COPD: a general-population study set up for one disease family. Second-hand smoke, occupational and other risk factors are measured as risk factors for asthma rather than as the design purpose, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: EDRN Colorectal and Pancreatic Neoplasm Virtual Biorepository
note: NCI Early Detection Research Network biorepository at the University of Pittsburgh of clinically annotated specimens and data from patients managed for colorectal and pancreatic cancers, other GI malignancies, premalignant conditions, IBD and pancreatic disease (plus colorectal cancer screening patients); a patient biorepository, with tumour accessions, and no exposure design.

label: Echinococcus Multilocularis and Internal Diseases in Leutkirch
quote: Participating in the present study were 2,187 adults (1,138 females [52.0%]; 1,049 males [48.0%], age: 18-65 years) taken from a sample of 4,000 persons randomly chosen from an urban population.
note: Population-based random sample of residents of Leutkirch, Germany, examined in 2002 with questionnaire, ultrasound and blood sampling; its original aim of measuring the prevalence of Echinococcus multilocularis infection was widened to internal diseases and public health generally, so it is a general health survey of unselected residents rather than a disease or exposure cohort.

label: Early Pseudomonas Infection Control Observational Study
note: Prospective observational cohort of children with cystic fibrosis aged 12 or under who were Pseudomonas aeruginosa-negative at enrolment, followed at 59 US CF centres for risk factors and consequences of early Pa acquisition; a patient cohort. Environmental risk factors (cigarette smoke, hot tubs, daycare) are among the risk factors evaluated, not a defining exposure or the design purpose.

label: Environmental Risk Longitudinal Twin Study
quote: The Environmental Risk Longitudinal Twin Study (E-Risk) comprised 2163 twin children from England and Wales (49.1% male) identified at birth in 1994 and 1995 and included administration of the Test of Word Reading Efficiency at age 7 years and the Wechsler Preschool and Primary Scale of Intelligence-Revised as a test of IQ at age 5 years.
note: Nationally representative twin birth cohort (England and Wales, 1994-95) studying how environmental and genetic factors contribute to behaviour, health and mental health problems from childhood to adulthood; a twin registry-type birth cohort with a broad purpose. The 'environmental risk' in its name is psychosocial (family, social, digital environments), not an environmental agent in scope here.

label: Gabapentin for chronic pelvic pain in women
note: Participants of a UK multicentre placebo-controlled trial of gabapentin in women aged 18-50 with chronic pelvic pain of at least three months and no obvious pelvic pathology; a patient (trial) cohort whose only 'exposure' is the trial drug.

label: Interdisciplinary Group for Advanced Research on BirtH outcomes - DBT India Initiative
quote: A cohort study of pregnant women was initiated in May 2015 at the civil hospital in Gurugram, Haryana, India.
note: Single-centre prospective pregnancy cohort in Haryana, India, enrolling women before 20 weeks' gestation and following them to delivery to find correlates and risk-prediction tools for preterm birth. Participants are unselected pregnant women and the outcome studied, preterm birth, is a pregnancy outcome rather than a disease, so it is not classed as a disease cohort; no environmental exposure is its purpose.

label: Global Biobank Meta-analysis Initiative
quote: We introduce the Global Biobank Meta-analysis Initiative (GBMI)-a collaborative network of 23 biobanks from 4 continents representing more than 2.2 million consented individuals with genetic data linked to electronic health records.
note: Consortium of population biobanks with genotypes linked to health records that meta-analyses GWAS across many diseases and endpoints; a collection of general biobanks, not defined by any disease or exposure.

label: Treatment program of DLBCL patients from the Groupe d'Etude des Lymphomes de l'Adulte
note: Patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma enrolled in the GELA LNH03 treatment trials whose germline DNA formed the case series of the GELA DLBCL GWAS (controls drawn from EPIC France); a patient series treated with chemotherapy regimens, with no exposure design.

label: Genetic and Environmental Risk Factors for Alzheimer's Disease Among African Americans Study
note: Case-control study of Alzheimer's disease in African Americans aged 65 or over identified through Henry Ford Health System claims data, with AD cases and cognitively normal controls; the cases of a case-control study. 'Environmental risk factors' in the name is generic and no environmental agent defines the sample or its design as documented.

label: Gene Environment Interaction and Breast Cancer in Germany
exposures: night work | shift work | environmental factors interacting with genes in breast cancer
quote: We have investigated the risk in a German population-based case-control study known as GENICA (gene environment interaction and breast cancer).
note: Population-based case-control study of breast cancer in the Greater Bonn region, built (with the Institute for Prevention and Occupational Medicine) to study how genes and environmental exposures interact in breast cancer, with detailed interviews on night and shift work; the cases make it a disease cohort and its gene-environment design centres on exposures, though the specific agents documented here are occupational (night work) rather than physical or chemical.

label: Genizon GWAS
note: Case-control GWAS sample of psoriasis patients and controls from the Quebec founder population assembled by Genizon BioSciences; the cases of a case-control study, no exposure design.

label: GEnetic analysis of NUclear Families with Atopic Dermatitis
note: Family-based genetic study recruiting nuclear families through at least two children with early-onset moderate to severe atopic dermatitis, plus unrelated affected children in its extended phase; a patient (affected family) cohort with no exposure design.

label: German Myocardial Infarction Family Study
note: Series of German case collections (GerMIFS I-VII) of people with early myocardial infarction or coronary artery disease, including familial cases and patients referred for angiography, compared with population controls; an aggregation of patient case series for one disease family, no exposure design.

label: Gene-Lifestyle Interactions and Complex Traits Involved in Elevated Disease Risk Study
exposures: lifestyle (diet, physical activity, smoking, alcohol) | gene-lifestyle interactions
quote: Established in 2008, the GLACIER Study comprises a cohort suitable for studies on the genetics of complex cardio-metabolic traits and gene-environment interactions, nested within the NSHDS.
note: Population-based prospective cohort nested in the Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study, established specifically for gene-lifestyle interaction studies of cardiometabolic traits, with diet (FFQ), physical activity, smoking and alcohol data from the Vasterbotten Intervention Programme; lifestyle exposures are its stated main subject, hence an exposure cohort, but its participants are unselected adults and its disease scope (cardiometabolic traits, type 2 diabetes, obesity, CAD) is broad, so not a disease cohort.

label: German Multicenter Allergy Study
note: German birth cohort of 1314 newborns recruited in 1990 in five cities, deliberately enriched for newborns at high allergy risk (two allergic family members or raised cord-blood IgE) and followed into adulthood to study asthma, allergic rhinitis, eczema and sensitisation; a birth cohort set up for one disease family (part of the sample also 'at risk'), with no environmental exposure as its purpose.

label: Genetic Modifier Study
note: Case-control study of genetic modifiers of cystic fibrosis lung disease enrolling F508del-homozygous CF patients at the extremes of lung function from US CF centres; a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: Genetic Modifier Study of Severe CF Liver Disease
note: International case-control study of genetic modifiers of severe liver disease in cystic fibrosis, enrolling CF patients with cirrhosis and portal hypertension and CF controls without liver disease; a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: GSK
note: Pharmacogenetic sample of outpatients with moderate to severe major depressive disorder from two GlaxoSmithKline escitalopram trials, contributed to NEWMEDS for antidepressant-response genetics; a patient (trial) cohort whose only 'exposure' is a medication.

label: GSK Munich recurrent major depression case-control study
note: GlaxoSmithKline case-control sample of German patients with recurrent major depression recruited at the Max Planck Institute of Psychiatry in Munich and two satellite hospitals, with screened community controls, used as the first case-control cohort of the recurrent MDD GWAS; the cases of a case-control study, no exposure design.

label: Great Smoky Mountains Study
quote: A multistage, overlapping cohorts design was used, in which 4500 of the 11758 children aged 9, 11, and 13 years in an 11-county area of the southeastern United States were randomly selected for screening for psychiatric symptoms.
note: A population-based longitudinal study of rural North Carolina children, sampled at random with oversampling of high scorers on a psychiatric screen, designed to study childhood psychiatric disorders and service use; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Hasselt Appendicitis Immunology and Environmental Study
exposures: environmental factors | dietary habits | lifestyle characteristics
quote: In a cohort of 300 patients and 300 controls, environmental factors as well as genetic make-up of the innate immune system, focusing mainly on pattern recognition, will be analyzed in order to gain insight in their relative importance in the pathology of appendicitis.
note: A prospective cohort of acute appendicitis patients at Jessa Hospital, Hasselt; its registered aim includes analysing environmental factors (diet, lifestyle, early-life environment by questionnaire) in the pathology of appendicitis, so it counts as designed to study exposures, though the exposures are broad.

label: Hwasun Cancer Epidemiology Study-Breast
note: The breast cancer arm of a hospital-based case-control study at Chonnam National University Hwasun Hospital; its cases are newly diagnosed breast cancer patients, and no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Health2008 Study
quote: In the population-based Health2008 study, 2218 men and women aged 30-60 years were invited.
note: A cross-sectional population-based study of a random sample of adults aged 30-60 in the Copenhagen area; neither an exposure nor a single disease defines it.

label: Health2010 Study
quote: The Health2010 study was conducted between 2010 and 2012 where 3732 persons between 18 and 69 years of age were invited.
note: A population-based study of a random sample of Danish adults aged 18-69 with a broad focus (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, asthma and allergy), so not a single-disease cohort, and no exposure defines it.

label: Hong Kong Diabetes Register
note: A prospective register of diabetes patients at the Prince of Wales Hospital, Hong Kong, followed for complications and outcomes; a patient cohort with no defining environmental exposure.

label: HostSeq initiative
note: A Canadian databank aggregating 13 studies of people infected with SARS-CoV-2, for host-genetic research on COVID-19 outcomes; the participants have the infection, so it is a disease (patients) aggregation rather than an exposed-uninfected cohort.

label: Hvidoere Remission Phase Study
note: A multinational cohort of children with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes followed for 12 months to study residual beta-cell function; a patient cohort with no defining exposure.

label: Nord-Trøndelag Health Study 1995–97
quote: All current residents ≥20 years of age in Nord-Trøndelag have been invited to each survey wave: the HUNT1 (1984–86, 77 202 participants, 89.4% of invitees participated),1 HUNT2 (1995-97, 65 228 participants, 69.5%)2 and HUNT3 (2006-08, 50 800 participants, 54.1%)3 surveys (Figure 1).
note: The second HUNT survey, to which all adult residents of Nord-Trøndelag were invited; a general population health survey defined neither by an exposure nor by a disease.

label: HypnoLaus Sleep Cohort Study
quote: We invited a cohort of 3043 consecutive participants of the CoLaus/PsyCoLaus study to take part.
note: A population-based sleep cohort of consecutive CoLaus/PsyCoLaus participants given home polysomnography; its stated aim is the prevalence of sleep-disordered breathing, one disease family, so a population study of disease; no exposure defines it.

label: Interaction of Gene and Environment of Depression during PostPartum
note: A prospective cohort of women recruited after delivery in Paris maternity units and followed for a year to study postpartum depression; the 'environment' it studies is stressful life events and childhood trauma, which are psychosocial and outside the exposure scope.

label: Impact of Neurodevelopmental disorders and School performance: genes and environment
note: A school-based cohort in Catalonia screening children for mental health problems and learning difficulties with diagnostic confirmation, set up to study neurodevelopmental disorders and school performance; 'environment' in the name is not a specific environmental exposure.

label: Japanese Consortium for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis research
note: A Japanese multicentre registry of ALS patients with DNA and clinical follow-up; a patient cohort with no defining exposure.

label: JAPC GWAS
note: A nested case-control GWAS of prostate cancer in Japanese American men of the Multiethnic Cohort; the cases have the disease, and the GWAS itself is not designed around an environmental exposure.

label: Japan Prospective Studies Collaboration for Aging and Dementia
quote: The Japan Prospective Studies Collaboration for Aging and Dementia (JPSC-AD) is a multisite, population-based prospective cohort study of dementia, which was designed to enroll approximately 10,000 community-dwelling residents aged 65 years or older from 8 sites in Japan and to follow them up prospectively for at least 5 years.
note: A population-based cohort of community-dwelling older Japanese followed for incident dementia; its 'environmental risk factors' are general lifestyle and medical variables (diabetes, obesity, smoking, inactivity), not a defining environmental exposure.

label: Korean Research Project on the Integrated Exposure Assessment of Hazardous Substances for Food Safety
exposures: dietary exposure to hazardous substances | lead (Pb) | cadmium (Cd) | mercury (Hg)
quote: KRIEFS was the first survey in Korea to conduct a nationwide integrated dietary exposure assessment on hazardous substances in people of all ages.
note: A nationwide Korean survey population sampled across all ages and built to assess dietary exposure to hazardous substances (heavy metals and others) with biomonitoring; an exposure study of the general population, not a disease cohort.

label: LAPC GWAS
note: A nested case-control GWAS of prostate cancer in Latino men of the Multiethnic Cohort; the cases have the disease, and the GWAS is not designed around an environmental exposure.

label: Levodopa in Early Parkinson's Disease
note: A Dutch randomised delayed-start trial of levodopa in patients with early Parkinson's disease; a patient trial cohort whose only 'exposure' is a medication, which is out of scope.

label: Luxembourg Parkinson's Study
note: A Luxembourg observational cohort of patients with Parkinson's disease and atypical parkinsonism plus controls, deeply phenotyped for diagnosis and progression markers; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Lung Tissue Research Consortium
note: An NHLBI biobank of lung tissue and blood from adults undergoing thoracic surgery, formed to collect material from patients with COPD and interstitial lung diseases (some participants turned out not to have them); no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Mammary Carcinoma Risk Factor Investigation
note: A German population-based case-control study of postmenopausal breast cancer whose cases were followed as a patient cohort; its main risk factor of interest, menopausal hormone therapy, is a medication and out of the exposure scope.

label: Mayo Clinic Study of Aging
quote: The Olmsted County, Minn., population, aged 70-89 years on October 1, 2004, was enumerated using the Rochester Epidemiology Project. Eligible subjects were randomly selected and invited to participate.
note: A random population sample of Olmsted County residents established to study the prevalence, incidence and risk factors of MCI and dementia; a population study of one disease family, not defined by any exposure.

label: MedStar
note: A hospital-based case-control study of angiographic coronary artery disease among patients undergoing cardiac catheterisation at Washington Hospital Center; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Melanoma in Southern Sweden
exposures: UV exposure | sunbed use | sun-exposure habits
quote: A prospective, population-based study of 40,000 women regarding host factors, UV exposure and sunbed use in relation to risk and anatomic site of cutaneous melanoma.
note: A random population sample of southern Swedish women set up to study melanoma risk factors, centred on UV exposure, sunbed use and sun-exposure habits by questionnaire; so both a population study of melanoma and a cohort designed to study UV exposure (quote is the title of the cohort's design paper, printed by cached.py).

label: Michigan State University Twin Registry
quote: The MSUTR has two broad components: a large-scale, population-based registry of child, adolescent, and adult twins and their families (current N~30,000) and a series of more focused and in-depth studies drawn from the registry (projected N~7,200).
note: A population-based twin registry from Michigan birth records; although its research focus is psychopathology, twin registries are out of scope as disease cohorts, and no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Mater-University of Queensland Study of Pregnancy
note: A Brisbane pregnancy birth cohort of mother-child pairs that became a general longitudinal study of growth, development and ageing; neither exposure nor one disease is its design basis.

label: Myositis Genetics Consortium
note: An international consortium collecting DNA from patients with idiopathic inflammatory myopathies; its members are patients, so disease: patients; no exposure basis.

label: Carolina Breast Cancer Study
note: A population-based case-control and case cohort study of breast cancer in North Carolina; cases have the disease. Risk factors are studied among many, not as an exposure design.

label: North Carolina Bladder Cancer Study
note: A hospital-based bladder cancer case-control study; cases are patients. Smoking is analysed as a modifier of genetic susceptibility, but participants were not selected for exposure and the main subject is carcinogen-metabolism and DNA-repair genotype, so exposure is no.

label: NCI-Maryland Prostate Cancer Case-Control Study
note: A prostate cancer case-control study in Baltimore; cases are patients. No exposure defines the cohort.

label: Northern Finland Birth Cohort 1966
note: A whole-population birth cohort of northern Finland set up to study risk factors and consequences of preterm birth and intrauterine growth retardation (pregnancy outcomes, not a disease in scope), later a general life-course cohort.

label: Linxian General Population Nutrition Intervention Trial
exposures: daily combined vitamin/mineral supplement
quote: Finally, a total of 29,584 subjects were included in the NIT study in 1986 to receive daily combined vitamin/mineral supplement or placebo.
note: A randomized vitamin/mineral supplementation trial of healthy adults in Linxian, a county with some of the world's highest oesophageal/gastric cardia cancer rates, followed as a cohort; nutritional exposure is its main subject (borderline, as the exposure is a supplement intervention) and its purpose is prevention of these cancers.

label: Neuro-Ophthalmology Research at Fundació ACE
note: Memory-clinic cohort of people evaluated for cognitive decline at Ace Alzheimer Center Barcelona, mostly dementia and MCI patients with some cognitively healthy participants; no exposure basis.

label: New York Cancer Project
note: A venue-sampled cohort and biorepository of New York adults whose stated aims centre on cancer aetiology and racial/ethnic disparities in cancer; no exposure defines it.

label: Okinawa Bioinformation Bank
note: A population-based biobank of Okinawa residents for population history and genetics of common and rare diseases; neither exposure nor a single disease defines it.

label: Pancreatic Cancer Cohort Consortium
note: An NCI consortium collecting pancreatic cancer cases and controls from cohorts and case-control studies for GWAS; classified by its cases as a pancreatic cancer patient aggregation; no exposure basis.

label: Prostate Cancer Genome-wide Association Study of Uncommon Susceptibility Loci
note: A nested prostate cancer case-control GWAS within the PLCO screening trial; cases are prostate cancer patients; no exposure basis.

label: University of Pennsylvania Catheterization Study
note: Consecutive patients undergoing cardiac catheterisation and coronary angiography, studied for coronary artery disease; no exposure basis.

label: Pediatric Imaging, Neurocognition, and Genetics
note: A cross-sectional imaging-genetics repository of typically developing children and young adults about brain and cognitive development; neither exposure nor disease defines it.

label: Karolinska Mammography Project for Risk Prediction of Breast Cancer - Case-Control Study
note: A Swedish breast cancer case-control study of Stockholm breast cancer patients with KARMA controls; no exposure basis.

label: Parkinson Research Examination of CEP-1347 Trial
note: A randomized drug trial in early Parkinson's disease patients, followed observationally afterwards; the only exposure is a drug, so exposure is no.

label: Predictors For ECT
note: Swedish patients treated with ECT for severe major depressive episodes; ECT is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Performance of Rotavirus and Oral Polio Vaccines in Developing Countries
quote: A randomized clinical trial platform evaluated the efficacy of delayed-dose oral rotavirus vaccine as well as the benefit of an injectable polio vaccine replacing one dose of oral polio vaccine.
note: A vaccine-trial birth cohort of newborns in low-income Dhaka studying oral vaccine underperformance; the defining exposure is vaccination (a medical intervention), and enteric infections are outcomes studied, not a recruitment basis or a single-disease purpose.

label: Queensland Twin Registry
note: A population-based twin registry; twin registries are no on both counts.

label: Research in African American Alzheimer Disease Initiative
note: A family-based study of African American families affected by Alzheimer's disease (patients with their relatives) to find AD genes; no exposure basis.

label: The Roskilde cohort of pregnant women
quote: A total of 1214 unselected pregnant women enrolled at nuchal translucency examination between 11(+3) and 13(+6) weeks of gestation.
note: A cohort of unselected pregnant women set up to test a biomarker for preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction; pregnancy itself does not count, but its stated purpose is these pregnancy disorders, so population study of disease (borderline).

label: Shanghai Breast Cancer Genetics Study
note: A breast cancer case-control genetics study pooling cases and controls from four Shanghai studies; classified by its cases as breast cancer patients; no exposure basis.

label: Scandinavian Lymphoma Etiology study
note: A Danish-Swedish population-based case-control study of lymphoma aetiology; cases are patients. Exposures such as UV are studied among many risk factors, not as a design basis, so exposure is no.

label: Spanish Coalition to Unlock Research on Host Genetics on COVID-19
note: A host-genetics cohort of hospital-recruited COVID-19 patients; the infection is the disease, not an exposure in the exposed-uninfected sense.

label: Steno Diabetes Center T2D Cases
note: Type 2 diabetes patients and controls from the Steno Diabetes Center outpatient clinic; no exposure basis.

label: Scottish Diabetes Research Network Type 1 Bioresource
note: A Scottish bioresource of people with a clinical diagnosis of type 1 diabetes, so a patient cohort; no environmental exposure defines or drives it.

label: Shanxi Upper Gastrointestinal Cancer Genetics Project
note: A case-control and case-only genetics project of upper gastrointestinal cancers in Shanxi, so its cases are patients. Questionnaire risk factors such as diet and smoking were measured, but the project is a genetic study of cancer cases, not one designed around an environmental exposure.

label: Swiss HIV Cohort Study
note: A nationwide cohort of people living with HIV, so a patient cohort; the infection is the disease, not an exposure of uninfected people.

label: Study of Osteoporotic Fractures
note: A population-based cohort of community-dwelling women aged 65 or older set up to study risk factors for osteoporotic fractures, so a population study of one disease family; no environmental exposure is its design purpose.

label: Study of Twin Adults: Genes and Environment
quote: The 'Study of Twin Adults: Genes and Environment’ (STAGE) is a cohort of the Swedish Twin Registry at the Karolinska Institute in Stockholm, of approximately 32,000 twin individuals, born between 1959 and 1985.
note: A twin cohort of the Swedish Twin Registry recruited by birth year, not by any exposure or disease.

label: Sequenced Treatment Alternatives to Relieve Depression
note: A treatment trial of outpatients with nonpsychotic major depressive disorder; the only exposures are antidepressant treatments, which are out of scope.

label: Tyypin 1 Diabeteksen Genetiikka
note: A Finnish collection of type 1 diabetes cases used in ImmunoChip studies, contributing independent cases, so a patient cohort; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Swedish Twin study of CHild and Adolescent Development
quote: Participants were originally included in a population-based longitudinal twin study, the Twin Study of Child and Adolescent Development (TCHAD),34 comprising all twins born in Sweden between May 1985 and December 1986 (2960 children in total).
note: A population-based twin study of all Swedish twins born 1985-86, about how genes and environments shape development of health and behavioural problems; broad purpose, not selected by exposure or disease.

label: Transforming Research and Clinical Knowledge in Traumatic Brain Injury
note: A multicentre observational cohort of patients with acute traumatic brain injury (with orthopaedic trauma controls), so a patient cohort; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Type 1 Diabetes TrialNet
note: TrialNet screens relatives of people with type 1 diabetes and autoantibody-positive people for its natural-history study, and also runs trials in newly diagnosed patients; mainly an at-risk cohort for type 1 diabetes. No environmental exposure is involved.

label: UCI Breast Cancer Study
note: A population-based breast cancer case-control study whose cases are breast cancer patients from Orange County, so a patient cohort; no environmental exposure is its design purpose.

label: U.S. Radiologic Technologists Study
exposures: low-dose occupational ionizing radiation exposure | personal medical ionizing radiation exposures | solar ultraviolet radiation exposures
quote: Radiologic Technologists (USRT) Study—also known as the Rad Tech Study—is a collaborative effort between the University of Minnesota, the National Cancer Institute Radiation Epidemiology Branch, and the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) to investigate potential radiation-related health effects from low-dose occupational radiation exposure.
note: An occupational cohort of certified radiologic technologists followed for the health effects of low-dose occupational radiation, so an exposure cohort defined by occupation; its outcomes are cancer and other diseases broadly, so not a disease cohort.

label: Vanderbilt Atrial Fibrillation Ablation Registry
note: A clinical and genetic registry of adults scheduled for catheter ablation of atrial fibrillation, so a patient cohort; ablation is a procedure, not an environmental exposure.

label: Vietnam Era Twin Study of Aging
exposures: military service during the Vietnam era (1965–1975)
quote: Briefly, VETSA includes 1608 men who were recruited from the Vietnam Era Twin Registry (VETR), a nationally representative registry, which includes male twins, who were in the military at some time during the Vietnam era (1965–1975).
note: Twins drawn from a registry of men who served in the US military in the Vietnam era, so selected by military service (though most report no combat exposure and the study is about aging); its stated focus is now early risk of MCI and Alzheimer's disease.

label: VHIR-FMT-Barcelona
note: A Barcelona case-control collection whose cases are ischaemic stroke patients, used in stroke GWAS; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Virginia Twin Study of Adolescent Behavioral Development
note: A population-based, unselected sample of Virginia school twins whose stated purpose is the development of child psychiatric disorders (and later substance use), so a population study of one disease family; it is not selected or designed around an environmental exposure.

label: Vanderbilt Atrial Fibrillation Registry
note: A clinical and genetic registry of patients with atrial fibrillation and their family members, so a patient cohort; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: WeGene cohort
quote: All participants were drawn from the customer base of WeGene, Inc., a consumer personal genetics company.
note: A research cohort of customers of a Chinese direct-to-consumer genetic testing company, not selected for any exposure or disease.

label: Wisconsin Sleep Cohort Study
note: A population sample of Wisconsin state employees, enriched for snorers, designed to study the natural history of sleep-disordered breathing, so a population study of one disease; the state-employee frame is a sampling frame, not an occupational exposure.

label: ZOE 2.0
note: A community-based study of preschool children in North Carolina set up as a GWAS of early childhood caries, so a population study of one disease; no environmental exposure is its design purpose.

label: Protection Against Allergy: Study in Rural Environments
exposures: farm exposures | living on family-run livestock farms | exposure to animal sheds | farm milk consumption
quote: Children of mothers living on family-run livestock farms at birth of the children were assigned to the farm group.
note: A rural birth cohort whose farm group was selected for living on livestock farms, compared with non-farm rural children, to study farm exposures as protective factors; its stated purpose is asthma and atopic disease.

label: Project Viva
exposures: prenatal diet
quote: We established Project Viva to examine prenatal diet and other factors in relation to maternal and child health.
note: A pre-birth cohort of pregnant women from a Massachusetts practice established to examine prenatal diet and other factors, so designed around a lifestyle exposure; its outcomes are broad maternal and child health, so not a disease cohort.

label: GERO cohort
note: Community-dwelling adults aged 70 or over without dementia but with subjective cognitive complaint, followed for progression to dementia, so selected for risk of dementia; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Alzheimer's Genetics in Argentina–Alzheimer Argentina consortium
note: A multisite Argentinian case-control study of sporadic Alzheimer's disease (its samples are the Argentinian ones in this GWAS), so its cases are patients; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: STORK study
quote: The STORK study is a prospective cohort study including 1031 healthy pregnant women of Scandinavian heritage with singleton pregnancies.
note: A cohort of healthy pregnant women in Oslo studying determinants of fetal growth and birthweight; pregnancy is not a disease and no environmental exposure defines it.

label: San Antonio Longitudinal Study of Aging
quote: The San Antonio Longitudinal Study of Aging (SALSA) is a community-based study of the disablement process in older Mexican Americans (MAs) and European Americans (EAs).
note: Community-based longitudinal study of the disablement process and frailty in older Mexican and European Americans randomly sampled from San Antonio neighbourhoods; an ageing study, not selected for an exposure or a disease.

label: Northern Ireland GRID Collection
note: A collection of type 1 diabetes cases from Northern Ireland used as independent cases in type 1 diabetes genetic studies; no exposure basis.

label: Genome-wide assessment of the gene variants associated with severe COVID-19 phenotype in Iran
note: Iranian genetic study of severe COVID-19 contributing to the COVID-19 HGI; the study name states it is about severe COVID-19, and that its participants are hospitalised patients rests on the definition only, since no fetched text describes its recruitment.

label: Northern Ireland Young Hearts Project
note: Random school samples of Northern Irish adolescents followed into young adulthood; its stated purpose is cardiovascular disease risk factors, so it is a population study of cardiovascular disease. Diet and physical activity are measured but are not the design basis.

label: Active Life Expectancy, Ageing, and Disability Related to Obesity Study
note: Community-dwelling older adults in Santiago, Chile, sampled from population sources; the cohort was designed to study disability and dementia associated with obesity, so it is a population study of those diseases, not a patient series.

label: Genetics of Glaucoma in People of African Descent Consortium
note: Consortium of case-control collections of primary open-angle glaucoma in people of African ancestry; classified by what it collects: glaucoma cases and controls.

label: International Collaboration on Ovarian Neoplasms 7 trial
note: Phase 3 randomised trial of bevacizumab in women with newly diagnosed ovarian cancer; the only exposure is treatment, which is out of scope.

label: Genetics of Parkinson's in India – Young Onset Parkinson's Disease
note: Pan-India multicentre series of patients with juvenile-, young- and early-onset Parkinson's disease recruited at movement disorder centres.

label: SweCovid study
note: Patients with critical COVID-19 admitted to the Uppsala University Hospital ICU and followed up after discharge; a disease cohort, not an exposure cohort.

label: COVID-19 Kohortenstudie am Klinikum München Rechts der Isar
note: Prospective registry of SARS-CoV-2-positive patients at the Klinikum rechts der Isar, Munich; a patient cohort.

label: Placental Abruption Genetic Epidemiology study
note: Case-control study of placental abruption (and preterm birth) among women delivering at Lima hospitals; environmental determinants are mentioned only generally, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: STORK Groruddalen
exposures: physical activity in pregnancy
quote: The STORK Groruddalen research programme: A population-based cohort study of gestational diabetes, physical activity, and obesity in pregnancy in a multiethnic population.
note: Population-based cohort of pregnant women in Groruddalen, Oslo, set up to identify predictors of gestational diabetes and fetal growth; physical activity is one of the three named subjects of the programme, which makes the exposure verdict borderline.

label: Mount Sinai COVID-19 Biobank
note: Research biobank of patients hospitalised with COVID-19 in the Mount Sinai Health System, with a small group of controls.

label: Die Deutsche Diabetes Dialyse Studie
note: Randomised trial of atorvastatin in patients with type 2 diabetes on maintenance haemodialysis; the only exposure is a medication, which is out of scope.

label: African Descent and Glaucoma Evaluation Study
note: Multicentre cohort of people with glaucoma, suspected glaucoma and controls of African and European descent; ADAGES III is mostly primary open-angle glaucoma patients.

label: ADMIxture and Risk of Acute Leukemia Study
note: Case-control study of B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia in African American children and young adults, with matched newborn-blood-spot controls; genetic, not environmental, in design.

label: Amish Family Osteoporosis Study
note: Family study of the Old Order Amish ascertained through adults with osteoporosis, whose first-degree relatives and spouses were recruited; mostly relatives of patients, hence at risk.

label: Asian Genetic Epidemiology Network
note: Consortium of East Asian genetic epidemiology studies, mostly population, hospital or family cohorts, organised around type 2 diabetes and related traits; its working groups also cover blood pressure and kidney function.

label: AIDS Linked to the IntraVenous Experience
exposures: injection drug use
quote: The AIDS Linked to the IntraVenous Experience (ALIVE) study is a natural history study following the incidence and progression of HIV infection among intravenous drug users (IDUs) in Baltimore, MD.
note: Community cohort of current and former people who inject drugs in Baltimore, recruited for that behaviour and followed for HIV incidence and progression; injection drug use defines the cohort and makes it at risk of HIV (some participants are HIV-positive).

label: Australian Melanoma Family Study
exposures: lifetime sun exposure | solar ultraviolet exposure
quote: Discovering and understanding genetic risk factors for melanoma and their interactions with phenotype, sun exposure, and other risk factors could lead to new strategies for melanoma control.
note: Population-based case-control-family study of early-onset cutaneous melanoma in Australia; its design centres on genetic and environmental influences, with detailed lifetime sun exposure histories collected from probands and relatives.

label: Anxiety NeuroGenetics STudy
note: Consortium of seven studies (mostly population cohorts and a control sample) pooled for case-control and factor-score GWAS of interview-diagnosed anxiety disorders; classified by what it collects, anxiety disorder cases and controls.

label: Anglo-Australasian Osteoporosis Genetics Consortium
note: Postmenopausal women selected for extreme high or extreme low hip bone mineral density for a GWAS of osteoporosis; the low-BMD women are treated as cases, though the extreme-truncate design is trait-based.

label: Anakinra for Pustular Psoriasis: Response in a Controlled Trial
note: Randomised placebo-controlled trial of anakinra in adults with palmoplantar pustulosis; smoking is studied as a disease driver elsewhere but does not define this trial.

label: Assessment of Renal and Cervical Artery DysplasIA
note: National French-Belgian registry of adults with fibromuscular dysplasia; a patient registry.

label: Anglo-Scandinavian Cardiac Outcomes Trial
note: Randomised trial of antihypertensive and lipid-lowering treatment in hypertensive adults with further cardiovascular risk factors; participants have hypertension and are at risk of cardiovascular disease. The only exposures are medications.

label: The Ashkenazi Jewish Dataset
note: A Parkinson's disease case-control GWAS sample of Ashkenazi Jewish people from New York; cases have PD, and no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Assessment, Serial Evaluation, and Subsequent Sequelae of Acute Kidney Injury Study
note: Hospitalised adults with acute kidney injury and matched non-AKI controls followed for kidney and cardiovascular outcomes; the 'exposure' is AKI itself, a disease, not an environmental agent.

label: Age-related diseases: Understanding Genetic and non-genetic influences - a study at the University of Regensburg
note: A general-population cohort of the mobile elderly around Regensburg, set up as a platform for late-onset chronic diseases in general; broad purpose, no defining exposure.

label: Bambui (Brazil) Cohort Study of Ageing
note: A community-based census cohort of all residents aged 60+ of Bambuí, Brazil, studying health and ageing; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: Biology, Affect, Stress, Imaging and Cognition study
note: A population-based cohort of pregnant women in Uppsala whose stated purpose is perinatal depression; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Baltimore Breast Cancer Study
note: A Baltimore breast cancer case-control study focused on markers of aggressiveness; cases have breast cancer, no environmental exposure focus.

label: Beaver Dam Eye Study
note: A population-based cohort of Beaver Dam residents aged 43-84 set up to study age-related eye disease, especially AMD; smoking is studied as a risk factor but does not define the cohort.

label: BioImage Study: A Clinical Study of Burden of Atherosclerotic Disease in an At-Risk Population
note: Asymptomatic health-plan members selected for their risk of atherothrombotic events and imaged for subclinical atherosclerosis; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Barbados National Cancer Study
exposures: environmental risk factors for breast and prostate cancer | dietary intake
quote: BNCS is a case-control study of environmental risk factors for breast and prostate cancer in a predominantly African-origin population in Barbados.
note: A nationwide case-control study of breast and prostate cancer in Barbados whose stated aim is environmental (including dietary, via a purpose-built FFQ) and genetic risk factors; the exposure verdict rests on that stated aim rather than a single defined agent.

label: Brigham and Women's Rheumatoid Arthritis Sequential Study
note: A single-centre registry of rheumatoid arthritis patients in Boston; drug response is studied but medication is not an environmental exposure.

label: British Society for Surgery of the Hand Genetics of Dupuytren's Disease study
note: A UK collection of surgically treated Dupuytren's disease patients for genetic studies; the controls come from another study.

label: Cambridgeshire Parkinson's Incidence from GP to Neurologist
note: A population-representative incident cohort of newly diagnosed Parkinson's disease and parkinsonism in Cambridgeshire.

label: Canadian Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection Study
note: A prospective cohort of patients presenting with acute spontaneous coronary artery dissection; emotional and physical stressors are recorded as precipitants but do not define the cohort.

label: Copenhagen City Heart Study
note: An age-stratified random sample of the Copenhagen general population set up as a cardiovascular population study; other topics (including alcohol) were added later but no exposure defines it.

label: Chicago Cancer Prone Study
note: A registry of individuals and families at high risk of cancer at a Chicago preventive oncology clinic, also run as a hospital-based case-control study of breast cancer in young patients (so it includes patients too).

label: Comprehensive Sickle Cell Centers Collaborative Data Project
note: A multicentre observational cohort of children and adults with sickle cell disease treated at the NHLBI Comprehensive Sickle Cell Centers.

label: Cardiovascular Genome Center cohort
note: A hospital-based registry of cardiology patients at Severance Hospital, Seoul, for genetic research on coronary artery disease; some came only for check-ups, so the patient role follows from the clinic setting rather than a stated diagnosis requirement.

label: Cancer Genetic Markers of Susceptibility
note: An NCI initiative running prostate and breast cancer GWAS in case-control sets drawn from existing cohorts and a case-control study; classified by the cancer cases it collects, with no exposure focus.

label: Canadian Cystic Fibrosis Gene Modifier Study
note: A population-based Canadian study of people with cystic fibrosis (and their parents) to find genetic modifiers of CF lung disease and complications.

label: Center for HIV/AIDS Vaccine Immunology
note: An NIAID HIV vaccine consortium whose clinical and host-genetics cohorts are mostly people with acute or chronic HIV-1 infection; it is defined by infection (disease), not by exposure among the uninfected.

label: Chinese Keratoconus Cohort Study
note: A hospital-based cohort of keratoconus patients in Zhengzhou; its 'environment' factors are eye rubbing, atopy and BMI, which are not environmental agents in scope.

label: Chronic Kidney Disease in Children Study
note: A North American prospective cohort of children with chronic kidney disease followed for progression and its effects.

label: UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics
note: A UCLA sample of mostly healthy community adults plus patient groups with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and ADHD, studied dimensionally for links to these illnesses; the disease verdict rests on the recruited patient groups, though healthy volunteers are the majority.

label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease in Dusty Areas
exposures: cement dust from cement plants
quote: The COPD in dusty areas (CODA) cohort study collected epidemiological and clinical data from participants living near cement plants where cement dust affected them16.
note: Residents of cement-plant districts in South Korea, with COPD or airflow limitation and normal-spirometry volunteers, followed for COPD outcomes under cement dust exposure; residence near the plants defines the exposure.

label: Cohort in Lung Transplantation
note: A French-Belgian cohort of lung transplant candidates (with end-stage lung disease, mostly COPD) and their donors, set up to predict chronic lung allograft dysfunction; air pollution was studied in a sub-project only, so no exposure verdict.

label: Cooperative Study of Sickle Cell Disease
note: A US multicentre natural-history study that enrolled patients with sickle cell disease, so a patient cohort; no environmental exposure defines or drives the design.

label: Dallas Heart Study
quote: A probability-based sample of Dallas County residents aged 18 to 65 years was surveyed with an extensive household health interview.
note: A population-based probability sample of Dallas County residents designed to study ethnic differences in cardiovascular health, so a population study of cardiovascular disease; exposures are not its design purpose.

label: Danish Testicular Cancer Late Treatment Effects Cohort
note: A nationwide Danish cohort of testicular cancer survivors studied for late treatment effects; the only exposure is cancer treatment, which is out of scope.

label: Drakenstein Child Health Study
quote: The DCHS is a population-based birth cohort study in the Drakenstein area in Paarl, a peri-urban area, 60 km outside Cape Town, South Africa.
note: A population-based South African birth cohort built to study early lower respiratory tract infection; environmental exposures (measured with home monitors) are one of seven risk-factor domains rather than the stated design purpose, so exposure is judged no, though it is borderline.

label: Dental Strategies Concentrating on Risk Evaluation
note: A dental-examination subgroup of Heart SCORE, a community-based cardiovascular disease study of Pittsburgh adults; participants were not selected for disease or exposure, so it is a population study of cardiovascular disease with dental phenotyping.

label: Diabetes Gene Discovery Group
note: A French type 2 diabetes case-control GWAS sample whose cases were selected for type 2 diabetes; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Diabetes Multi-omic Investigation of Drug Response
note: A cohort of type 2 diabetes patients in a Michigan health system studied for drug response; medication response is not an environmental exposure.

label: Detroit Neighborhood Health Study
quote: To test this viewpoint, we examined PTSS data from the DNHS, a prospective population-based longitudinal cohort based in Detroit, Michigan33.
note: A population-based Detroit cohort whose stated objective is psychopathology, chiefly PTSD and depression; the exposures studied are traumatic and stressful life experiences and social adversity rather than an environmental agent, so exposure is judged no.

label: Endometrial Cancer Association Consortium
note: A consortium of endometrial cancer case-control studies, classified by its cases; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: European Challenge for Healthy Aging
note: A European family study of longevity recruiting nonagenarians and centenarians with relatives; longevity is a trait, not a disease, and environmental factors are mentioned only in passing.

label: Pittsburgh Epidemiology of Diabetes Complications Study
note: A prospective cohort of people with childhood-onset type 1 diabetes followed for complications; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Scottish AMD study
note: A Scottish clinic-based case-control study of age-related macular degeneration, classified by its cases; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Estudo Longitudinal de Saúde do Adulto
quote: At Visit 1, we enrolled 15 105 civil servants from predefined universities or research institutes.
note: A cohort of Brazilian university and research-institute employees whose stated aim is chronic disease, primarily diabetes and cardiovascular disease, so a population study of those diseases (borderline with a broad chronic-disease purpose); civil servants were not chosen for an environmental exposure.

label: Epidemiology of Burkitt Lymphoma in East African Children and Minors
note: A case-control study of childhood Burkitt lymphoma in malaria-endemic East Africa, classified by its cases; infections are studied as risk factors of the disease, but participants were selected by disease status, not by exposure.

label: Essen-Heidelberg
note: A German melanoma case-control GWAS sample of histologically confirmed cutaneous melanoma cases and healthy controls; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: FActeurs de RIsque et de récidives de la maladie thromboembolique Veineuse
note: A French multicentre case-control study of first venous thromboembolism, classified by its cases; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: European/International Fibromuscular Dysplasia Registry and Initiative
note: A European/international registry of patients with fibromuscular dysplasia; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: FinDonor 10 000 study
quote: A total of 2584 blood donors (N = 8003 samples) were recruited into the study alongside standard donation at three donation sites in the capital region of Finland between 5/2015 and 12/2017.
note: A cohort of Finnish whole-blood donors set up to study iron status and iron stores; donors are healthy volunteers, iron status is a trait and blood donation is not an environmental exposure, so both verdicts are no.

label: National FinHealth 2017 Study
quote: The national FinHealth 2017 study comprises a random sample of adults in Finland, and it focuses on objective and perceived health, quality of life, lifestyle, prevalence, and risk factors for common health problems including sleep, insomnia, and alcohol consumption.
note: A national health examination survey of a random sample of Finnish adults with a broad health-monitoring purpose; neither an exposure nor a disease defines it.

label: FinnTwin12 Cohort
exposures: tobacco use | alcohol use | substance use
quote: The basic aim of the FT12 study design was to obtain information on individual, familial and school/neighborhood risks for substance use/abuse prior to the onset of regular tobacco and alcohol use and then track trajectories of use and abuse and their consequences into adulthood.
note: A population-based Finnish twin birth cohort whose stated basic aim is the risks and trajectories of tobacco, alcohol and other substance use and abuse, so its main subject is lifestyle exposure and it is a population study of substance abuse.

label: Finnish Twin Study on Aging
quote: The FITSA was set up to investigate genetic and environmental effects on the disablement process in older female twins.
note: A study of older female twin pairs from the Older Finnish Twin Cohort on the disablement process of ageing; ageing and physical functioning are not diseases and environmental effects are mentioned only generically.

label: Follow-up of Ovarian Cancer Genetic Association and Interaction Studies
note: A post-GWAS programme pooling the ovarian cancer case-control studies of the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium, classified by its cases; gene-environment interaction is one aim among many, not an exposure design.

label: Marburg-Münster Affective Disorders Cohort Study
note: The FOR2107 cohort of patients with major psychoses (MDD, bipolar disorder, schizoaffective disorder, schizophrenia), at-risk subjects and controls; environmental risk is one of several selection criteria for a minority of healthy subjects and no specific environmental agent defines the cohort, so exposure is no.

label: Genes and Blood Clotting Study
quote: A total of 1189 healthy individuals (ages 14-35) representing 507 sibships (with 2-6 siblings per family) from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, were recruited between June 26, 2006, and January 30, 2009.
note: A family-based sample of healthy young University of Michigan students and their siblings recruited to study genetic variation in blood clotting proteins; healthy volunteers, no exposure or disease focus.

label: Genetic Analysis of Psoriasis Consortium
note: An international consortium pooling collections of people with psoriasis vulgaris with controls for genetic association studies, classified by its cases; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Ghana Breast Health Study
note: Population-based breast cancer case-control study in Ghana; cases are women with suspected or treated breast cancer. Exposures such as mosquito-control products were analysed later but are not the design basis.

label: GenomALC
exposures: chronic heavy drinking (≥80 g of alcohol/day for men, 50 g/d for women, for ≥10 years)
quote: Briefly, chronic heavy drinkers who reported consuming ≥80 g of alcohol/day (male) or 50 g/d (female) for ≥10 years with cirrhosis (cases) or without significant alcohol-associated liver disease (controls) were recruited.
note: Case-control GWAS of alcohol-related cirrhosis in which every participant was recruited as a long-term heavy drinker; cases have alcoholic cirrhosis.

label: Melanoma Genetics Consortium
note: Consortium of familial melanoma genetics groups pooling melanoma cases, melanoma-prone families (including unaffected CDKN2A carriers, at risk) and controls. Gene-UV interaction is one listed aim but the design centres on genetics, so exposure is no.

label: GENetics of SEPsis-induced ARDS Network
note: ICU cohort of adult sepsis patients followed for ARDS and survival; all participants have sepsis.

label: Genetics of Early Onset Stroke Study
note: Population-based case-control study of first ischaemic stroke at ages 15-49 in the Baltimore-Washington area; environmental risk factors are secondary to the genetic aim.

label: Genetics of Osteoarthritis Consortium
note: Consortium meta-analysing osteoarthritis case-control GWAS from its contributing cohorts and biobanks; it collects osteoarthritis cases.

label: Genetics of Childhood Cancer Treatment
note: Retrospective cohort of paediatric cancer patients for pharmacogenetics; the platinum chemotherapy is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Genetic Origin of Dupuytren Disease and Associated Fibromatosis study
note: Dutch case collection of Dupuytren disease patients from surgery clinics for genetic studies.

label: Genetics of Impulsivity project
quote: Participants were 1252 young adults (62 % female) with low levels of addictive behavior, who were assessed in individual laboratory rooms at the University of Chicago and the University of Georgia.
note: Healthy young adults with low substance use studied for the genetics of impulsivity, a trait; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: Genetics of Latinos Diabetic Retinopathy
note: Family-based study of Latinos ascertained through probands with type 2 diabetes and diabetic retinopathy or long diabetes duration.

label: Global Parkinson's Genetics Program
note: Worldwide programme genotyping Parkinson's disease patients (with some controls) from existing and new collections; it collects Parkinson's disease cases.

label: Genomic Research on Asthma in the African Diaspora
note: Asthma case-control collection of African Americans in the Baltimore-Washington area assembled from asthma studies.

label: Genomic Research in Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency and Sarcoidosis Study
note: Observational study enrolling adults with sarcoidosis and adults with PiZZ/PiMZ alpha-1 antitrypsin genotypes; the lung microbiome is studied as biology, not as an environmental exposure.

label: Genomics of Resistance to Immunodeficiency Virus
note: DNA collection of HIV-1-infected long-term non-progressors and rapid progressors in France; the infection is the disease defining the cohort, so it is not an exposed-uninfected exposure cohort.

label: Guangzhou Twin Eye Study
note: Longitudinal study of population-registry twins aged 7-15 whose stated primary aim is common eye diseases, particularly myopia; environmental influences are mentioned generically, not as a defined exposure.

label: Guangzhou cohort
note: Extreme-phenotype collection of high myopes and hyperopes in Guangzhou; participants were selected for refractive error.

label: Guangzhou Colorectal Cancer Study
note: Hospital-based colorectal cancer case-control study in Guangzhou genotyped for GWAS.

label: Hemophilia Growth and Development Study
note: Longitudinal study of boys with hemophilia, most HIV-infected through clotting factor concentrates, studying the impact of HIV; HIV acquired through treatment is a disease here, not an environmental exposure.

label: Hordaland Health Study
quote: The Hordaland Health Study (HUSK) is a community-based study in Western Norway conducted as a collaboration between the University of Bergen, the Norwegian Health Screening Service and the Municipal Health Service in Hordaland (https://husk-en.w.uib.no/)53.
note: Community-based health study of Hordaland residents invited by birth year, covering chronic diseases broadly; neither exposure- nor single-disease-defined.

label: Hong Kong Children Eye Study
note: Population-based school-children cohort whose stated purpose is eye disorders; environmental determinants are named generically, not a defined exposure.

label: Hong Kong Diabetes Biobank
note: Multicentre prospective cohort and biobank of adults with diabetes attending hospital diabetes centres in Hong Kong.

label: Healthy Zhejiang One Million People Cohort
quote: The HOPE Cohort is a newly established community-based prospective cohort enrolling participants from both urban and rural areas in Zhejiang Province, China.
note: New community-based prospective population cohort in Zhejiang; no exposure or disease basis stated.

label: Health and Prevention Enhancement
quote: The Health and Prevention Enhancement (H-PEACE) study was designed to investigate the association of diagnostic imaging results, biomarkers and the predisease stage of non-communicable diseases (NCDs), such as malignancies and metabolic diseases, in an average-risk population in Korea.
note: Retrospective cohort of health check-up examinees at a Seoul hospital, an average-risk population studied for non-communicable diseases broadly.

label: Initiative on Nephropathy, of relevance to public health, which is Chronic, possibly in its Initial stages, and carries a Potential risk of major clinical End-points
note: Random general-population sample of adults aged 40+ in Veneto set up to study chronic kidney disease prevalence and risk factors.

label: International Stuttering Project
note: Collection of clinically ascertained people with developmental stuttering, a speech disorder, for genetic studies.

label: INTERHEART study
exposures: smoking | dietary patterns | physical activity | consumption of alcohol | psychosocial factors
quote: The relation of smoking, history of hypertension or diabetes, waist/hip ratio, dietary patterns, physical activity, consumption of alcohol, blood apolipoproteins (Apo), and psychosocial factors to myocardial infarction are reported here.
note: INTERHEART is a 52-country case-control study of first acute myocardial infarction whose cases are MI patients; its main subject is modifiable risk factors including smoking, diet, alcohol and physical activity, so it counts as designed to study lifestyle exposures, though these sit alongside clinical risk factors.

label: International Tuberculosis Host Genetics Consortium
note: A consortium of tuberculosis case-control GWAS studying host genetic susceptibility; its members are defined by TB disease, not by exposure to the infection.

label: Indiana University-Purdue University Indianapolis cohort
note: Volunteers recruited for 3D facial imaging and genotyping to study normal facial variation and other visible traits; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: International Warfarin Pharmacogenetics Consortium
note: A pharmacogenetics consortium pooling data on warfarin-treated patients to model warfarin dose; the defining feature is a medication, which is out of scope for exposure, and the patients are not selected for one disease.

label: Karolinska Breast Cancer Study
note: A Stockholm breast cancer case-control study of inherited susceptibility whose cases are breast cancer patients; no exposure focus.

label: Korea National Cancer Center gastric cancer case-control study
exposures: antioxidant-rich diet | dietary mercury intake
quote: The dietary antioxidant capacity was estimated based on the oxygen radical absorbance capacity (ORAC) incorporated with a semiquantitative food frequency questionnaire.
note: A hospital-based gastric cancer case-control study at the Korean National Cancer Center; cases are gastric cancer patients, and the study collects food-frequency data used chiefly for diet-gene studies of gastric cancer, so diet is a main subject.

label: Korea-NCC (National Cancer Center) Colorectal Cancer Study
exposures: dietary vitamin B2 intake
quote: Dietary vitamin B2 intake was assessed using a semiquantitative food frequency questionnaire, and the association with CRC was evaluated.
note: A hospital-based colorectal cancer case-control study at the Korean National Cancer Center; cases are CRC patients, and it collects food-frequency data used for diet-gene studies, though its genetic role in the Asia Colorectal Cancer Consortium is equally prominent, so the exposure verdict is medium.

label: Low Concentration Atropine for Myopia Progression Study
note: A randomised trial of low-concentration atropine eye drops in children with progressing myopia; participants have myopia, and the intervention is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: Leipzig Childhood Obesity cohort
note: A cohort of children and adolescents with overweight or obesity recruited through the Leipzig paediatric obesity clinic; obesity counts as a disease here.

label: Lung Oncology Research & Discovery
note: A case-only cohort of lung cancer surgery patients in Quebec City; smoking is analysed but the cohort is defined by disease, not exposure.

label: Multicenter AIDS Cohort Study
note: A cohort of gay and bisexual men with and without HIV-1 infection, recruited as a risk group to study the natural history of HIV infection and AIDS; the mix of infected and at-risk men is recorded as at risk. HIV infection is a disease here, not an environmental exposure.

label: Manchester Lung Health Check
exposures: ever smoking
quote: In brief, ever smokers aged 55–74 at participating general practices (n=14) were invited to a LHC; this consisted of 6-year lung cancer risk calculation (PLCOM2012),3 symptom assessment, smoking cessation advice and spirometry.
note: A community lung cancer screening programme that invites ever-smokers and screens those at high risk; smokers recruited as smokers make it an exposure cohort, and it is at risk for lung cancer.

label: Mayo Vascular Disease Biorepository
note: An EMR-linked biorepository of Mayo Clinic patients referred for vascular evaluation with known or suspected atherosclerotic vascular disease; no exposure focus.

label: Manchester Cancer Research Centre Biobank
note: A cancer research tissue bank collecting samples from surgical patients in whom cancer is a possible diagnosis; it serves cancer research and has no exposure focus.

label: MELARISK study
note: A French collection of melanoma patients recruited for genetic susceptibility studies; risk-factor questionnaires are collected but exposure is not the design purpose.

label: Multicenter Hemophilia Cohort Studies
note: NCI cohorts of people with hemophilia or related coagulation disorders followed for HIV, HCV and HBV infection; participants are selected for a disease, not for an environmental exposure.

label: Myeloma XI trial
note: A UK phase 3 treatment trial for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma; participants are patients and the interventions are medications.

label: MRC Myeloma IX trial
note: A UK MRC randomised treatment trial for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma; participants are patients and the interventions are medications.

label: Mexican Genomic Database for Addiction Research
exposures: tobacco use | alcohol use | drug use
quote: This study analyzed a subsample of the Mexican Genomic Database for Addiction Research (MxGDAR/Encodat), derived from the Mexican National Survey of Tobacco, Alcohol, and Drug use (Villatoro-Velázquez et al., 2017).
